Vragen van het lid Azmani (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat niemand van de Rotterdamse werkloze jongeren aan de sl

Member Azmani (VVD) asked the ministers whether unemployed Rotterdam youths refusing port jobs, despite available vacancies, should face sanctions and how youth unemployment and the skills mismatch are being tackled. The state secretary responded that the municipality applies sanctions for non-compliance, reported falling WWB/WIJ benefit numbers, and said changes to national rules to move people off benefits faster are being considered.
It is being considered whether further legislation and regulation in this area is needed to get people off benefits faster.
Bezien wordt of nadere wet- en regelgeving op dit vlak nodig is om mensen sneller uit een uitkering te krijgen.

Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over jonggehandicapten die vanwege kabinetsbeleid hun jobcoach – en daarmee hun baan – verliezen (ingezonden 11 november 2011

An SP MP asks the State Secretary whether ending UWV-funded job coaching for young disabled workers after three years, which may cost them their jobs, is desirable and how it fits government employment goals. The State Secretary replies that the protocol change aims at more efficient coaching, that extensions can be requested on justified grounds, and that some claims about a TNO study were misleading.
It is undesirable if young disabled persons lose their jobs.
Het is onwenselijk als jongehandicapten hun baan verliezen.
Vragen van het lid Azmani (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over «Te veel jongeren in de Wajong» (ingezonden 11 november 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about reports that municipalities moved young people from the WWB/WIJ benefit to the Wajong disability scheme for financial reasons, and about the role of UWV and the Wajong intake rate. The state secretary acknowledges the substitution effect, points to the planned Wet Werken naar Vermogen to unify responsibility with municipalities, and says he will consider preventing cost-shifting in the detailed design of that bill.
I will take this aspect into account in the further elaboration of the Werken naar Vermogen bill.
Ik zal dit aspect betrekken bij de nadere uitwerking van het wetsvoorstel Werken naar Vermogen.

Vragen van de leden De Jong en Van Klaveren (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat allochtone probleemjongeren in Utrecht werkschuw zijn (ingezonden 17 november 201

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about reports that allochtone problem youths in Utrecht are work-shy, questioning the sustainability of the welfare safety net, the spending on reintegration projects, and whether benefits should be stopped and fraud fully recovered. The state secretary agreed that refusing suitable work should lead to benefit withdrawal, noted the Utrecht project was municipally run with limited results so far, and pointed to planned fraud-recovery proposals and existing interest-charging rules.
The cabinet has developed proposals so that, in cases of benefit fraud, wrongly received benefits are fully recovered and a sanction of up to the fraud amount can additionally be imposed.

Het kabinet heeft voorstellen ontwikkeld om in geval van uitkeringsfraude, de onterecht ontvangen uitkeringen geheel terug te vorderen en daarnaast een sanctie op te leggen van maximaal het fraudebedrag.

Vragen van de leden Hamer, Van Dam en Marcouch (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het discrimineren van Turken, Marokkanen en Suriname

PvdA MPs asked ministers about a study finding that about three quarters of Dutch temp agencies honour employer requests to exclude Turkish, Moroccan or Surinamese candidates, and what the government will do. The state secretary condemned discrimination, promised consultations with industry bodies and the minorities platform, pointed to existing complaint routes, and stated that agencies have their own responsibility under equal treatment law but offered no new enforcement tools such as fines or licence withdrawal.
I intend to hold consultations in the short term with the General Union of Temp Agencies (ABU), the Dutch Union of Placement and Temp Agencies (NBBU) and the National Minorities Consultation (LOM).

Ik ben voornemens om op korte termijn overleg te voeren met de Algemene Bond Uitzendondernemingen (ABU), de Nederlandse Bond van Bemiddelings- en Uitzendondernemingen (NBBU) en het Landelijk Overleg Minderheden (LOM).

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Karabulut (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de onterechte korting op de bijzondere bijstand van chroni

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked why Amsterdam cut special assistance for chronically ill and disabled people after a court ruling, whether the state knew, and whether people will be compensated and municipalities obliged to grant categorical assistance. The state secretary replied that special assistance is decentralised to municipalities, that he does not comment on individual cases, will not compensate affected people, and will not oblige municipalities to grant categorical assistance.
In this context it is up to the independent judge to assess the decisions the municipality of Amsterdam made in individual cases.
In dit kader is het aan de onafhankelijke rechter om een oordeel te geven over de besluiten die de gemeente Amsterdam in individuele gevallen heeft genomen
Vragen van de leden Van den Besselaar en De Jong (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over gratis fietsen voor werklozen in Rotterdam (ingezonden 13 oktober 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Rotterdam scheme giving free bicycles to unemployed people, questioning incentives, resale, control, and budget sources. The state secretary replied only that a substantive answer could not be given within the three-week deadline because additional information was awaited.
The reason for this is that I am awaiting additional information.
De reden hiervoor is dat ik in afwachting ben van aanvullende informatie.

Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat Spijkenisse de grenzen sluit voor kansloze uitkeringsgerechtigden uit Rotterdam (ingezonden 2 september

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether the Spijkenisse alderman's plan to refuse welfare recipients from Rotterdam, and his description of benefit recipients as non-willing profiteers, is lawful and whether it stems from the Rotterdam law. The government replied that the municipality is bound by the regional housing ordinance, that the Rotterdam law cannot wall off a municipality, that it does not comment on a wethouder's statements, and that the Rotterdam law's effects will be seen in the municipality's evaluation.
This law does not offer the possibility to place a 'fence around the municipality', but can be applied to a few specifically named districts.
Deze wet biedt niet de mogelijkheid om «een hek om de gemeente» te plaatsen, maar kan worden toegepast voor enkele specifiek te benoemen wijken.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de toename van de wachtlijsten voor de schuldhulpverlening (ingezonden 3 oktober 2011).

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about rising waiting lists for municipal debt assistance, whether maximum waiting times would be met under the proposed Wet gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening, and whether predatory private debt intermediaries would be controlled. The state secretary said he could not forecast waiting times, would rely on the statutory maximum waiting times and municipal councils to hold municipalities accountable, and would report on supervision and enforcement against malafide intermediaries before year-end.
If a municipality unexpectedly does not comply with this statutory obligation, it is up to the municipal council to hold the college of mayor and aldermen to account.
Indien een gemeente zich onverhoopt niet houdt aan deze wettelijke verplichting, is het aan de gemeenteraad om het college van B en W daarop aan te spreken.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over veiligheid van liften (ingezonden 1 september 2011).

An SP MP asked whether the Arbeidsinspectie's interim findings on large-scale contracting of certifying bodies for periodic lift inspections could be shared, and whether the recommendations would be adopted in the new lift inspection framework. The state secretary refused to release the interim memo because it may contain inaccuracies, promising the final report, and said the framework question cannot be answered until the investigation is complete.
Notes of findings may contain inaccuracies and for that reason are never made public.
Nota’s van bevindingen kunnen onjuistheden bevatten en worden om die reden nooit openbaar gemaakt.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over veiligheid van liften (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asks the state secretary of Social Affairs about lift safety, including whether maintenance firms may choose the inspector, the independence of certified inspection bodies flagged by the Labour Inspectorate, and whether the SNEL safety norm for existing lifts should be made mandatory. The state secretary replies that inspectors must be independent and under supervision of the Labour Inspectorate and accreditation body, that the Inspectorate's independence finding is still provisional with a final view expected in late 2011, and that no mandatory SNEL implementation is planned because the case for it is not yet convincing.
After processing the responses, the Labour Inspectorate will give a definitive judgement.
Na verwerking van de reacties zal de Arbeidsinspectie een definitief oordeel geven.

Vragen van het lid De Jong (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de berichten «Familie fraudeert met uitkeringen en koopt dure auto’s» en «Jaarlijks 8 miljoen euro uitkeringsfraude» (ing

An MP asked the state secretary about press reports of family benefit fraud and about calls to permanently stop benefits and fully recover fraud amounts with interest. The state secretary said fraud should be tackled firmly but that proportionality limits sanctions, so stopping benefits for three months is the ultimate sanction, and that existing rules already cover asset seizure and recovery with interest.
Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het schrappen van duizenden ID en WIW-banen bij gemeenten (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary how the claim that 150,000 to 200,000 welfare recipients can work squares with municipalities cutting thousands of ID and Wiw subsidised jobs, and about consequences for other benefits, subsidies and institutions. The state secretary answered that municipalities are free and responsible for phasing out subsidised work, that no detailed data on functions or dismissals are held centrally (about 7,700 subsidised places at end 2010), and gave no guarantees to workers.
They account for their policy to the municipal council, not to central government. Therefore no detailed data on functions, institutions or numbers are available.
Zij leggen over hun beleid verantwoording af aan de gemeenteraad, niet aan het Rijk. Er zijn daarom geen gedetailleerde gegevens beschikbaar over functies, instellingen of aantallen.

Vragen van de leden Sterk en Van der Werf (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de arbeidsomstandigheden op de bouwplaats van een energiecentrale in de Eemshaven (ingezonden 11 au

CDA MPs asked the state secretary about working conditions and fatal accidents at the RWE power plant construction site in the Eemshaven, including whether the Labour Inspectorate investigated. The state secretary answered that ten reportable accidents, one fatal, occurred, that the Inspectorate found violations and took enforcement action, and that weekly inspections continue.
Every week the Labour Inspectorate carries out inspections at RWE.
Wekelijks voert de Arbeidsinspectie controles uit bij RWE.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de berichten «Bedrijfsarts onder druk gezet door werkgever en arbodiensten», en

An MP asks ministers whether they will act on reports that about one in five company doctors cannot work independently due to pressure from employers and occupational health services, including breaches of medical confidentiality and possible effects on sickness and care costs. The government promises a policy response later, notes that doctors should work independently, says confidential medical data should not be shared, and points to sector-led initiatives on contracts and specialist recruitment.
I am of the view that every company doctor must be able to carry out their work independently, in accordance with the applicable professional or conduct codes.
Ik ben van mening dat elke bedrijfsarts zijn werkzaamheden onafhankelijk, conform de geldende beroeps- of gedragcodes dient te kunnen uitoefenen.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de berichtgeving dat de helft van de 330 000 bijstandsgerechtigden kinderen heeft (ingezonden 20 juni 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about reports that half of the 330,000 welfare recipients have children, the effects of childcare cuts and the Wet werken naar vermogen on welfare numbers, and child poverty. The state secretary says the figure includes adult children, that the policy focus is on work, that childcare allowances remain largely intact, that a poverty trap for single parents is being addressed, and that a SCP study on long-term effects of child poverty will follow.
The Social and Cultural Planning Office (SCP) has been commissioned to conduct research into the long-term effects of child poverty.
Het Sociaal en Cultureel Planbureau (SCP) is opdracht gegeven onderzoek te doen naar de lange-termijn effecten van armoede bij kinderen.
Vragen van het lid Vermeij (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over pensioentekort voor werknemers in de sociale werkplaats (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

The MP asks the minister whether a pension deficit of about EUR 350 million at the Werk en (re)Integratie pension fund for sheltered-workshop employees can be confirmed, and what measures will ensure low-income workers build adequate pension. The state secretary declines to confirm the figure, stresses that supplementary pensions are the responsibility of social partners, rules out a ministry top-up, and points to the AOW increase and the social partners' task.
Supplementary pensions are a responsibility of the social partners.
Aanvullende pensioenen zijn een verantwoordelijkheid van de sociale partners.

Vragen van de leden Arib en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat wie eerlijk is over hiv een baan kan vergeten (ingezonden 30 mei

MPs Arib and Dikkers asked ministers about reports that job applicants who disclose HIV may be rejected, and about employer attitudes, legal protection, and planned measures. The state secretary acknowledged persistent prejudice, noted the legal ban on HIV-based discrimination and existing complaint routes, and promised to consult social partners and anti-discrimination bureaus and to respond to ILO recommendation 200.
I am examining whether it is possible, within existing frameworks, to give more attention to discrimination on the grounds of HIV.
Ik bezie of het mogelijk is om binnen bestaande kaders meer aandacht te geven aan discriminatie op grond van hiv.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het beperken van de mogelijkheden voor begeleiding van Wajongers op de werkvloer (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

MP Ortega-Martijn asks the minister whether limiting job coach support for Wajong beneficiaries to three years and reducing the support rate to 10% will cause employers to end contracts, and how UWV's implementation and exception procedure will be improved. The state secretary replies that the protocol aligns with the goal of independent employment, exceptions allow a 15% rate with justification, UWV's concerns are addressed by a 2.5-year notification, and the revised protocol will not be sent to parliament in advance as UWV is an independent body.
I have asked UWV to examine how the Personal Support facility can be deployed more selectively and effectively
Ik heb aan het UWV gevraagd te bezien hoe de voorziening Persoonlijke Ondersteuning selectiever en effectiever kan worden ingezet
Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over hogere instroom in WIA (ingezonden 4 mei 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether the budget shortfall from higher-than-expected inflow into the WIA disability scheme can be easily calculated, whether the government will share relevant information, and for insight into the shortfall. The state secretary said other factors also determine the budget, that information will come via the Voorjaarsnota due before 1 June, and that the budget changes will be shown there.
Through the Voorjaarsnota you will gain insight into the size and reason of the budgetary changes in the WIA in 2011.
Via de Voorjaarsnota krijgt u inzicht in de omvang en de reden van de budgettaire mutaties in de WIA in 2011.

Vragen van het lid Vermeij (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over een geconstateerde lacune in de inkomensvoorziening voor oudere werklozen met een ondernemersverleden (ingezonden 29 april 2011)

An MP asked the minister whether older former self-employed workers who return briefly to employment and then lose their job fall through gaps between the IOW, IOAW and IOAZ income schemes, and whether a hardship clause or a legislative fix is planned. The state secretary replied that the WWB safety net covers such cases, that the schemes' conditions are deliberate, and that municipalities can partly exempt pension capital, so no regulatory change is needed.

Given the availability of the WWB, and the possibilities for municipalities to (partly) exempt pension assets when implementing the WWB in appropriate cases and thus apply tailored measures, there is no reason to amend the regulations.

Gezien de beschikbaarheid van de WWB, én de mogelijkheden voor gemeenten om bij de uitvoering van de WWB in voorkomende gevallen pensioenvermogen (deels) vrij te laten en zo maatwerk toe te passen, is er geen aanleiding voor aanpassing van de regelgeving.
Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over strenger beleid voor doktersbezoek bij Combiwerk (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

Karabulut (SP) asked whether Combiwerk's ban on staff visiting the doctor during working hours, due to budget cuts, is acceptable under the Wsw collective agreement and how staff can make up the hours. The state secretary replied that the matter is between employer and employees under the cao, that Combiwerk says it will apply the rules better, and that he cannot provide a savings calculation since it is Combiwerk's policy.
It is up to Combiwerk to give further substance to this.
Het is aan Combiwerk om hier verdere invulling aan te geven.
Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de studiefinanciering in combinatie met een WIJ-uitkering (ingezonden 4 mei 2011).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary whether a municipality may require a sibling of a WIJ benefit recipient to take the maximum student loan because they share a household, and on what legal basis, and how many such cases exist. The State Secretary answers that individual cases are a municipal matter, that the student loan is a choice rather than a legal obligation, and that the WIJ and WWB rules count shared household income including the living-cost portion of student finance.
Responsibility for individual cases lies with the municipality concerned.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor individuele gevallen ligt bij de betreffende gemeente.
Vragen van het lid Sterk (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over administratieve lasten/handelingen voor burgers (ingezonden 19 april 2011).

MP Sterk (CDA) asked the state secretary whether reducing administrative burdens for citizens with multiple needs is government policy, whether digital applications via Regelhulp are possible for WMO, AWBZ and UWV benefits, and requested the implementation test behind a motion. The government confirmed the policy, described existing Regelhulp connections, and said links to UWV online application forms will be in place by 1 October 2011, though the implementation test was not provided.
Can you, pending your definitive decision before summer on digital applications for UWV provisions via Regelhulp, share this implementation test with the House of Representatives?

Kunt u, in afwachting van uw nog voor de zomer te nemen definitieve besluit over het digitaal aanvragen van voorzieningen van het UWV via Regelhulp, deze uitvoeringstoets aan de Tweede Kamer overleggen?
Vragen het lid De Jong (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht «Bonus voor uitkeringsgerechtigde die baan vindt» (ingezonden 20 april 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether Breda's municipal job-finding bonuses for welfare recipients and employers, which he said commodify benefits and undermine the social safety net, are acceptable. The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for these instruments, that the bonus carries no meaningful misuse risk given the conditions attached, and that individual responsibility remains the starting point.
It is the responsibility of municipalities to implement the WWB/WIJ and to get as many people receiving benefits as possible into regular work.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten om de WWB/WIJ uit te voeren en zoveel mogelijk personen met een uitkering naar regulier werk te laten uitstromen

Vragen van het lid Van den Besselaar (PVV) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat fraude kon doorgaan

An MP asks the government about a reported fraud case where a medical confidentiality duty allegedly let benefit fraud continue, and about tougher action, recovery, and controls. The state secretary says UWV acted on early suspicions, the Public Prosecution Service is examining how medical confidentiality hampers criminal investigations, and the government will decide next steps after that review.
On that basis, together with the Minister of Security and Justice, we will consider which follow-up steps are necessary.
Op basis daarvan zullen wij samen met de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie bezien welke vervolgstappen noodzakelijk zijn.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Huizing (VVD), Vermeij (PvdA), De Jong (PVV), Ulenbelt (SP) en Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Financiën over het oproep

MPs asked the state secretary about employers, including Connexxion as self-insurer, summoning former employees with WGA 35-80% disability for medical reassessments, and about the rights, procedures and re-integration duties involved. The state secretary answered that assessment of incapacity is reserved to the UWV, that self-insuring employers may request reassessment but cannot set the percentage themselves, and that he sees no reason for new rules or talks with Connexxion.
The UWV or the self-insuring employer have the possibility to summon a WGA beneficiary.
Het UWV of de eigenrisicodrager hebben de mogelijkheid om een WGA-gerechtigde op te roepen.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Fritsma en De Jong (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het bericht dat de werkloosheid onder niet-westerse alloch

PVV MPs asked the government about rising unemployment among non-Western immigrants in 2010, including whether immigrants should wait ten years before claiming welfare and whether continued immigration of low-skilled workers worsens the problem. The minister replied that stricter migration and welfare rules are being examined, attributed the unemployment rise to the cyclical and temporary-job structure of the labour market, and cited research indicating that the causes are cumulative factors rather than work ethic.
In line with the coalition agreement, it is being examined to what extent tightening migration policy is possible and what this means for access to our social provisions.
Overeenkomstig het regeerakkoord, wordt bezien in hoeverre aanscherping van het (arbeids)migratiebeleid mogelijk is en wat dit betekent voor de toegang tot onze sociale voorzieningen.
Vragen van het lid Vermeij (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de verenigbaarheid van de WIA met ILO Verdrag 121 (ingezonden 14 maart 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether the WIA disability benefit law complies with ILO Convention 121, including the 35% threshold and the basis for WGA follow-up benefits, and what steps will follow an ILO opinion, and whether the earlier informal ILO request was dropped. The state secretary answers by referring to a separate letter to the House on the ILO's opinion, while saying the committee's opinion is welcome.
For the answer to this question I refer to my letter of today to the House of Representatives on the ILO's opinion.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik naar mijn brief van heden aan de Tweede Kamer over de zienswijze van de ILO.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat de Pantar-busjes blijven rijden (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether Amsterdam is cutting woon-werk transport for Wsw-indicated workers at sheltered workplace Pantar, whether people with a Wsw indication risk dismissal, how many Pantar staff would be dismissed, and whether other sheltered workplaces plan dismissals. The state secretary answered that the choice of transport policy and staffing cuts lies with the municipality of Amsterdam, that the cuts are aimed at no Wsw worker losing their job, that he has no figures on Pantar dismissals, and that he knows of a Rotterdam plan not to renew 212 temporary Wsw contracts.
It is up to the municipality of Amsterdam to choose how it shapes its policy on commuting transport for Wsw employees.
Het is aan de gemeente Amsterdam om een keuze te maken op welke wijze zij haar beleid omtrent woon-werkverkeer van Wsw-werknemers vorm geeft.
Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de hogere instroom in de Wet werk en inkomen naar arbeidsvermogen (WIA) (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether the rise in WIA disability-benefit inflow, its drivers, the revised inflow forecast for 2011 and the resulting budget shortfalls are known and acknowledged. The state secretary confirmed the analysis of causes, noted the forecast rose from 33,000 to 37,500 entrants, and deferred the budget figures to the spring memorandum.
With the spring memorandum, the cabinet will inform the House about the current budgetary problems and solutions for them.
Met de voorjaarsnota zal het kabinet de kamer informeren over de actuele budgettaire problematiek en oplossingen daarvoor.

Vragen van de leden Ulenbelt (SP), Ortega Martijn (ChristenUnie), Klaver (GroenLinks) en Hamer (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over machtsmisbruik, intimidatie en falende leiding bij d

Four MPs asked the state secretary for Social Affairs about alleged abuse of power, intimidation and failed leadership at the sheltered workplace Pauw Bedrijven, including what workers can do and what measures will prevent such abuses. The state secretary answered that this is a matter for the employer, works council, union and local authorities, that an independent investigation has been commissioned, and that no further measures or known signals elsewhere exist.
This concerns a matter for the implementing organisation and the administrators involved.
Dit betreft een kwestie van de uitvoeringsorganisatie en de betrokken bestuurders.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de toegankelijkheid van de schuldhulpverlening (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

An SP MP asks the state secretary whether it is acceptable that Alkmaar deregisters residents from the municipal personal records database (GBA) after six months without giving reasons, thereby stalling debt assistance, and whether debt assistance can continue for people with structurally low income. The state secretary declines to judge individual municipal cases, states that debt assistance is currently not a statutory municipal duty so municipalities may set their own criteria, and says a bill would make it a statutory duty with broad accessibility.
From central government I do not intervene in individual cases concerning the implementation of legislation by municipalities.
Ik treed vanuit het Rijk niet in individuele gevallen rond de uitvoering van wetgeving door gemeenten.
Vragen van het lid Sterk (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht «Het bijstandswonder van Boxmeer» (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether the DPS profiling software used by Boxmeer, which reportedly saved nearly 700,000 euro in welfare spending, reduces fraud-enforcement paperwork and whether it will be rolled out to other municipalities. The state secretary confirms positive early results from small municipalities, explains the four-profile control model, and says DPS is available to all municipalities via the regional fraud coordination point and the 2011-2014 enforcement programme.
DPS is made available by the initiating municipalities and the RCF to all municipalities in the Netherlands.
DPS wordt door de initiatiefnemende gemeenten en RCF ter beschikking gesteld aan alle gemeenten in Nederland.

Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over dreigende bezuinigingen op alle vormen van gesubsidieerde arbeid bi

An MP asked the ministers whether cuts to subsidised work (WIW and ID-banen) would threaten opening hours, security and possible closure of museums and cultural institutions, and how many people such jobs involve. The government said it has no figures by sector, that cuts to these jobs are a municipal responsibility, and that institutions must anticipate municipal measures.
The cabinet does not have information on how many people in subsidised work are employed in museums, theatres and other cultural institutions.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie hoeveel mensen op basis van gesubsidieerde arbeid werkzaam zijn binnen musea, theaters en andere culturele instellingen.

Vragen van de leden De Jong en Van den Besselaar (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretarissen van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat bij een grootschalige actie in d

PVV MPs asked the state secretaries about a report of large-scale benefit fraud arrests and whether fraud amounts with interest will be recovered, whether fraud will be tackled harder, and whether interventie teams should do more controls. The government answered that the damage cannot yet be determined, that fraudulent benefits will be stopped, recovered and fined, that a fraud-tackling plan and a handhavingsprogramma are planned, and that interventieteams will be deployed more targeted.
No, no statements can yet be made about this at this stage of the investigation.
Nee, hierover kunnen in dit stadium van het onderzoek nog geen mededelingen worden gedaan.

Vragen van de leden Hamer en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de voornemens van het kabinet met betrekking tot de sociale werkplaatsen en de Wajong (ingezonden 28

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about the cabinet's plans for sheltered workshops (Wsw) and Wajong, including a single scheme for the bottom of the labour market, budget cuts, municipal finances and quotas for disabled workers. The state secretary said a concrete proposal is still being developed in consultations with municipalities and implementers, promised a policy outline letter, and rejected mandatory employer quotas in favour of incentives.
As soon as possible I will inform the House further.
Zo spoedig als mogelijk zal ik uw Kamer nader informeren.
Vragen van de leden Hamer (PvdA) en Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de terugvordering van Wsw-gelden van gemeenten (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

MPs Hamer and Koşer Kaya asked the state secretary why some municipalities were warned about discrepancies in their Wsw (sheltered employment) accounts and others not, whether the 20% threshold was used, and how the Breda court ruling on the clawback affects recoveries. The state secretary said all accounts were checked, flagged municipalities were given a chance to correct them, clawback applies even when funds were spent as intended, and the ruling does not affect the recovery decisions because the legal basis stands.
I therefore do not know whether Wsw-registered persons working at a sheltered workshop elsewhere are the cause of a common error.
Het is mij derhalve niet bekend of Wsw-geïndiceerden, die bij een werkvoorzieningschap elders werkzaam waren, de oorzaak zijn van een veelvoorkomende fout.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het schrappen van de vervoersvoorziening bij Pantar in Amsterdam (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

Ulenbelt (SP) asked whether Pantar Amsterdam may cut the collective transport arrangement for sheltered-employment workers and whether the state can be held to indicated adaptations, including the 31,000 euro per-worker funding and management bonuses. The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for implementing the Wsw, that the law does not oblige a transport facility, that indicated adaptations are advisory, and that Pantar's management denied paying bonuses.
National funds for the Wsw are provided annually to individual municipalities.
Rijksmiddelen voor de Wsw worden jaarlijks aan individuele gemeenten verstrekt.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht «Eigenrisicodragen voor WGA» (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

MP Omtzigt asked the state secretary about a UWV web text describing WGA employer self-insurance (eigenrisicodrager), reintegration duties, the absence of sanctions and of a process regulation, and the remedies available to beneficiaries. The state secretary answered that employers bear legal reintegration duties regardless of private insurance, that no sanction was chosen but UWV can extend sick pay, and that beneficiaries can object and appeal to the administrative court.
The legislator did not choose a statutory sanction for the self-insuring employer.
De wetgever heeft niet gekozen voor een wettelijke sanctie voor de eigenrisicodrager.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de mogelijkheid van het stellen van eisen bij het toekennen

An SP MP asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and of Economic Affairs whether ESF subsidies to TNT could carry conditions preventing displacement of real jobs by 'pulpbanen' (artificial jobs) at taxpayers' expense, and whether the Commission's concerns about displacement were rejected. The government answered that no additional conditions on displacement were set, that a displacement test would be undesirable and unworkable, and that ESF subsidy requests are not assessed for displacement effects.
No, no further requirements have been set for project applications regarding displacement.
Nee, er zijn geen nadere eisen gesteld aan projectaanvragen inzake verdringing.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de herkeuringen voor mensen met een SW-indicatie (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

MP Ulenbelt (SP) asked whether the coalition agreement pledge that current sheltered-work (WSW) employees will not be re-assessed still holds, given that re-assessments are continuing. The State Secretary confirmed the pledge, saying current WSW employees keep their existing rights and obligations and that re-assessments for this group continue under the existing system.
Yes, I am aware of that.

Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de benadeling van jonggehandicapten die onder de oude regeling vallen ten opzichte van de jonggehandicapten die onder de

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether beneficiaries under the old Wajong scheme are disadvantaged compared with the new scheme, and whether they may choose between schemes. The secretary acknowledged income differences in some bands, said the old-scheme group cannot yet be opened to the new scheme pending monitoring results, and promised a decision after the June 2011 monitor report.

Following the results, a better picture will likely emerge of the effects of the work scheme. On that basis, and taking into account the relevant measures from the coalition agreement, I will decide on opening the work scheme to the other Wajong beneficiaries.

Naar aanleiding van de resultaten zal waarschijnlijk een beter beeld kunnen worden gevormd van de effecten van de werkregeling. Op basis daarvan en rekeninghoudend met de betreffende maatregelen uit het regeerakkoord zal ik een beslissing nemen over de openstelling van de werkregeling voor de overige Wajongers.
Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het ontslag van 31 medewerkers bij de sociale werkvoorziening in Purmerend (ingezonden 24 september 2010).

Karabulut (SP) asked the minister whether dismissing 31 Purmerend employees of a social employment body, after the municipality lost funding for their youth training positions, was a proper implementation of the Wet Investeren in Jongeren, and whether other sheltered-work firms would do the same. The state secretary replied that these posts were a re-integration track funded from the participation budget rather than the Wsw, that the municipality decides how to organise youth provision, and that an efficiency cut to the Wsw budget is necessary.
It is up to the municipality of Purmerend to make a choice in how it offers unemployed young people a learning/work placement.
Het is echter aan de gemeente Purmerend om een keuze te maken in de wijze waarop zij werkloze jongeren een leer/werkaanbod doen.

Vragen van de leden Sterk en Biskop (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de gevolgen van de wijze van bekostiging van het Voor

Christian Democrat MPs asked whether Vavo (adult secondary education) counts as education funded from the national treasury, which under the WIJ would bar young people from a work-learning offer and the related income support, and whether the law is unclear on this. The state secretary replied that Vavo is funded from the Rijkskas and so carries no right to a work-learning offer, and said the ambiguity in implementation will be addressed in an upcoming letter to municipalities.
I intend to pay attention to this in the upcoming collective letter to municipal executives.
Ik ben voornemens om hier aandacht aan te besteden in de eerstkomende Verzamelbrief aan colleges van burgemeester en wethouders.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over grote tekorten en ontslagen bij de sociale werkvoorziening (ingezonden 24 december 2010).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about budget deficits and staff dismissals at sheltered employment (SW) companies caused by 2011 national spending cuts, requesting figures per company and the reasons. The state secretary said the questions on company-level figures and staffing cannot be answered because the choices are left to municipalities and SW companies, and defended the efficiency cut while denying that outward placement is put on hold.
Deze vragen kan ik niet beantwoorden.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Karabulut (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat rekeningen steeds vaker niet betaald word

Two SP MPs asked ministers about reports that household bills are increasingly left unpaid, probing causes, the effect on small firms, household debt stability, and the wage share. The government answered that responsibility lies with debtors and creditors and municipalities, cited research on causes, rejected a link between consumer debt and financial instability, denied a declining labour share, and pointed to municipal debt-relief funding and a pending bill.
Het kabinet zet in op zelfstandigheid.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de toename van het aantal mensen dat in Nederland in armoede leeft (ingezonden 17 december 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary for Social Affairs about rising poverty in the Netherlands, whether targets to halve child social exclusion still stand, whether welfare benefit levels suffice for basic needs, and about volunteer support after 2012. The state secretary said the child low-income rise reflects the 2009 crisis, that benefits are tied to the minimum wage, that no adequacy study will be done, and that municipalities are responsible, with the volunteer projects to be evaluated in 2011.

Vragen van de leden Koşer Kaya (D66) en Hamer (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over terugvordering van Wet Sociale Werkvoorziening (Wsw)-budgetten (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

MPs asked whether municipalities were recovered funds for Wsw sheltered-employment budgets after failing to report Wsw workers employed by other providers, and whether warnings were given and whether administrative errors justify recovery. The state secretary confirmed recoveries from several municipalities for incomplete reporting, said warnings and an extra internal check were applied, and stated that only reporting failures not shown to be non-culpable led to recovery, while clerical errors were not charged.
Recovery only took place in cases where there were errors in the accountability, where the municipalities had not shown that the handling was not culpable.
Terugvordering heeft alleen plaatsgevonden in de gevallen waarbij sprake is van fouten in de verantwoording

Vragen van de leden Koşer Kaya en Van der Ham (beiden D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over terugvordering van Wet werk en bijstand (WWB)budgetten door het ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgel

D66 MPs asked the minister whether the ministry recovered WWB funds from Rotterdam that were spent on ROC contracts for at-risk youth, whether rules have changed since, and whether a rigid rule application should block effective spending. The state secretary confirmed a 25 million euro recovery decision for 2008 spending, explained that the Participatiebudget from 2009 now allows such support under conditions, and declined to say whether the spending is lawful now because no accountant audit has occurred.
Yes, I have taken a decision to recover 25 million from the municipality of Rotterdam.
Ja, ik heb een besluit tot terugvordering van 25 mln. van de gemeente Rotterdam genomen.
Vragen van het lid Vermeij (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de arbeidsomstandigheden in slachterijen (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary about poor working conditions and safety in slaughterhouses, including whether higher fines or inspection intensity would help. The government acknowledged compliance has improved but remains insufficient, pointed to the Labour Inspectorate's sector-focused enforcement and work stoppages, and relied mainly on social partners' codes and a broader safety action plan.
Compared with the previous inspection project four years ago, compliance has improved. However, the level of compliance is not yet sufficient.
Ten opzichte van het vorige inspectieproject vier jaar geleden is de naleving verbeterd. Het nalevingsniveau is echter nog niet voldoende.

Vragen van het lid de Jong (PVV) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat de gemeente Utrecht de scriptie «Een evaluatie van de Wet Investeren in Jongeren (WIJ) bij het jongerenloket in U

An MP asked the minister whether Utrecht municipality suppressed a thesis evaluating the WIJ youth employment law's youth desk as chaotic, and whether criminal youths and wasted public money resulted. The state secretary replied that the report was wrongly described, that municipalities are responsible for WIJ implementation, that the council has the oversight role, and that an evaluation of the WIJ will be sent to parliament before 1 October 2011.
Municipalities are responsible for the quality of the implementation of the WIJ.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van de uitvoering van de WIJ.

Vragen van de leden Karabulut en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over gemeenten die vanwege rijksbezuinigingen het

SP MPs asked whether it is desirable that municipalities may cut collective health insurance for low-income people due to national budget cuts, and asked about premium increases, numbers affected, and the burden on those on low incomes. The state secretary replied that municipal collective insurance is a local responsibility under the WWB and Zorgverzekeringswet, that exact national figures are not held, that no sharp changes were expected by 1 January 2011, and that individuals can still claim special assistance.

The choice whether to offer a collective (supplementary) health insurance within municipal minimum policy, and the considerations involved, is a responsibility that lies not with central government but with local government.

De keuze om bij de inrichting van het gemeentelijk minimabeleid al dan niet een collectieve (aanvullende) zorgverzekering aan te bieden en de afwegingen die voor de gemeente daar een rol bij spelen, is een verantwoordelijkheid die niet bij het rijk maar bij het lokale bestuur ligt.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het niet naleven van de vrijstelling van de sollicitatieplicht voor alleenstaande ouders met kinderen tot

An MP asked the state secretary why municipalities reject exemptions from the job-seeking obligation for single parents with children under five, despite the statutory right created in 2009, and whether the government will sanction them or ensure information and evaluation. The state secretary replied that municipalities have discretion in implementing the exemption and reintegration, that individual exemptions are granted on general grounds, that the government intends to abolish the specific exemption, and that no measures against municipalities or evaluation are planned.
Municipalities state as their reason that granting exemptions on this ground also suffices for single parents with children under five.
Gemeenten geven hierbij als reden aan dat ontheffen op deze grond ook voor alleenstaande ouders met kinderen jonger dan vijf jaar volstaat.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat vier op de tien jongeren onder de 24 jaar moeilijk aan de bak komen (ingezonden 1 november 2010).

Klaver asked the minister whether the Manpower report showing four in ten under-24s struggle to find work reflects a failure of the youth unemployment action plan and whether the plan should be changed. The state secretary rejected the four-in-ten claim as not supported by data, cited falling youth unemployment and plan results, and said the plan would not be adjusted before its 2011 end.
The conclusion that four in ten young people have difficulty finding work is not recognised.
De conclusie dat vier op de tien jongeren moeilijk aan de bak komt, wordt niet herkend.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de staatsecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over ontevredenheid van bedrijfsartsen (ingezonden 27 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a survey showing dissatisfaction among occupational physicians, including whether professional integrity can be guaranteed in a commercial setting. The state secretary said a joint ministry study is ongoing, due by summer 2011, and that integrity requires effort from practitioners, employers and professional bodies.
The study will be completed before summer 2011.
Het onderzoek wordt voor de zomer van 2011 afgerond.
Vragen van de leden Spekman en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de arbeidsomstandigheden van arboartsen (ingezonden 28 oktober 2010).

PvdA MPs Spekman and Vermeij asked the state secretary about working conditions of occupational physicians, citing reports of work pressure and conflicts with ethics and independence. The state secretary answered that a joint study with VWS is underway, results expected by summer 2011, that employers are responsible for occupational health provision, and that the government will await the study before acting.
The cabinet is awaiting the results of the study into the position of the occupational physician, as mentioned in the answer to question 2.
Het kabinet wacht de resultaten van het onderzoek naar de positie van de bedrijfsarts, zoals genoemd in antwoord op vraag 2, af.
Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de stijging van het aantal armen in Amsterdam (ingezonden 27 oktober 2010).

The MP asks whether the rise to about 70,000 Amsterdam households at or near minimum income is acceptable, whether poverty is also growing nationally, what measures will fight it, and whether planned cuts hitting low-income groups will be dropped. The state secretary says the 2009 rise is a crisis effect and that municipalities are responsible for minimum policy, and that the government will pursue participation and self-reliance while sanitising public finances without withdrawing the proposed cuts.
The judgment on the poverty policy of the municipality of Amsterdam and its implementation is primarily for the Amsterdam municipal council.
Het oordeel over het armoedebeleid van de gemeente Amsterdam en de uitvoering daarvan is primair aan de gemeenteraad van Amsterdam.

Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de reiskostenvergoedingen verstrekt door het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemers Verzekeringen (UWV) (ingezonden 29 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asked whether UWV stopped reimbursing travel costs under 15 km for people without medical limitations from 1 October 2010, why, how much it saves, what alternatives were considered, and whether the minister will reverse it. The state secretary confirmed the harmonised 15 km threshold, explaining it aims at uniform rules across UWV, with only a modest side saving, and that the LCR and VNG were consulted.
Under the new scheme, clients only qualify for travel cost reimbursement if the one-way distance is fifteen kilometres or more.
In de nieuwe regeling komen klanten alleen nog voor vergoeding van reiskosten in aanmerking, indien de enkele reisafstand vijftien kilometer of meer bedraagt.
Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de kwaliteit van schuldhulpverlening in gemeenten (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An MP asked whether municipal debt assistance is failing individuals, how many municipalities have capacity problems, and whether the government will inventory and publish problem cases. The state secretary answered that no national picture exists, that municipalities are responsible for quality, that examining individual municipalities does not fit the division of responsibilities, and pointed to a pending bill setting a minimum quality floor.
Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het aantal kinderen dat in armoede opgroeit (ingezonden 11 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether 385,000 children (11%) grow up in poverty according to CBS figures, why the government's child-poverty targets are not being met, and how planned cuts to child-related benefits, welfare and income support fit with those targets. The state secretary said the CBS figure measures a 120%-of-minimum-income threshold rather than poverty itself, that the SCP participation measure is still being monitored with results due in early 2011, and that cuts are necessary while work participation of parents is the main policy lever.
Your House will be informed about this as agreed.
Uw Kamer zal daar volgens afspraak over worden geïnformeerd.

Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over korting op het arbeidsloon bij een re-integratiebedrijf vanwege een dienstverband elders (ingezonden 11 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a construction where welfare recipients under the WWB are employed by a reintegration firm on a 'wages for benefits' basis, with the benefit ended and extra outside income deducted from pay, raising questions on minimum wage, pension and leave rights, legality, and use of public reintegration funds. The state secretary answered that individual municipal decisions fall outside his role, that employers must pay minimum wage pro rata, that such offsetting is a contractual matter for the courts, and that municipalities are responsible for reintegration instrument choices, citing evidence that regular contracts yield better outflow to work.
Under the Work and Assistance Act (WWB) I do not intervene in the decision-making in individual cases.
Op grond van de Wet werk en bijstand (WWB) treed ik niet in de besluitvorming van individuele gevallen.

m: Motie Sharpe over prioriteit geven aan de file top 50
Asks the government to give priority to the top-50 traffic jam locations within the MIRT infrastructure programme.
requests the government to give the top-50 traffic jams priority within the MIRT
verzoekt de regering de file top-50 prioriteit te geven binnen het MIRT
Motie De Rouwe c.s. over een permanent karakter van de Crisis- en herstelwet
Asks the government to investigate whether the Crisis- en herstelwet, which speeds up project permitting, or parts of it should become permanent.
to investigate whether the Crisis and Recovery Act or relevant parts of it could be given a permanent character
te onderzoeken of de Crisis- en herstelwet of relevante onderdelen daaruit een permanent karakter zouden kunnen krijgen
Motie Neppérus c.s. over vasthouden aan de afspraken uit het MIRT-projectenboek
Asks the demissionary cabinet to keep to the agreements in the MIRT project book and continue the chosen course.
requests the government to hold firmly to the agreements made and continue on the chosen course
verzoekt de regering onverkort vast te houden aan de gemaakte afspraken en op de ingeslagen weg voort te gaan
qa: Vragen van het lid Sharpe (PVV) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Iedereen kan OV-chipkaart kraken» (ingezonden 11 november 2010).

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether the OV-chipkaart's security is adequate, whether TLS should be subjected to an independent performance evaluation, and whether TLS executive salaries should be cut. The minister answered that fraud is rare, that TLS monitors and blocks manipulated cards, that a new card generation is being rolled out, and that the ministry cannot intervene directly in the private company TLS.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment has no possibility to intervene directly with TLS because TLS is a private company.
Overigens heeft het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu geen mogelijkheden om rechtstreeks bij TLS in te grijpen omdat TLS een private onderneming is.
Vragen van het lid Sharpe (PVV) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «KLM overhoop met Schiphol» (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether Schiphol's planned steep increase in charges for transfer passengers would reduce the airlines using it as a hub, and whether the government would act against it. The state secretary replied that Schiphol will raise charges only modestly from April 2011 and postpone the structural tariff change by six months to study its effects, while the EU-related bill concerns non-discrimination principles rather than tariff levels and the government would take no action beyond referring to that answer.
Reference is made to the answer to question 2.
Verwezen wordt naar het antwoord op vraag 2.

Vragen van de leden De Rouwe (CDA), Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD), Samsom (PvdA) en Sharpe (PVV) aan de minister van Financiën over mogelijke significante verhoging transfertarieven (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

MPs from CDA, VVD, PvdA and PVV asked the Finance Minister about a possible significant rise in Schiphol transfer tariffs and whether this breached earlier commitments to freeze tariffs. The minister, as shareholder, answered that the limited tariff increase is consistent with Schiphol's commitments, deferred questions on network quality to the state secretary, and said he has no formal control over tariffs or the consultation process.
As a shareholder, I do not decide on Schiphol's tariffs.
Als aandeelhouder ga ik niet over de tarieven van Schiphol.
Vragen van het lid Sharpe (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over vermeende corruptie bij de FIFA (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary of health, welfare and sport about alleged corruption in the FIFA bidding committee for the 2018 and 2022 World Cups, including whether Dutch-Belgian bid contacts were approached improperly and whether the government still trusts the Dutch bid. The minister confirms awareness of the reports, says no improper proposals were received during the delegation's visit, expects FIFA to resolve the matter, and declines to draw conclusions or contact FIFA before the December 2010 vote.
I assume that FIFA will get to the bottom of this matter and ensure that the elections for awarding the 2018 and 2022 World Cups are conducted with integrity.
Ik ga er van uit dat de FIFA deze zaak tot op de bodem uitzoekt en er voor zorgt dat de verkiezingen voor de toewijzing van het WK 2018 en 2022 integer verlopen.
Vragen van de leden De Mos en Sharpe (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over gevolgen van de zandmotor voor de Delflandse kust (ingezonden 17 september 2010).

PVV MPs De Mos and Sharpe asked the minister of Transport and Water Management whether the Zandmotor pilot should be halted over uncertain effects on currents, rip formation, drowning risk, munitions and sea-level rise. The minister rejected halting the project, citing active monitoring, safety measures and the need for innovative, cost-efficient coastal defence.
Also during and after the construction of the Zandmotor, effects are monitored daily.
Ook tijdens en na de aanleg van de Zandmotor worden effecten dagelijks gemonitord.
Vragen van lid Sharpe (PVV) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de structurele fileproblematiek rondom Amsterdam (ingezonden 6 juli 2010).

MP Sharpe asked the minister of Transport and Water Management about structural traffic congestion around Amsterdam, including whether the Filetop 50 should be prioritised under MIRT as requested by a motion. The minister disputed that the situation is 'schrijnend', listed six Amsterdam bottleneck projects already in progress and pointed to the MIRT projectenboek 2010 for planning and delivery dates.
These projects are described in detail in the MIRT projectenboek 2010, including the delivery schedule.
Deze projecten staan uitvoerig beschreven in het MIRT projectenboek 2010, inclusief planning van de oplevering.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Fritsma en Sharpe (allen PVV) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over islamisering van het Haagse amateurvoetbal (ingezonden 9 jul

PVV MPs asked ministers whether a Hague amateur football club receives subsidy and whether reports of an 'Islamisation' coup there (no karbonaadjes, alcohol labels removed, women volunteers not invited) show a failure of Moroccan integration. The government answered that there is no current subsidy relation, that the club disputes the reports, and that the matter is a local responsibility with no integration problem found.
On the basis of the information obtained, I establish that there is no question of a coup or an integration problem here.
Op basis van de verkregen informatie stel ik vast dat hier geen sprake is van een coup dan wel een integratieprobleem.

Motion asks the government to abolish the Natura 2000 policy so that the Crisis and Recovery Act can operate fully.
requests the government to abolish the Natura 2000 policy so that the Crisis and Recovery Act fully takes effect
verzoekt de regering, om het Natura 2000-beleid te schrappen, zodat de Crisis- en herstelwet optimaal tot zijn recht komt

Removes wind energy projects from the accelerated procedure of the Crisis- and recovery act, so permits for wind farms follow the regular procedure with its normal review and appeal.
With this amendment it is arranged that the accelerated procedure of the Crisis and Recovery Act no longer applies to decisions that are required under any statutory provision
Met dit amendement wordt geregeld dat de versnelde procedure van de Crisis- en herstelwet niet langer van toepassing is op besluiten die krachtens enig wettelijk voorschrift zijn vereist
Amendement van het lid Van Bemmel over het buiten toepassing verklaren van de versnelde procedure van de Crisis-en herstelwet bij de aanleg of uitbreiding van productie-installaties voor de opwekking
Removes the accelerated Crisis- and Recovery Act procedure for permits for wind energy production installations, restoring standard procedures and review rights.

Met dit amendement wordt geregeld dat de versnelde procedure van de Crisis- en herstelwet niet langer van toepassing is op besluiten die krachtens enig wettelijk voorschrift zijn vereist
Amendement van de leden Houwers en Van Bemmel over het uitbreiden van de werking van het wetsvoorsetl naar alle bedrijfswoningen

This amendment provides that the application of this bill is extended to all company dwellings
Dit amendement regelt dat de toepassing van dit wetsvoorstel wordt uitgebreid naar alle bedrijfswoningen
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Bemmel ter vervanging van nr. 45 over de opname van milieuvoorwaarden in een algemene maatregel van bestuur
Allows general administrative orders to set environmental conditions for public procurement, with a four-week wait before submission to parliament.
By general administrative order, rules may be laid down on the application of conditions relating to environmental considerations.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen regels worden gesteld met betrekking tot de toepassing van voorwaarden die verband houden met milieuoverwegingen.

Asks the government to report to the House before the summer recess 2012 on how more targeted and professional procurement could yield public savings.
to report to the House before the 2012 summer recess how substantial public savings can be achieved through more targeted policy and more professional procurement
de Kamer voor het zomerreces van 2012 te rapporteren hoe via gerichter beleid en een meer professionele inkoop substantiële overheidsbesparingen in Nederland gerealiseerd kunnen worden

Replaces an earlier amendment to remove or limit turnover requirements in public tenders, allowing turnover thresholds only with strong justification and capping them at three times the contract value.
With this amendment the submitters remove the turnover requirement as far as possible.
Met dit amendement schrapt de indiener de omzeteis zoveel mogelijk.
Motie Ziengs/ Van Bemmel over een richtpercentage voor aanbestedingen
Asks the government to have (decentralised) authorities set a target that at least 30% of procurement goes to SMEs, with comply-or-explain.
requests the government to ensure that (decentralised) authorities, when drafting their procurement policy, state a target under which at least 30% of procurements must be awarded to SMEs

verzoekt de regering ervoor te zorgen dat (decentrale) overheden bij het opstellen van hun aanbestedingsbeleid een richtpercentage aangeven waarbij minimaal 30% van de aanbestedingen aan het mkb moet worden gegund

Asks the government to ensure that model contract terms for public tenders are drafted using the Proportionality Guide and developed with business to avoid disproportionate risk shifting.
requests the government to ensure that the contract terms to be drawn up are also drafted using the Proportionality Guide
verzoekt de regering ervoor te zorgen dat de op te stellen contractvoorwaarden ook worden opgesteld aan de hand van de Gids Proportionaliteit
Amendement van het lid Van Bemmel over het schrappen van de omzeteis
Amendment removing or capping turnover requirements in public tender suitability criteria.
With this amendment the submitter removes the turnover requirement as far as possible.
Met dit amendement schrapt de indiener de omzeteis zoveel mogelijk.
