Motie van het lid Daniëlle Jansen c.s. over het zo snel mogelijk verbieden van wegwerp-e-sigaretten
Asks the government to ban disposable e-cigarettes as quickly as possible, following Belgium, because of health harms and littering.
requests the government, following Belgium, to ban disposable e-cigarettes as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering om – in navolging van België – zo snel mogelijk wegwerp-e-sigaretten te verbieden
Motie van het lid Slagt-Tichelman c.s. over een kasschuif toepassen om de bezuiniging op het scheiden van wonen en zorg terug te draaien
Asks the government to reverse the budget cut on separating housing and care by using a cash-shift to fund more nursing home places.
requests the government to reverse at the Spring Memorandum the saving linked to separating housing and care
verzoekt de regering om bij de Voorjaarsnota de bezuiniging die samenhangt met het scheiden van wonen en zorg en de huisvestingtarieven terug te draaien
Motie van het lid Slagt-Tichelman c.s. over onderzoek naar een bekostingingsaanpassing om de specialist ouderengeneeskunde als regiebehandelaar mogelijk te maken
Asks the government to commission research into funding changes enabling specialists in geriatric medicine to act as care coordinators for elderly patients outside nursing homes.
requests the government to have research carried out into how adjustments in funding can contribute
verzoekt de regering onderzoek uit te laten voeren naar de wijze waarop aanpassingen in de bekostiging kunnen bijdragen
Motie van het lid Bikker c.s. over stoppen met het eisen van een mantelzorgverklaring
Asks the government to talk with municipalities to stop requiring caregiver declarations (mantelzorgverklaring) and trust informal carers instead.
requests the government to talk with municipalities to stop demanding a caregiver declaration
verzoekt de regering om het gesprek te voeren met gemeenten om te stoppen met het eisen van een mantelzorgverklaring

Motie van de leden Paulusma en Slagt-Tichelman over de subsidieregeling voor pg-organisaties zo wijzigen dat zij zich onthouden van activiteiten die de toegang tot de zorg voor bepaalde groepen bemoei

Asks the government to study whether subsidy rules for patient and disability organisations can be changed so they refrain from activities aimed at restricting access to care for LGBTIQ+ people and women.
requests the cabinet to investigate whether and how the subsidy scheme for patient organisations can be changed
verzoekt het kabinet om te onderzoeken of en zo ja, hoe de subsidieregeling voor pg-organisaties kan worden gewijzigd
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Westerveld over het voorkomen van massadonatie

MPs Slagt-Tichelman and Westerveld asked the State Secretary for Health about 'mass donation' of sperm, a clinic apparently circumventing donor registration, the adequacy of the law, a European register, and remedies for donor children. The State Secretary answered that the 2025 law caps donor sperm at 12 women via a central Dutch register, that cross-border and private-sphere donations remain outside its reach, and that further measures are being explored with a letter promised in Q1 2026.
I am in discussions with various parties about the possibilities and desirability of taking further measures against the use of donor sperm that is used internationally for more than 12 women.

Ik ben in gesprek met verschillende betrokken partijen over de mogelijkheden en wenselijkheid om nadere maatregelen te treffen tegen het gebruik van donorzaad dat in internationaal verband bij meer dan 12 vrouwen wordt ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Slagt-Tichelman en Gabriëls over het bericht dat gemeenten een landelijke aanpak voor bestrijdingsmiddelen willen

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the minister about municipalities' calls for a national approach to pesticides in bulb cultivation, including a statutory spray-free zone and national rules, and about the government's health-in-all-policies approach. The minister answered that a legal framework already exists for municipalities to act locally, that a study on spray-zone width is under way, that the sector is reducing pesticide use voluntarily, and that no national statutory spray-free zone will be introduced.
I agree with the municipality of Midden-Drenthe that this issue is complex, and I endorse the importance of mutual trust and open communication between farmers and residents.
Ik ben het eens met de gemeente Midden-Drenthe dat dit vraagstuk complex is, en onderschrijf het belang van onderling vertrouwen en open communicatie tussen agrariërs en omwonenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Bushoff en Slagt- Tichelman over het bericht dat gemeenten zorgondernemers nauwelijks op criminaliteit toetsen

MPs Westerveld, Bushoff and Slagt-Tichelman asked the state secretary about reports that municipalities rarely screen care providers for criminal links under the Bibob Act, and about the size of care fraud and measures taken. The state secretary acknowledged limited use of Bibob by municipalities, said the size of fraud cannot be reliably estimated, pointed to pilot projects and a DUS-I review due end 2025, and promised a progress update this autumn.
Yes, I recognise the picture that municipalities to date make limited use of the possibilities offered by the Bibob Act to screen care providers.

Ja, ik herken het beeld dat gemeenten tot op heden beperkt gebruik maken van de mogelijkheden die de Wet Bevordering integriteitsbeoordelingen door het openbaar bestuur (Wet Bibob) biedt om zorgaanbieders te toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht 'Alleen garantie op gescheurde borstimplantaten als je ze laat vervangen

MPs Tielen and Slagt-Tichelman asked the minister about reports that breast implant manufacturers' warranties only cover torn implants if the patient gets replacements, and whether this misleads patients and whether oversight is adequate. The minister said such contract terms are for the civil courts to judge, noted removal may be covered by the basic health package when medically necessary, reported very few complaints, and said she is reviewing the reporting structure for implant complaints.
Ultimately it is for the civil judge (on the claim of the injured party) to decide.
Dat is uiteindelijk aan de civiele rechter (op vordering van de benadeelde).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht 'Aantal gevallen van mazelen blijft oplopen: nu al meer dan heel vorig jaar'

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the state secretary about rising measles cases, a cluster in Amsterdam, a school outbreak in Helmond, vaccination coverage, traveller information and vaccine procurement. The state secretary answered that municipal and GGD responsibilities are primary, that outreach to low-coverage neighbourhoods will be intensified via a pilot, and that existing travel and worker information is already available, committing to some further communication and a future evaluation of funding.
I am willing to bring this information further to the attention of the employers' associations.
Ik ben bereid om deze informatie extra onder de aandacht te brengen bij de werkgeversverenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht 'Belangrijke wetswijzigingen voor donorkinderen: is dit hoe we massadonatie kunnen voorkomen?'

MPs asked the state secretary about reported exceedances of the limit on children per sperm donor and the communication about them, and why donor children were not informed directly. The government answered that 85 donors had more than 25 offspring, that clinics and the Cdkb are responsible for communication, that BRP authorisation is being pursued, and that monitoring will run via the Cdkb annual report.
The Cdkb only registers the data of the donors and the treated women.
Het Cdkb registreert alleen de gegevens van de donoren en de behandelde vrouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Westerveld over het bericht 'Ruim honderd vrouwen met spiraaltje van Ballerine tóch zwanger, gros klachten niet gemeld bij inspectie'

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the health minister about reports that over a hundred women with a Ballerine IUD became pregnant and that most complaints were not reported to the inspectorate, asking about information, certification, reporting and oversight. The minister answered that the EU certification system functioned adequately, that the 2021 IGJ review found no need for further action, and that she will explore a clearer reporting structure for users and providers.

I want to look into how I can arrive at as clear a reporting structure as possible for users and healthcare providers, so that they always know where to go for complaints and side effects of medical devices.

Ik wil kijken hoe ik tot een zo helder mogelijke meldstructuur kan komen voor gebruikers en zorgverleners, zodat zij altijd weten waar zij terecht kunnen voor klachten en bijwerkingen bij medische hulpmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht 'Veerle (27) wil nooit meer een spiraaltje zonder verdoving: ‘Deze pijn is het niet waard’'

An MP asks the health minister and state secretary about reports that women experience severe pain when a coil is inserted without anaesthesia, and about options such as cervical spray, guidance and information. The government says it is aware of the concerns, refers pain management decisions to clinicians, notes NHG guideline revision and existing information channels, and declines to take further concrete steps beyond what it already committed to.
At the same time, the Minister of VWS is not responsible for how healthcare providers deliver care, insofar as medical-substantive considerations are concerned.
Tegelijkertijd gaat de Minister van VWS niet over de manier waarop zorgverleners zorg verlenen, voor zover het medisch-inhoudelijke overwegingen betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Dijk en Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht ‘Zorgverzekeraars vinden thuis sterven vaak te duur’

MPs from four parties asked the state secretary for health about reports that insurers refuse to pay for home-based terminal palliative care because of budget caps, and about causes, insurer practices, and remedies. The state secretary disputes the specific case, says insurers report no such refusals, and points to agreements in the Aanvullend Zorg- en Welzijnsakkoord and the palliative care programme as the way forward.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht dat de genderpoli van het Amsterdam UMC voorlopig geen nieuwe volwassenen in behandeling neemt vanwege overbelasting

MPs Westerveld and Slagt-Tichelman asked about reports that the Amsterdam UMC gender clinic stopped inviting new adult patients for intake due to overload, the long waiting times, staff shortages, the state's efforts to address them, and whether patients are being pushed abroad in breach of the duty of care. The minister confirms the pause for adults, says waiting times cannot be predicted, points to a coordinating platform, extra funding for mental health care and the duty of insurers, and says the revised quality standard is due in September 2025.
It is not possible to say anything about the overall duration of the waiting time.
Het is niet mogelijk om een uitspraak te doen over de algehele duur van de wachttijd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over het NZa-rapport 'Tussen Wal en Voordeur'

MPs Slagt-Tichelman asked whether the government leaves choices on home care for the elderly to health insurers' care offices (zorgkantoren) rather than making future-proof decisions, and how it responds to NZa recommendations on the Wlz and the NZa report 'Tussen Wal en Voordeur'. The minister answers that the government is working on housing and care for older people, a Hoofdlijnenakkoord ouderenzorg and a study on returning verzorgingshuizen, agrees with the NZa conclusions while assigning zorgkantoren the task of concrete follow-up, and says the Wlz-related questions will be addressed in the Hoofdlijnenakkoord process without committing to specific legal changes yet.
We are therefore in discussion with parties, including the NZa, about a Hoofdlijnenakkoord ouderenzorg (HLO).
We zijn daarom met partijen, waaronder de NZa, in gesprek over een Hoofdlijnenakkoord ouderenzorg (HLO).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Diederik van Dijk, Van den Hil, Krul, Ceder, Rikkers-Oosterkamp, Slagt-Tichelman, Kostić en Eerdmans over een solide toekomstplan voor Kamp Westerbork naar aanleiding van 80 jaar

MPs asked the government to respond to Kamp Westerbork memorial's financial shortfalls, deferred maintenance and the need for a sustainable future plan, and to say what it will do about the memorial's proposed plan and the Moluccan history. The state secretary answers that a solid future plan will be developed with the memorial centres, one-off 2025 funds have been reserved, the memorial's financing plan is under study, and an OHW letter on progress is expected around summer 2025.
I am studying this plan and looking at what role the central government can play in it.
Ik ben dit plan aan het bestuderen en bekijken welke rol de Rijksoverheid daarin kan spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over het rapport van de Raad Volksgezondheid en Samenleving ‘Gezond in de Bonus, via supermarkten betere voeding stimuleren’

MP Slagt-Tichelman asked the State Secretary for Health about the RVS report proposing a legally anchored bonus-malus system to reward supermarkets for selling healthier food. The State Secretary acknowledged the public health problem and the supermarkets' role, but preferred negotiated agreements and monitoring first, citing legal and regulatory hurdles to a bonus-malus scheme and promising a broader prevention strategy.
I first focus on concrete agreements with supermarkets and annually monitoring their progress.
Ik zet allereerst in op concrete afspraken met de supermarkten en het jaarlijks monitoren van de voortgang hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Piri over zorg voor zwangere vrouwen en baby’s in aanmeldcentrum en AZC’s

MPs Slagt-Tichelman and Piri asked the ministers about maternity care for pregnant asylum seekers in reception centres, citing the EGALITE report on higher stillbirth and birth complications, and asked about relocations, interpreters, hygiene, privacy and the status of the Ketenrichtlijn. The minister acknowledges the problems, points to the Musselkanaal wing, the strain on reception capacity and planned action (raising the guideline with professional bodies, reviewing the EGALITE recommendations), but declines to change birth registration rules and does not commit to new binding standards.
I will therefore ask the professional organisations in maternity care to bring the chain guideline again to the attention of their members.
Ik zal de beroepsorganisaties in de geboortezorg daarom verzoeken om de ketenrichtlijn opnieuw onder de aandacht te brengen bij hun achterban.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Slagt- Tichelman over de financiering van de bevrijdingsfestivals

MPs Mohandis and Slagt-Tichelman asked whether the government will keep financially supporting the Dutch liberation festivals, which are at risk, and about the status of a broad future vision for 5 May. State Secretary Karremans answers that the national committee receives structural funding, that one-off direct aid was given in 2024 and no structural state guarantee is provided, and that talks with other ministries on a final one-off contribution are ongoing.
I have at least reserved budgetary space for a one-off contribution from VWS in 2025.
Ik heb in ieder geval budgettaire ruimte gereserveerd voor een incidentele bijdrage vanuit VWS in 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over de SuperlijstGezondheid2024 en het bericht dat 64 procent van de volwassenen overgewicht heeft in 2050

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about the SuperlijstGezondheid2024 report showing supermarkets promoting alcohol and unhealthy products, and about RIVM projections of 64 percent adult overweight by 2050, questioning preventive policy, budget cuts and enforcement. The State Secretary acknowledges the problem, promises a preventive strategy, a monitor, and legislation restricting child-directed unhealthy marketing, while relying mainly on voluntary agreements for now.
I am therefore working, among other things, on legislation to restrict child-directed marketing of unhealthy products.
Ik werk daarom onder andere aan wetgeving om kindermarketing op ongezonde producten in te perken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden White, Gabriëls en Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht ‘Bewoners Bonaire geëvacueerd na grote brand bij de vuilstort’

MPs White, Gabriëls and Slagt-Tichelman asked about a large fire at the Selibon waste dump on Bonaire, its health and environmental effects, and the permit and oversight failures at the site. The government answered that the underground fire is not yet controlled, that the acting Kingdom Representative has taken over permitting and enforcement from the island authority due to neglect of duty, and that a waste plan and asbestos and biomedical waste measures are being prepared.

This led to a decision by the acting Kingdom Representative (on 15 November 2024) to step in for the island executive and make a number of decisions on permitting, supervision and enforcement at Selibon/Lagun.

Dit heeft geleid tot een besluit van de waarnemend Rijksvertegenwoordiger (op 15 november 2024) om indeplaats te treden van het bestuurscollege en daarmee te voorzien in een aantal beslissingen op het gebied van vergunningverlening, toezicht-, en handhaving (VTH) bij Selibon/Lagun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Slagt-Tichelman over wachtlijsten voor genderzorg

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about waiting lists for gender care after the Mutsaersstichting restricted its gender care to Limburg, and whether budget cuts and service gaps would be addressed. The state secretary answered that gemeenten are responsible for youth gender care, national waiting-time data are not kept, the Mutsaersstichting has a continuity plan with added municipal and subsidy funding, and a Landelijk Platform Transgenderzorg is being set up with a work agenda expected in early 2025.
Municipalities are responsible for organising youth care, including gender care. Figures on the number of waiting lists and average waiting times are therefore not kept nationally.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het organiseren van jeugdhulp, dus ook genderzorg. Cijfers over aantallen wachttijden en gemiddelde wachttijden worden daarom niet landelijk bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over smartvapes

MP Slagt-Tichelman asks the state secretary about smartvapes, enforcement against illegal vapes, and cuts to Trimbos Institute, prevention programmes and addiction-related funding. The state secretary acknowledges the problem, promises €3 million structural extra NVWA enforcement from 2026 and an action plan on vaping in spring 2025, but defends the budget cuts as manageable and declines to fund separate guest lessons.
From 2026 I will therefore structurally make an additional 3 million euros available for NVWA enforcement.
Vanaf 2026 stel ik dan ook structureel 3 miljoen euro extra beschikbaar voor de handhaving van de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over de zin en onzin van de Nutri-Score

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about the Nutri-Score: whether it helps curb overweight, whether category-based comparison misleads, why manufacturers are dropping it, and whether it should be mandatory. The State Secretary defends the voluntary logo, promises monitoring, communication and product-improvement measures, and says mandatory rules are being examined under EU law.
I am willing to use legal measures where necessary.
Ik ben bereid indien nodig wettelijke maatregelen in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en het lid Westerveld over genderzorg voor jeugd

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about the threatened disappearance of gender care for under-18s in Noord-Brabant after BuroJIJ's possible exit, and about waiting lists and measures. The government acknowledged shortages of specialist youth care, pointed to the bill on availability of youth care and the Aanpak Wachttijden, said no current national waiting-list or wait-time data exist, and promised a Landelijk Platform Transgenderzorg and further work on protocols.
For (specialist) gender care for under-18s, no current figures are known on the number of people waiting or average waiting times.
Voor (specialistische) genderzorg voor jeugdigen onder 18 jaar zijn geen actuele cijfers bekend van aantallen wachtenden en gemiddelde wachttijden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman, Westerveld, Paulusma, Krul, Dijk, Dobbe, Bikker, El Abassi, Kostić, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de Nota van Wijziging op de Ontwerpbegroting van het Ministerie van

MPs from multiple parties asked the health ministry, in a set of written questions on the 2025 budget amendment, about cuts to the Stagefonds Zorg, borstprothesen subsidy, SOV care for the uninsured, Veelbelovende zorg, sports funding and the generic staff cut. The minister's answers defend the cuts as efficient or minimal in impact, give partial figures, and state that several effects are still being examined.
It is not known for how many unique patients the subsidy scheme for medically necessary care for the uninsured (SOV) is used.
Het is niet bekend voor hoeveel unieke patiënten gebruik wordt gemaakt van de subsidieregeling medisch noodzakelijke zorg aan onverzekerden (SOV).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Bushoff over de stand van zaken omtrent seksuele gezondheid in Nederland

MPs Slagt-Tichelman and Bushoff asked about the state of sexual health in the Netherlands, including falling condom and pill use, rising STIs, access to STI testing and PrEP, HPV vaccination, and sexual misconduct prevention. State Secretary Karremans answered largely by describing existing and planned measures, committing to a study of condom-promoting interventions and a review of the ASG subsidy, while declining to commit to reinstating Vrij Veilig campaigns yet.
I aim to inform the House early next year about the steps I will take to revise the system.
Ik streef ernaar om uw Kamer begin volgend jaar te informeren over de stappen die ik ga zetten om te komen tot een herziening van het stelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over de Netflixserie 'The man with a 1000 kids'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the Netflix series on a sperm donor with many offspring, including donor limits, registers, international sperm banks, information for parents, consanguinity risks, and reimbursement of anonymous-donor treatment abroad. The government answered that a 12-family cap per donor via Dutch clinics takes effect in 2025, opposed a private-donor register, referred parents to information sites, and said it will report to parliament in 2025 on limiting reimbursement for anonymous-gamete treatment abroad.

Therefore, with the amendment of the Donor Data Artificial Insemination Act (Wdkb) entering into force on 1 January 2025, it will be ensured that it is not possible through a Dutch clinic to conceive children with one donor's sperma with more than 12 women.

Daarom zal met de wijziging van de Wet Donorgegevens Kunstmatige Bevruchting (Wdkb) die per 1 januari 2025 in werking treedt, worden geborgd dat het niet mogelijk is via een Nederlandse kliniek bij meer dan 12 vrouwen kinderen te verwekken met het sperma van één donor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht ‘Zorginnovaties sneuvelen door financieringsregels'

An MP asks whether effective digital health apps such as Vertigo Training and URinControl should be freely available and how structural implementation barriers are addressed. The minister points to the Digizo.nu programme and IZA agreements for scaling up digital care, says reimbursement issues are assessed case by case, and commits to discussing the signal about advice from Zorgvoorinnoveren with that body.
I do not have the necessary information for that.
Ik beschik niet over de benodigde informatie daarvoor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Bromet over de geplande lelieteelt naast OBS De Singelier, gemeente Westerveld

MPs Slagt-Tichelman and Bromet asked about a planned lily farm next to a primary school in Westerveld, where pesticide exposure concerns arise, and what advice parents and schools can get. The State Secretary answered that GGD advice is available, that a RIVM study on pesticides and residents is underway, that a motion on spray-free zones is being considered, and that the Omgevingswet allows municipalities to apply the precautionary principle.
Since a lot of crop protection agents are used in lily cultivation, the Minister of LNV will start an investigation into how the expansion of the lily acreage can be limited.
Aangezien in de lelieteelt veel gewasbeschermingsmiddelen worden gebruikt, gaat de Minister van LNV een onderzoek starten naar hoe de uitbreiding van het areaal in de lelieteelt beperkt kan worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Mohandis over het bericht dat geïnstalleerde trapliften vaak nog steeds niet voldoen aan het Bouwbesluit en dit tegenstrijdig is met valpreventie beleid

MPs Slagt-Tichelman and Mohandis asked whether stairlifts installed via the Wmo often fail Bouwbesluit safety minimums, whether the ministry's guidance is being used, and whether compliance can be a GALA funding condition, among nine questions. The minister said no signals of widespread non-compliance were received, that enforcement and compliance are municipal responsibilities under the decentralised Wmo and Woningwet, and that the guidance is voluntary and not a GALA condition, while committing to ensure the VNG repromotes the guidance.
Under the Wmo 2015, the municipality (as client and owner) must ensure that the stairlift complies with all regulations, including the Bouwbesluit.
Op grond van de Wmo 2015 moet de gemeente (zijnde opdrachtgever en eigenaar) zich verzekeren dat de traplift voldoet aan alle regelgeving waaronder het Bouwbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt- Tichelman en Westerveld over de topsalarissen van zorgbestuurders

MPs asked the health minister about top salaries of healthcare executives, including interim managers exceeding WNT pay norms, unenforced expense-disclosure rules in the Governancecode Zorg, and whether a statutory duty or lobbying-register reform should apply. The minister said the WNT norms rightly apply by status rather than appointment form, that she prefers talks with sector bodies before legislating on expense transparency, and that a lobbying-register letter is forthcoming.
I will first talk with the BoZ, NVZ, NVZD and NVTZ to see how transparency around declarations can be promoted.
Ik ga eerst met de BoZ, NVZ, NVZD en NVTZ in gesprek om te kijken hoe transparantie rondom declaraties bevorderd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over miljarden euro’s aan junkfoodadvertenties

An MP asked the state secretary for health about billions of euros spent on junk food advertising despite preventive accord targets, whether voluntary industry agreements work, whether a total advertising ban is needed, and what further steps will reduce overweight. The state secretary acknowledged the conflict with the accord, pointed to a planned ban on junk food marketing aimed at children and a food environment law, a sugar-based drinks levy and other prevention programmes, while rejecting a full advertising ban for now.
This is one of the reasons why I am preparing legislation that prohibits marketing of unhealthy food aimed at children.
Dit is een van de redenen waarom ik wetgeving voorbereid die marketing van ongezonde voeding gericht op kinderen verbiedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Slagt-Tichelman over het stoppen van basis geestelijke gezondheidszorg door een grote zorgaanbieder

MPs Westerveld and Slagt-Tichelman asked the minister how the regional mental health care provider Lentis's decision to stop basic mental health care in Groningen would affect patients and capacity, and why regional bodies were not informed. The minister acknowledged the decision, said Lentis no longer accepts new basic care clients and referred patients elsewhere, and said that oversight of regional capacity is primarily the task of health insurers, not the Taskforce.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman en Westerveld over de topsalarissen van zorgbestuurders

MPs Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman and Westerveld asked about high executive pay in healthcare, including a UMC Maastricht board chair above the WNT pay cap, interim manager exemptions, and municipal leverage over pay. The minister defended the exemption mechanism, said data on sector-wide pay totals and jeugdzorg management costs are not kept, and noted only seven exemptions were granted in healthcare.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over het smaakjesverbod voor e-sigaretten

An MP asked the state secretary about the flavour ban on e-cigarettes, including whether opzetbare flavour filters that circumvent it are prohibited and how enforcement, fines and neutral packaging are progressing. The government confirms that such filters are banned under the Tabaks- en rookwarenbesluit, admits enforcement and the planned fine increases will take one to two years, and promises research results on neutral e-cigarette design by March.
I can be brief about this: these attachable flavour filters are indeed prohibited.
Ik kan hier kort over zijn: deze opzetbare smaakjesfilters zijn inderdaad verboden.

m: Motie van het lid Raemakers c.s. over een platform vanwaar jongeren doorverwezen kunnen worden naar de juiste hulporganisatie
Asks the government to explore a platform that refers young people to the right help organisation for mental health and information.
requests the government to explore whether a platform can be developed to refer young people to help organisations
verzoekt de regering om te verkennen of een platform (door)ontwikkeld kan worden
Motie van het lid Richardson c.s. over vermijdbaar tijdschrijven schrappen op de werkvloer en uit de contracten
Motion asks the government to ensure employers and municipalities definitively eliminate avoidable time-writing in youth care and inform parliament in Q1 2023.
requests the government to promote that employers and municipalities definitively eliminate avoidable time-writing
verzoekt de regering op korte termijn te bevorderen dat werkgevers en gemeenten vermijdbaar tijdschrijven daadwerkelijk definitief schrappen
Motie van het lid Richardson c.s. over een landelijke campagne om aandacht te vragen voor mentale gezondheid bij jongeren
Asks the government to launch a national campaign with municipalities and education on youth mental health and point young people to accessible online and local help.
requests the government, together with municipalities and education, to initiate a national campaign drawing attention to mental health among young people
verzoekt de regering om samen met gemeenten en het onderwijs een landelijke campagne te initiëren die aandacht vraagt voor mentale gezondheid bij jongeren
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld, De Hoop, Hagen, Peters, Richardson, Drost, Beertema, Pouw-Verweij, Bisschop, Van Baarle, Sylvana Simons, Omtzigt en Wassenberg over de examenuitslag voor vso-scholieren

MPs asked the minister whether vso (special secondary education) pupils could receive their exam results on the same day as mainstream pupils, and whether an earlier-announcement arrangement from 2024 was progressing. The minister agreed this would be desirable, explained that a structural fix requires rescheduling the state exams and will not be ready until late 2024, and said an interim measure is unlikely to be feasible in 2025.

I will inform your House about these possibilities and the extent to which the group of candidates for whom it becomes possible increases compared with a possible interim solution in 2024, so that your House can weigh the desirability of the interim solution in 2025.

Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over deze mogelijkheden en in welke mate het de groep kandidaten voor wie het mogelijk wordt gemaakt ten opzichte van een eventuele tussenoplossing in 2024 wordt vergroot zodat uw Kamer de wenselijkheid van de tussenoplossing in 2025 kan wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Richardson over het bericht ‘Schoolleiding zet docent onder druk: krik cijfer leerling op’

An MP asks the Minister whether school management pressuring teachers to raise pupils' grades, as reported by the AOb union, breaches the teacher's statutory autonomy in assessment, and what oversight and remedies exist. The Minister says such pressure is impermissible, that teachers should first raise it within the school and can then report to the Inspectorate, and promises to share relevant findings and a herijking of steering model by early 2024.
It is impermissible for school management to pressure teachers to adjust grades, norms and tests.
Het is ongeoorloofd als schooldirecties leraren onder druk zetten om cijfers, normeringen en toetsen aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Richardson over het bericht ‘Emotionele ouderavond om nieuw schoolplan: Kinderen komen huilend thuis’

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about reports that a Zoetermeer school's new plan cut subject instruction to 30 minutes per week, with students doing homework in large groups, and about whether this breaches instruction-time norms and how parents can complain. The minister said the Inspectorate is investigating the school and will report this autumn, and that whether statutory norms are met is for the Inspectorate to judge, while giving general guidance on complaints channels.
It is good that the Inspectorate of Education is currently investigating this school, given the unrest that has arisen.
Het is goed dat de Inspectie van het Onderwijs momenteel onderzoek doet op deze school, gezien de ontstane onrust.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Richardson, Van den Hil en Verkuijlen over het bericht ‘Tientallen klachten van misbruik en mishandeling in Gelders jeugddorp’

MPs asked the state secretary about reports of abuse and mistreatment at the Glind youth village, including whether inspectors had prior signals and what is being done about the care provider and former foster children. The government answered that the IGJ received several signals and reports since 2018 and will handle them, that Pluryn set up a helpline and is commissioning research, and that existing complaint channels exist, while declining to disclose details of individual reports citing confidentiality and privacy.
The IGJ never makes statements about the precise content of reports and how they are handled.
Over de precieze inhoud van meldingen en de afhandeling doet de IGJ nooit mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Richardson over het bericht ‘GGD trekt stekker uit digitaal jeugddossier ondanks investering van miljoenen’

MP Richardson asked the state secretary about the GGD halting its digital youth record project despite millions invested, including the quality criteria, the leverage of the supplier, and how lessons would be shared. The state secretary answered that the decision and its handling rest with the GGD boards and municipalities, that evaluations are underway in each region, and that VWS is not responsible for the project's termination.
The decision to stop the GGiD was taken by the three GGD general boards themselves.
Het besluit om te stoppen met het GGiD is een besluit dat genomen is door de drie GGD (algemeen) besturen zelf.

orders the person to whom the request is addressed to comply with the request made
degene tot wie het verzoek is gericht bevelen het gedane verzoek na te komen

Deletes the mandatory disclosure by large shareholders of whether they object to a listed company's strategy, and the related website disclosure duty.

Amends the Wft so that shareholders requesting a shareholder meeting agenda item must disclose their full long and short economic interest.
