Removes the obligation for major shareholders to state whether they object to a listed company's strategy and the related website disclosure duty for companies.
Motie Schaart over het stopzetten van de rijksbijdrage aan MVO Nederland
Asks the government to stop the state contribution to MVO Nederland as soon as possible, privatise it, and redirect the freed funds to innovation.
requests the government to stop the state contribution to MVO Nederland as soon as possible and privatise MVO Nederland
verzoekt de regering de rijksbijdrage aan MVO Nederland zo snel mogelijk stop te zetten en MVO Nederland te privatiseren
Motie Schaart over de relatie tussen de ROM's en de rijksoverheid
Asks the government to present within six months a plan on how the relationship between the regional development companies and the central government as shareholder should be shaped.
requests the government to come up within six months with a plan on how the relationship between the ROMs and the central government should be shaped
verzoekt de regering binnen een halfjaar met een plan te komen waarin wordt aangegeven hoe de relatie tussen de ROM's en de rijksoverheid moet worden vormgeven
Amendement van het lid Koppejan c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 8 over een bedrag van €1,4 dat in 2012 ten goede zal komen aan het programma onderzoek MKB en ondernemerschap
Shifts €1.4 million in 2012 from market-ordering research to the SME and entrepreneurship research programme in exchange for three research tasks.
The 1.4 million will benefit the SME and entrepreneurship research programme in 2012
De 1,4 miljoen zal in 2012 ten goede komen aan het programma onderzoek MKB en ondernemerschap
Amendement van het lid Koppejan c.s. over een bedrag van 1,4 miljoen dat in 2012 ten goede zal komen aan het programma onderzoek MKB en ondernemerschap
Shifts 1.4 million euro from optimal market regulation research to a SME and entrepreneurship research programme in the budget.
the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by 1,400 thousand euro
worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 1 400 (x € 1 000)
Amendement van de leden Schaart en Van Vliet over het openstellen van de co-financieringsregeling van TNO
Amendment shifts funds within the budget article on strong innovation capacity, opening the TNO co-financing scheme to other knowledge institutions.
The submitters want to open this scheme to all other knowledge institutions
De indieners willen deze regeling openstellen voor alle andere kennisinstellingen
Motie Schaart over het verkopen van de aandelen van de ROM's
Asks government to sell its shares in regional development companies (ROMs) to private or regional public parties, shifting responsibility to the regions.
to sell the ROM shares to private parties or to public parties in the regions
de aandelen van de ROM's te verkopen aan private partijen of aan publieke partijen in de regio's
Motie Schaart c.s. over het Innovatiefonds MKB+
Motion asking the government to set explicit conditions for the MKB+ innovation fund, including private co-financing and profit-sharing on success.
to explicitly name the following conditions for the use of this fund
de volgende voorwaarden voor de benutting van dit fonds expliciet te benoemen
Motie Koppejan c.s. over het volgen van innovatiegelden
Asks the government, following the Court of Audit's recommendation, to make innovation subsidies traceable from recipient to results and to set up a public tracking system.
requests the government, in line with the Court of Audit's recommendation, to achieve more transparency on where innovation funds go
verzoekt de regering om conform de aanbeveling van de Algemene Rekenkamer meer transparantie te bewerkstelligen waar innovatiegelden naartoe gaan
Motie Verburg en Schaart over netneutraliteit

Asks the government not to give legal force to the EU net neutrality implementation before the Chamber has discussed the proposal and its effects, and to prevent new cost allocation through agreements with providers.

requests the government not to give the implementation of the present EU directives the force of law before both the proposal and the effects of the European Commission on net neutrality have been discussed with the Chamber

verzoekt de regering de implementatie voor de onderhavige EU-richtlijnen niet eerder kracht van wet te doen krijgen, dan nadat zowel het voorstel als de effecten van de Europese Commissie inzake netneutraliteit met de Kamer zijn besproken
Motie Schaart en Verburg over verstoring van de dienstverlening
Asks the government to secure agreements preventing broadband interference from 800 MHz use and to create powers allowing the minister to impose obligations on licence holders.
requests the government to include in the 800 MHz licences a provision allowing the minister to impose obligations on licence holders
verzoekt de regering in de vergunningen voor de 800 MHz-band een bepaling op te nemen waarmee de minister aan vergunninghouders verplichtingen kan opleggen
Amendement van het lid Schaart over keuze- en uitingsvrijheid van eindgebruikers op het internet
Amends the Telecommunications Act so that internet providers may not block or slow internet services, except in listed cases, and must offer consumers full internet access.
End users must be able to decide for themselves which content they want to send and receive
Eindgebruikers moeten zelf kunnen beslissen welke inhoud zij willen verzenden en ontvangen
qa: Antwoord vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Schaart over de levering van een SIGMA korvet aan Indonesië

Two VVD MPs asked about the sale of a SIGMA corvette by Damen Schelde Naval Shipbuilding to Indonesia, including contract value, jobs, prior deliveries and whether EU arms export criteria were applied. The government confirmed a contract of about $220 million for one corvette with an option on more, said a positive preliminary assessment against the EU criteria was made, and provided an overview of export licences for Indonesia.
In an exploratory phase, a so-called sondage, a positive opinion was given based on assessment against the eight criteria of the EU Common Position.
In een verkennende fase, een zogenaamde sondage, is een positief advies gegeven aan de hand van de beoordeling van de acht criteria van het EU Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt.
Antwoord vragen Schaart over het ruimtevaartbeleid, en de gevolgen van bezuinigingen voor de positie van de ESA-vestiging te Noordwijk

MP Schaart (VVD) asked the minister of Economic Affairs about reports that ESTEC, ESA's research centre in Noordwijk, might leave the Netherlands, the economic value of space activity, Dutch ESA contributions, and long-term funding certainty. The minister answered that space is part of the top-sector policy, outlined Dutch contributions and multiplier effects, promised a policy letter before summer, and said ESA member states will clarify their funding at the November 2012 ministerial conference.
Yes, it is my intention to send Parliament a policy letter on space policy before this summer, including the priorities the cabinet chooses for this policy area in the coming years.
Ja, het is mijn voornemen om voor deze zomer een beleidsbrief over het ruimtevaartbeleid aan uw Kamer aan te bieden
Vragen van het lid Schaart (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de verkoop van namaak Uggs op de Nederlandse markt (ingezonden 7 november 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary about large-scale online sale of counterfeit UGG boots, its representativeness, Chinese cooperation, economic damage, enforcement measures, Marktplaats's role, animal-welfare concerns about fur, and labour conditions. The government answers that customs intercepts counterfeit goods at the border, cooperates with China and Marktplaats's notice-and-takedown programme, and that counterfeits are a large and growing problem, but declines to take specific extra measures on fur or labour conditions.
No, for action against infringement of intellectual property rights it makes no difference how the articles in question were manufactured.
Nee, voor het optreden tegen inbreuk op intellectueeleigendomsrechten maakt het geen verschil hoe de desbetreffende artikelen zijn vervaardigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schaart en Lucas over het artikel ‘Slimme dijken op komst’

MPs Schaart and Lucas asked about a newspaper report on 'smart dikes', including whether broadband cable ducts in dikes could be shared with telecom companies at marginal cost and how water boards are encouraged to combine projects. The minister answered that sensor dike technology is still being studied, that a convenant between water boards and cable operators is in preparation, and that she will consider cost-sharing when the moment is right.
A convenant between the Union of Water Boards and the Platform of Network Operators is currently being prepared.
Er wordt op dit moment gewerkt aan een convenant tussen de Unie van Waterschappen en het Platform Netbeheerders

Vragen van de leden Leegte en Schaart (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat aluminiumsmelter Zalco deze week failliet is gegaan (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

MPs Leegte and Schaart asked the minister about the bankruptcy of aluminium smelter Zalco, the role of global energy cost differences, carbon leakage, German compensation schemes and Dutch energy competitiveness. The minister attributed the closures to world-set aluminium prices, high European production costs, and cheap energy elsewhere, said carbon leakage rules change only from 2013, and promised to ask the European Commission about compensation schemes in neighbouring countries.
I can only inform you about special contracts in other EU countries after I have received an answer from the European Commission.
Over speciale contracten in andere EU-landen kan ik u eerst informeren nadat ik antwoord heb ontvangen van de Europese Commissie.

Vragen van de leden Schaart en Snijder-Hazelfhoff (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken Landbouw en Innovatie over de veiligheid van aanstekers op de Nederlandse markt (ingezonden 29 december 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the government about the safety of lighters sold on the Dutch market, including the share from China, enforcement measures, injury figures and whether the NVWA should conduct new research. The minister answered that the NVWA already supervises importers and distributors, that a supplementary inspection will conclude in February 2012, and that policy will be adjusted if the results warrant it.
I will study the results of the NVWA investigation and, if there is cause, I will adjust my policy.
Ik zal de resultaten van het onderzoek van de NVWA bestuderen en wanneer daartoe aanleiding is, zal ik mijn beleid aanpassen.

Vragen van de leden Schaart en Snijder-Hazelhoff (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de inwerkingtreding van Verordening (EU) nr 284/2011 door een wijziging van het Ware

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about EU Regulation 284/2011 on aflatoxin controls, including who pays for inspections, turnaround times and possible trade standstill. The minister answered that importers will pay cost-covering fees from early 2012, that the turnaround is indicatively one working week, and that no maximum turnaround is set to protect the thoroughness of the testing.
The Regulation does not set a maximum turnaround time.
De Verordening stelt geen maximum doorlooptijd vast.

Vragen van de leden Schaart en van Miltenburg (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de slechte ontvangst van Radio 1, Radio 2, Radio 3, Ra

MPs Schaart and van Miltenburg asked why radio stations including Radio 1 and Omroep Drenthe remain poorly received in northern Netherlands after the Hoogersmilde mast collapse, and what the public broadcaster and government are doing about it. The minister answered that a temporary emergency mast and alternative frequencies improve reception but full restoration awaits rebuilding the mast (expected October 2012), and that a 200-metre temporary mast is being planned.
You will be informed separately by letter about the progress and the action plan.
Over de voortgang en het plan van aanpak wordt u afzonderlijk per brief geïnformeerd.

Vragen van het lid Schaart (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een onvolledige rapportage van Agentschap Telecom over graafschades veroorzaakt bij het aanleggen van glasvezel (ingezond

MP Schaart asks the minister whether reported excavation damage figures for Deventer and Amsterdam are accurate and whether the Agentschap Telecom report on glass-fibre excavation damage is misleading and should be corrected. The minister denies knowing the source of the figures, explains the report is based on mandatory netbeheerder reports with no breakdown by cause, admits the report could have addressed risks more, and says AT has contacted the agency and will act as supervisor.
Following your questions, there has been contact with AT.
Naar aanleiding van uw vragen is er contact geweest met AT.

Vragen van de leden Schaart en Dijkhoff (beiden VVD) minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat de € 9,1 miljard beschikbaar stelt voor met name breedband in buitengebieden (ingezonden 6 o

MPs Schaart and Dijkhoff asked the minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the EU's Connecting Europe Facility would offer EUR 9.1 billion for broadband, including to local governments and utilities, and how many Dutch households lack broadband and whether the Netherlands should claim a share. The minister answered that broadband rollout is primarily a market task with public funding only where markets fail, that about 98% of households can reach 30 Mbps, and that questions on budget shares cannot yet be answered because the proposal is still in early decision-making.
Given the stage of decision-making the Connecting Europe Facility proposal is in, answering these questions is not possible at this time.
Gelet op de fase van besluitvorming waarin het voorstel voor de «Connecting Europe Facility» zich bevindt, is beantwoording van deze vragen nu niet mogelijk.

Vragen van het lid Schaart (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat Nederland op de ranglijst van sterkste IT-landen sterk gedaald is naar de 10e plaats wereldwijd (ingezond

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about Dutch fall to 10th place in an IT competitiveness index and its causes, and what will be done about ICT policy. The minister answers that the index is one of many with its own method, that Nederland scores well on other ICT indicators, acknowledges ICT's importance and says ICT is included in all top sectors and a forthcoming implementation agenda.
The ICT sector is an important sector for the cabinet.
De ICT-sector is een belangrijke sector voor het kabinet.
Vragen van het lid Schaart (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over workshops sociale media georganiseerd door Syntens (ingezonden 16 mei 2011).

An MP asked the minister why Syntens, a publicly funded innovation body, offers free or low-cost social media workshops that commercial parties also provide, and whether this is a government task. The minister defended the workshops as first-line awareness work for SMEs, said Syntens' remit is being reviewed within the planned Ondernemerspleinen concept, and promised a letter to parliament this summer.
This summer I will send a letter to your House elaborating the concept of the Ondernemerspleinen.
Deze zomer zal ik een brief aan uw Kamer sturen, waarin het concept van de Ondernemerspleinen verder uitgewerkt is.

Vragen van het lid Schaart (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de bezorgdheid van de branchevereniging Scheepsbouw Nederland over het toenemende protectionisme van concurrerende overhe

An MP asked the economy minister whether the Dutch shipbuilding sector's concern about foreign protectionism would be addressed by establishing a level playing field, and whether subsidies or guarantees would be used. The minister replied that the Netherlands seeks international level-playing-field agreements, that Dutch subsidy and guarantee schemes exist, and that distortions would be raised with the European Commission.
Demonstrable distortions of the level playing field within Europe are raised by my department with the European Commission.
Aantoonbare verstoringen van het level playing field binnen Europa worden door mijn departement aangekaart bij de Europese Commissie.

Vragen van de leden Schaart en van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «iPhone maakt elke minuut een foto van je, ook in bed

Two MPs asked the ministers whether consumers should be told in advance about hidden location-tracking features in Apple devices, and whether government use of Apple products should be halted. The government answered that existing consumer information duties apply, declined to advise separately or ban Apple products, and pointed to security measures for sensitive functions.
I do not consider a separate advice on this point necessary.
Ik acht een separaat advies op dit punt niet noodzakelijk.
Vragen van de leden Nicolaï en Schaart (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een wapentransport onderweg van Turkije naar Jemen (ingezonden 28 maart 2011).

MPs Nicolaï and Schaart asked the Foreign Minister about a seized arms shipment from Turkey to Yemen, whether it could destabilise Yemen, who was behind it, whether Turkey was aware, and Dutch arms-export criteria for Yemen. The minister said the UAE authorities are investigating and may later share details, that Turkish authorities were not aware and had not licensed it, and that all Dutch export applications for Yemen are on hold.
The authorities in the UAE are conducting the investigation into this incident and may in due course be able to provide information on the client, carrier and final destination of the transport.

De autoriteiten in de VAE verrichten het onderzoek omtrent dit incident en zullen te zijner tijd wellicht in staat zijn om informatie te verschaffen over opdrachtgever, vervoerder en einddoel van het transport.

Vragen van de leden Taverne en Schaart (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat radiobazen betaald krijgen voor lied

MPs Taverne and Schaart asked whether radio station directors registered with Buma/Stemra as composers, receiving royalties for songs they did not write, and whether this constitutes abuse or should be criminalised. The government answered that these are private contracts, that Buma membership rules are for Buma to decide, that it will ask the College van Toezicht Auteursrechten to look at the issue, and that a copyright contract law proposal is pending.
I will ask the College van Toezicht Auteursrechten to pay attention to the matter.
Ik zal het College van Toezicht Auteursrechten verzoeken aandacht aan de kwestie te besteden.
Vragen van de leden Verburg (CDA) en Schaart (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de ESA (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

MPs Verburg and Schaart asked the minister about Dutch commitment to ESA, its contribution levels, return calculations and the role of space and aviation in the top-sector policy. The minister answered that contributions will be set at the 2012 Ministerial Conference within budget limits, that Dutch geo-return exceeds 1, and that space can contribute to several top sectors.
The Cabinet will consider the Dutch position ahead of the 2012 Ministerial Conference within the framework of financial possibilities.
Het Kabinet zal de Nederlandse inzet in aanloop naar de Ministeriële Conferentie in 2012 bezien binnen het kader van de financiële mogelijkheden.
Vragen van het lid Schaart (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie betreffende een advies inzake hondentraining van Syntens (ingezonden 15 februari 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether Syntens, a government-funded innovation network, was right to advise a firm to use a dog training session and how this fits its mandate. The minister answers that Syntens only referred the firm to a commercial adviser, which the firm paid for itself, and describes Syntens' funding and role.
Contrary to what was reported, Syntens did not advise holding a session with dogs to better understand the mutual relationships.
In tegenstelling tot wat in de berichtgeving is opgenomen, heeft Syntens niet geadviseerd om een sessie met honden te houden om de onderlinge verhoudingen beter te begrijpen.
Vragen van het lid Schaart (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie inzake cybercrime aanvallen op Nederlandse bedrijven (ingezonden 7 januari 2011).

An MP asked the economics minister about cyberattacks on Dutch firms, the Netherlands' high rate of ICT incidents in the EU, and planned action. The minister acknowledged the problem, said firms bear primary responsibility, pointed to awareness programmes and an information-sharing knooppunt, and promised to address it in the forthcoming Digitale Agenda and Nationale Cybersecurity Strategie.
In March 2011 the National Cybersecurity Strategy will be sent to the House of Representatives, including policy on tackling cybercrime.
In maart 2011 zal de Nationale Cybersecurity Strategie aan de Tweede Kamer worden toegestuurd met daarin ondermeer het beleid rond de aanpak van cybercrime.

Vragen van de leden Schaart en Nicolaï (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de door China aangekondigde verlaging van de export van zeldzame aardmetale

MPs Schaart and Nicolaï asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about China's reduced export quotas for rare earth metals, its effect on Dutch raw material security, and how the government will safeguard that security. The government answered that there is no acute supply problem yet, pointed to a CBS/TNO study of critical raw materials, and described EU and WTO efforts against Chinese export restrictions, including a WTO dispute panel expected to rule in early 2011.
I will inform the House about this.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Vragen van de leden Schaart en Van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Financiën inzake de BKR-regeling (ingezonden 15 november 2010).

MPs Schaart and Van der Steur asked whether telecom firms withdrawing from BKR credit registration over disproportionate effects should lead the government to change policy, and whether obligated parties should be free to leave the system. The minister answered that BKR registration remains useful for creditworthiness checks, that registration does not mean automatic refusal, and that any changes to the BKR rules are for participants to decide, with talks reported to have resumed.
Any amendments to the BKR regulations are for the participants of BKR.
Eventuele aanpassingen van het reglement van BKR zijn aan de deelnemers van BKR.
Vragen van het lid Schaart (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de kwaliteit van de postbezorging (ingezonden 17 september 2010).

An MP asks the minister of Economic Affairs whether whole neighbourhoods receive late or no post and whether TNT Post is fulfilling its universal service duty, given that the latest quality measurement dates from last year. The minister replies that the internal memo does not prove whole neighbourhoods are affected, that TNT reported 96.4% next-day delivery for 2009 meeting the 95% norm, and that regulator OPTA is investigating and may use its formal powers if needed.
I have asked OPTA to take up the investigation expeditiously and to inform me of the result as soon as possible.
Ik heb OPTA verzocht het onderzoek met voortvarendheid op te pakken en mij zo spoedig mogelijk over het resultaat te informeren.

Vragen van de leden Aptroot en Schaart (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en Economische Zaken over het artikel «Duopolie op komst in openbaar busvervoer» (ingezonden 18 augustus 2010).

Two VVD MPs asked ministers whether the government assesses the proposed Transdev-Veolia merger in public bus transport, whether the market is closing to smaller entrants, and what the policy is on competition given NS subsidiary Qbuzz. The ministers answered that the NMa is conducting an in-depth review requiring a licence, that the policy is set out in WP2000 and a pending amendment, that NS Internationaal is commercially independent with no subsidy, and that the market remains open to new entrants.
The NMa is currently conducting an in-depth investigation into the consequences of the merger.
De NMa voert momenteel een diepgaand onderzoek uit naar de gevolgen van de fusie.

m: Motie van het lid Boon c.s. over de Kamer periodiek informeren over de effecten van de handhaving op schijnzelfstandigheid om een zachte landing te bevorderen
Asks the government to report regularly to the Chamber on the effects of enforcement against sham self-employment, with attention to experiences of freelancers, clients and the Tax Authority.
requests the government to promote a soft landing by periodically informing the Chamber about the effects of enforcement on sham self-employment
verzoekt de regering een zachte landing te bevorderen door de Kamer periodiek te informeren over de effecten van de handhaving op schijnzelfstandigheid
Motie van het lid Boon c.s. over een opt-outmogelijkheid voor zelfstandigen die aantoonbaar voldoende hebben voorzien in hun arbeidsongeschiktheidsrisico
Asks the government to include an opt-out from mandatory disability insurance for self-employed people who have demonstrably provided for their disability risk.
requests the government, when elaborating the mandatory disability insurance, to include an opt-out possibility
verzoekt de regering bij de uitwerking van de verplichte arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering een opt-outmogelijkheid op te nemen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon en Raijer over de bezetting van het Academiegebouw in Leiden door gemaskerde pro-Palestijnse activisten

MPs Boon and Raijer (PVV) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the occupation of the Leiden Academy Building by masked pro-Palestinian activists, whether universities should engage with occupiers, whether the university must file a criminal complaint, and whether the action should be qualified as antisemitic. The minister said university boards decide interventions locally, that the Leiden board filed a complaint and police cleared the building, and that qualifying antisemitism is for the prosecutor and courts, not the minister.
I want to note that as Minister I cannot intervene in the prosecution service's decisions nor have any involvement in the legal process.
Ik hecht eraan te benoemen dat ik als Minister niet kan treden in opvolging door het OM noch bemoeienis kan hebben met de rechtsgang.
Antwoord op de leden Boon en Wilders over het voornemen van de HZ Omer Moskee in Epe om vanaf 20 juni 2025 wekelijks een islamitische gebedsoproep te laten horen

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the government would act against a mosque in Epe broadcasting a weekly Islamic call to prayer and whether it would ban such calls nationally. The Interior Minister answered that the freedom of religion protects calls to prayer, that local authorities set noise rules under the Wet openbare manifestaties, and that the government is examining whether the rules need changing, with a report to parliament to follow.
The cabinet is examining whether the existing regulations need to be adjusted.
Het kabinet onderzoekt of de bestaande regelgeving aanpassing behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon en Van der Hoeff over herhaalde antisemitisme en oproepen tot geweld door Radboud-docent Harry Pettit

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how she judges a Radboud University lecturer's statements comparing Zionists to Nazis and calling for eradicating Zionism, whether this warrants criminal reporting, and why the university has not dismissed him. The Minister called the statements abject, said criminality is not for her to determine, left employment and conduct measures to the university as employer, described the inspectorate's and Raad van Toezicht's roles, and rejected the claim that the university lacks moral authority.
It is for Radboud University, as employer, to take measures towards its staff where necessary.
Het is aan de Radboud Universiteit om, als werkgever, zo nodig maatregelen te nemen richting haar medewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boon over het bericht “Tienduizenden arbeidsmigranten van buiten de EU zonder papieren in Nederland’

An MP asked the minister about reports of tens of thousands of non-EU labour migrants without papers working illegally, including visa-free routes from Brazil and Georgia, the RNI system giving BSNs, lack of exit control, and enforcement against illegal employment. The government said it cannot quantify the illegal population, sees no basis yet to suspend visa-free travel, will address the RNI loophole and report to parliament in September, and explained existing enforcement (Labour Inspectorate fines, return decisions, residence permit withdrawal).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boon en Van der Hoeff over antisemitisme en oproep tot ingrijpen wegens wanbeheer

Two PVV MPs asked the education minister whether recent occupations at the University of Amsterdam and Radboud University endangered students and staff, whether students should be expelled, and whether the minister would order an inspection and a formal instruction for alleged mismanagement by the boards. The minister answered that institutions handle disciplinary measures themselves, that the Inspectorate acts independently and a formal instruction is not currently warranted, and that the sector is being engaged on antisemitism and safety.

If the Inspectorate of Education, after investigation, concludes there is mismanagement within the meaning of the WHW, i.e. a serious degree of neglect of social safety, I can as a last resort issue a formal instruction to the Supervisory Board.

Wanneer de Inspectie van het Onderwijs na onderzoek tot de conclusie komt dat er sprake is van wanbeheer in de zin van de WHW, dus van ernstige mate van verwaarlozen van de sociale veiligheid, kan ik als ultimum remedium overgaan tot het geven van een aanwijzing aan de RvT.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon, Van der Hoef en Uppelschoten over het bericht 'Lezing pro-Israëlische activiste op Radboud Universiteit ruw verstoord, aangifte tegen gemaskerde docent: ’Hij leidde de bende’ en anti

MPs from the PVV asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a disrupted lecture at Radboud University, lecturers linked to Scholars for Palestine, alleged antisemitic slogans at demonstrations, and the awarding of a contract for antisemitism-prevention lessons in schools. The Minister said universities must report offences and take measures proportionate to the situation, that the TU Delft and UM handle their own assessments, and that the Fawaka contract was awarded on multiple criteria with the award documents withheld as confidential.
The associated award and assessment documents cannot be sent to the House, because they contain commercially sensitive and confidential information.
De bijbehorende gunnings- en beoordelingsdocumenten kunnen we niet aan de Kamer toesturen, omdat deze bedrijfsgevoelige en vertrouwelijke informatie bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon, Wilders en Blaauw over de benoeming van de ambassadeurs van de vrijheid door het Nationaal Comité 4 en 5 mei

MPs Boon, Wilders and Blaauw asked whether the National Committee 4 and 5 May's choice of Freedom Ambassadors, including a performer alleged to have joined an antisemitic fundraiser, was acceptable and whether the government would intervene. The State Secretary answered that the Committee is independent, that the selection process was careful, and that the government respects its choices and will not intervene.
The National Committee 4 and 5 May is independent and independently determines how the National Commemoration on 4 May and Liberation Day on 5 May are shaped.
Het Nationaal Comité 4 en 5 mei is onafhankelijk en bepaalt zelfstandig hoe de Nationale Herdenking op 4 mei en Bevrijdingsdag op 5 mei worden vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon en Van der Hoeff over hakenkruizen en antisemitisme op het United World College (UWC) in Maastricht

MPs Boon and Van der Hoeff asked the Minister of Education about swastikas and antisemitism at UWC Maastricht, including a reported incident involving a six-year-old Israeli girl and whether the school handled antisemitism adequately. The State Secretary answered that the school handled six reported swastika incidents with internal investigations, sanctions in one case, and extra measures, that the inspectorate sees no reason for further steps, and that the school is urged to use the antisemitism guidance.
The inspectorate currently sees no reason for follow-up steps.
De inspectie ziet op dit moment geen reden voor vervolgstappen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon en Van der Velde over de weigering van de Joods-Israëlische comedian Yohay Sponder door Amsterdamse club Boom Chicago en de toenemende onveiligheid voor Joodse artiesten in Nederland

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether Boom Chicago should have reported threats and cooperated with police instead of cancelling Yohay Sponder's shows, whether the venue's antisemitic remark was shocking, and how the government will keep the cultural sector safe for Jewish artists. The minister agreed cancelling was regrettable, called the remark an unfortunate utterance, pointed to a VSCD incident protocol and inter-ministerial talks, and noted a Kunsten '92 project against antisemitism.

Further talks have been held between the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, the Ministry of Justice and Security and the Association of Dutch Municipalities to guarantee access to the local triangle.

Er zijn verder gesprekken gevoerd tussen het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap, het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten om de toegang tot de lokale driehoek te waarborgen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon, Van der Velde en Heutink over ‘de onacceptabele uitsluiting van PVV-bewindspersonen door UN Women bij de aftrap van een campagne tegen geweld tegen vrouwen en meisjes in Enschede.’

PVV MPs asked whether UN Women excluded PVV state secretaries from a campaign launch against violence against women in Enschede because of their party affiliation, and whether this is acceptable. The government condemned unequal treatment on political grounds, said UN Women Nederland is an independent Dutch foundation rather than a UN body, and noted the Enschede municipality has withdrawn from the event.
If ministers are excluded because of their political affiliation, that is completely unacceptable.
Indien bewindslieden omwille van hun politieke affiliatie worden uitgesloten is dat volstrekt onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon en Blaauw over antisemitische bezetting en veiligheid op de Gerrit Rietveld Academie

MPs Boon and Blaauw asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a months-long standoff between the Gerrit Rietveld Academie board and pro-Palestinian students, including a sit-in, antisemitic banners and a letter of concern from staff and alumni. The minister replied that the institution is responsible for safety, that the board tolerated the occupation under conditions, that banners have been removed and a complaint filed, and that existing antisemitism-related safety measures will continue.
I asked the Gerrit Rietveld Academie whether they could share with me the letter you refer to.
Ik heb de Gerrit Rietveld Academie benaderd met de vraag of zij de brief waar u aan refereert zouden kunnen delen met mij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon en Deen over een protest op 19 juni 2024 buiten de Tweede Kamer

PVV MPs Boon and Deen asked the ministers whether they knew of a 19 June 2024 protest outside the Tweede Kamer where chants allegedly called for violence against Jewish people, and whether demonstrators dressed as Al-Qassam Brigades members amounted to glorification of terrorism. The minister confirmed awareness, said prosecution of such expressions is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts to assess case by case, and noted the cabinet plans to make glorification of terrorism a separate criminal offence.
Whether publicly uttering certain wording qualifies as a criminal offence ... is for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the court to assess.
Of het in het openbaar uiten van bepaalde bewoordingen te kwalificeren valt als strafbaar feit ... is aan het Openbaar Ministerie en in laatste instantie aan de rechter om te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Faber-van de Klashorst, Vlottes, Boon en Markuszower over de 'Stichting Plant een Olijfboom'

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about the Stichting Plant een Olijfboom, whose staff allegedly praised the 7 October attack, questioning its ANBI charity status, missing financial reporting, possible funding of Hamas, and calls for an FIOD investigation or a ban. The minister condemned such statements but said the ANBI public-benefit test is neutral and non-prosecutable conduct is no ground for revocation, that financial publication gaps are usually remedied, that tax secrecy prevents comment on the individual organisation, and that dissolution/banning under Article 2:20 BW is for the Public Prosecution Service and the court.
The Tax Authority is bound by the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act and therefore cannot provide further information about individual institutions.
De Belastingdienst is gehouden aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen en kan daarom geen nadere informatie verstrekken over individuele instellingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Krul, Diederik van Dijk en Boon over de berichten 'Staatssecretaris: begrip voor uitstel concerten Israëlische groep' en 'Driehoek wist niets van het besluit over afgelastin

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary for culture how the government will ensure artists can perform safely regardless of origin, and why she showed understanding for Het Concertgebouw cancelling Jerusalem Quartet concerts without consulting the local security triangle. The answers say the cancellation was a security-based decision by the venue, that the state secretary understood it as an exception, that a general guidance document is being prepared with the sector, and that a concert date is being sought.
However, Het Concertgebouw itself made the decision to cancel this concert before advice had been given by the security triangle.
Het Concertgebouw heeft echter zelf de beslissing genomen om dit concert af te gelasten voordat er een advies vanuit de driehoek was gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Velde en Boon over het bericht 'WO II-voorstelling afgelast vanwege antisemitisme'

Two MPs asked whether cancelling a WWII performance due to antisemitism signals capitulation to anti-Jewish hatred and what role government plays in safeguarding cultural events. The State Secretary condemned such cancellations, said culture must remain free, and outlined cooperation with the sector, local security triangles and a forthcoming broader antisemitism approach.
It has been agreed that parties in the cultural sector will, in consultation with me, develop a general guideline and specific protocols with a clear directive.
Afgesproken is dat partijen in de cultuursector in overleg met mij komen tot een algemene handreiking en specifieke protocollen met een eenduidige richtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Velde en Boon over het bericht 'Reeks muzikale holocaustherdenkingen afgelast door antisemitische dreiging: ‘Risico is veel te groot’

MPs asked whether the cancellation of Holocaust commemoration concerts due to antisemitic threats is unacceptable and what measures will be taken to keep such events going, and whether the sector's exposure to antisemitism will be mapped. The Staatssecretaris condemns antisemitism, says cultural events must not be cancelled over Jewish themes, and reports sector agreements on protocols and a round-table, while committing to inform parliament further on the antisemitism approach.
It has been agreed that parties in the cultural sector will, in consultation with me, develop a general guideline and specific protocols with a uniform directive.
Afgesproken is dat partijen in de cultuursector in overleg met mij komen tot een algemene handreiking en specifieke protocollen met een eenduidige richtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Blaauw en Boon over het bericht ‘Woede over besluit Hogeschool Utrecht om Holocaust-lezingen te schrappen’

MPs Blaauw and Boon asked the minister whether the Hogeschool Utrecht's cancellation of Holocaust lectures sends the wrong signal and what the government will do to ensure the lecture series goes ahead. The minister said Holocaust education is important, that the first lecture has already taken place after a postponement for safety reasons, and that how the lectures are made publicly available is for the organisers to decide.
This concerns a lecture series organised by the Hogeschool Utrecht in cooperation with CIDI.
Het betreft hier een lezingenreeks die is georganiseerd door de Hogeschool Utrecht in samenwerking met het CIDI.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boon over het bericht 'Opnieuw pro-Palestijnse sit-ins op stations, dit keer op Joodse feestdag: 'Zorgwekkend en intimiderend''

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Justice and Security about pro-Palestinian sit-ins at railway stations on a Jewish holiday, including antisemitic slogans and whether Jewish Dutch citizens feel threatened. The minister confirmed awareness, condemned discriminatory expressions, said the government and NCTV monitor the situation, and noted that criminal offences during demonstrations can be acted upon by the mayor, prosecutor and police.
When possible criminal offences such as incitement, hatred, discrimination or violence are committed during a demonstration, action can be taken.
Op het moment dat tijdens een demonstratie (mogelijke) strafbare feiten worden gepleegd, zoals opruiing of het aanzetten tot haat, discriminatie of geweld, kan worden opgetreden.

m: Motie van de leden Van Rooijen en Tony van Dijck over geen terugwerkende kracht bij lastenverzwaringen
Asks the government not to include retroactive effect in new tax bills where they increase burdens on citizens or firms.
when drafting new tax bills, not to include retroactive effect where burdens on citizens and/or firms are increased
om bij nieuwe fiscale wetsvoorstellen geen terugwerkende kracht op te nemen als het gaat om lastenverzwaringen voor burgers en/of bedrijven
Motie van de leden Van Brenk en Van Rooijen over de sollicitatieplicht koppelen aan een periodieke beoordeling
Asks the government to link job-search obligations for welfare recipients to periodic assessment and allow alternative activities for some older people.
requests the government to link the job-search obligation for welfare recipients to a periodic assessment
verzoekt de regering, de sollicitatieplicht voor mensen in de bijstand te koppelen aan een periodieke beoordeling
Motie van het lid Van Weyenberg c.s. over de fiscale vrijstelling voor scholing bij de private individuele leerrekeningen
Asks the government to examine improvements to the tax exemption for training under individual learning accounts and related effects on the transition payment.
requests the government to examine whether there are improvements in applying the existing tax exemption
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken: • of er verbeterpunten zijn bij het toepassen van de bestaande fiscale vrijstelling
Motie van de leden Van Brenk en Van Rooijen over onderzoek of de UFR ook voor Nederlandse pensioenfondsen kan gelden
Asks the government to have the Commissie Parameters examine whether the European Ultimate Forward Rate can also apply to Dutch pension funds.
requests the government to explicitly instruct the Commissie Parameters to examine whether the European Ultimate Forward Rate (UFR) can also apply to Dutch pension funds
verzoekt de regering om de Commissie Parameters expliciet opdracht te geven om te onderzoeken of de Europese Ultimate Forward Rate (UFR) ook voor Nederlandse pensioenfondsen kan gelden
Motie van de leden Van Brenk en Van Rooijen over afzien van aanscherping van criteria voor een WIA-arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkering
Asks the government to refrain from further tightening the criteria for WIA disability benefits.
requests the government to refrain from further tightening the criteria for a WIA disability benefit
verzoekt de regering, af te zien van verdere aanscherping van criteria voor een WIA-arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkering
Motie van de leden Van Brenk en Van Rooijen over de berekening van de verplichtingen van pensioenfondsen vergeleken met de premieberekening
Asks the government to use the same expected return when calculating pension fund obligations as in the pension premium calculation.
to use the same expected return in calculating pension fund obligations as in the pension calculation
om bij de berekening van de verplichtingen van pensioenfondsen uit te gaan van hetzelfde «verwachte rendement» als bij de pensioenberekening
Motie van de leden Van Brenk en Van Rooijen over onderzoek naar de toename van het aantal zzp'ers
Asks the government to commission research into the causes of the rise in self-employed workers and recommend policy options to slow it.
requests the government to carry out research into the causes and make recommendations on concrete policy options
verzoekt de regering, een onderzoek uit te voeren naar de oorzaken en aanbevelingen te doen over concrete beleidsopties
Motie van de leden Van Brenk en Van Rooijen over de IOW op 60-jarige leeftijd in stand houden
Asks the government to keep the income provision for older unemployed (IOW) available from age 60.
requests the government to maintain the IOW at age 60
verzoekt de regering, de IOW op 60-jarige leeftijd in stand te houden
Motie van het lid Smeulders c.s. over een arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering voor alle zzp'ers
Asks the government to include in its self-employed reform proposals a mandatory disability insurance for all self-employed workers.
requests the government, when elaborating the self-employed plans, to make proposals for a disability insurance for all self-employed workers
verzoekt de regering om, bij de uitwerking van de zzp-plannen voorstellen te doen voor een arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering voor alle zzp'ers
Motie van de leden Van Brenk en Van Rooijen over een harde ondergrens voor bescherming van werkenden
Asks that the Commission on Regulation of Work also consider the Council of State's suggestion of one uniform arrangement for all workers with a legally defined hard floor of protection.
the Council of State's analysis of labour market polarisation and social divides, and its related suggestion of one uniform arrangement for all workers
de analyse van de Raad van State over arbeidsmarktpolarisatie, sociale scheidslijnen, en de daaraan gerelateerde suggestie om te komen tot één uniforme regeling voor alle werkenden
Motie van de leden Van Brenk en Van Rooijen over een eenduidig kader voor kwalitatief goede schuldhulpverlening
Motion asks government to help develop a uniform quality framework for municipal debt assistance and a national picture of its quality.
requests the government to help develop a uniform framework on what minimum good-quality debt assistance looks like
verzoekt de regering, een eenduidig kader te helpen ontwikkelen, over hoe schuldhulpverlening van goede kwaliteit er minimaal uitziet
Motie van het lid Renkema c.s. over snelle implementatie van de Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet
Asks the government to implement the simplified protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) law as quickly as possible.
requests the government to do whatever is necessary to implement this law as quickly as possible
verzoekt de regering, alles te doen wat nodig is om deze wet zo snel mogelijk te implementeren
Amendement van de leden Van Rooijen en Van Brenk ter vervanging van nr. 19 over het afschaffen van de 30%-regeling en het LIV
Abolishes the 30% expat tax ruling for incoming workers and the low-income advantage, using the proceeds to raise the minimum wage by 3%.
With this amendment the 30% ruling and the Low Income Advantage (LIV) are abolished.
Met dit amendement worden de 30%-regeling en het Lage Inkomens Voordeel (LIV) afgeschaft.
Motie van het lid Van Rooijen over het verlagen van het afbouwpercentage van de ouderenkorting
Asks the government to lower the phase-out rate of the elderly tax credit from 15% to 5%.
requests the government to lower the phase-out rate of the elderly tax credit from 15% to 5%
verzoekt de regering, om het afbouwpercentage van de ouderenkorting te verlagen van 15% naar 5%
Motie van het lid Van Rooijen over gelijktrekken van de algemene heffingskorting voor gepensioneerden en werkenden
Asks the government to equalize the general tax credit for pensioners and working people.
requests the government to equalize the general tax credit for pensioners and workers
verzoekt de regering, de algemene heffingskorting voor gepensioneerden en werkenden gelijk te trekken
Motie van het lid Van Weyenberg c.s. over monitoren van de effecten van de afschaffing van de bpm-teruggaafregeling
Asks the government to monitor the effects of abolishing the BPM refund scheme on accessible low-emission vehicles for care and special-needs transport and report before the 2020 tax plan.
requests the government to monitor that there is sufficient and timely supply of very efficient and zero-emission vehicles for care and target-group transport
verzoekt de regering om te monitoren dat er voldoende en tijdig aanbod is van zeer zuinige en emissievrije voertuigen voor het zorg- en doelgroepenvervoer
Motie van het lid Van Rooijen over uitstellen van de Wet aanpassing kansspelbelasting voor sportweddenschappen
Asks the government to postpone the sports betting gambling tax law by one year.
requests the government to postpone the Betting Tax Adjustment Act for sports bets by one year
verzoekt de regering, de Wet aanpassing kansspelbelasting voor sportweddenschappen met één jaar uit te stellen
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van Rooijen en van Brenk ter vervanging van nr. 10 over het afschaffen van de belasting op leidingwater
Replaces an earlier amendment to abolish the water tax on tap water, removing the tax from the law and cutting the tax burden on tap water.
This amendment provides that the tax on tap water is abolished entirely.
Dit amendement regelt dat de belasting op leidingwater geheel kom te vervallen.
Amendement van de leden Van Rooijen en Van Brenk 35026-19 ter vervanging van nr. 18 over het afschaffen van de 30%-regeling en het LIV
Abolishes the 30% ruling for incoming workers and the low-income benefit (LIV), and raises the minimum wage by an extra 3%.
With this amendment the 30% ruling and the Low Income Benefit (LIV) are abolished.
Met dit amendement worden de 30%-regeling en het Lage Inkomens Voordeel (LIV) afgeschaft.
Amendement van het lid Van Rooijen over het afschaffen van de 30%-regeling en het LIV
Abolishes the 30% expatriate tax ruling and the low-income benefit (LIV) in the wage-tax bill, and raises the minimum wage by an extra 3%, without transitional rules.
With this amendment the 30% ruling and the low-income benefit (LIV) are abolished.
Met dit amendement worden de 30%-regeling en het Lage Inkomens Voordeel (LIV) afgeschaft.
Amendement van het lid Van Rooijen over het vastzetten van de AOW-leeftijd
Amends the General Old Age Pensions Act to fix the pension age at 66 from 2019 and removes the link to life expectancy, funded by reversing corporate tax cuts.
the statutory pension age in article 7a of the General Old Age Pensions Act is fixed at 66 from 1 January 2019
wordt de pensioengerechtigde leeftijd, bedoeld in artikel 7a van de Algemene Ouderdomswet, vanaf 1 januari 2019 vastgezet op 66 jaar
Amendement van de leden Van Rooijen en Van Brenk ter vervanging van nr. 9 over het afschaffen van de belasting op leidingwater
Abolishes the tax on tap water by removing the relevant chapter and tax provisions from the bill.
Amendement van het lid Van Rooijen over het afschaffen van de belasting op leidingwater
Abolishes the tax on tap water, a fiscal measure with no bearing on executive checks.
This amendment provides that the tax on tap water is abolished entirely.
Dit amendement regelt dat de belasting op leidingwater geheel kom te vervallen.
Motie van het lid van Rooijen over advies vragen aan de Raad van State over de pensioenfondsenrichtlijn
Motion asking the government to request an advisory opinion from the Raad van State on whether the revised pension fund directive conflicts with EU law.
requests the government to still ask the Raad van State for advice on whether this directive conflicts with EU law.
verzoekt de regering, alsnog de Raad van State advies te vragen of deze richtlijn strijdig is met EU-recht
Motie van het lid Van Rooijen over advies van de Raad van State over de tweede nota van wijziging
Asks the government to submit the second amendment note to the Council of State's advisory division, which it did not consult, because it may conflict with EU law.
requests the government to still submit the second nota van wijziging (Kamerstuk 34 934, nr. 11) to the Council of State's advisory division
verzoekt de regering, de tweede nota van wijziging (Kamerstuk 34 934, nr.11 ) alsnog voor te leggen aan de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Leijten c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 7 over het ongedaan maken van de afschaffing van de dividendbelasting
Amendment to reverse the abolition of the dividend tax, keeping the tax and adjusting related articles of the bill.
With this amendment the submitters reverse the abolition of the dividend tax.
Met dit amendement maken de indieners de afschaffing van de dividendbelasting ongedaan.
Amendement van het lid Leijten c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 5 over het ongedaan maken van de afschaffing van de dividendbelasting
Amendment reversing the abolition of the dividend tax by deleting the related articles and redirecting references to withholding tax.
With this amendment the submitters undo the abolition of the dividend tax.
Met dit amendement maken de indieners de afschaffing van de dividendbelasting ongedaan.

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether pension valuation rules should differ depending on the purpose of reporting (transfer of liabilities versus meeting obligations over time), and whether the risk-free rate and 97.5% security standard in the FTK are appropriate. The minister answered that the reports serve different purposes but that for a funded pension system the aims are not separable, that the 97.5% standard is not linked to transferring liabilities, and that the risk-free curve is appropriate regardless of security level, without committing to any change.
Valuing on the basis of the risk-free interest rate term structure is separate from the degree of certainty with which these pension entitlements will be met in the future.
Het waarderen op basis van de risicovrije rentetermijnstructuur staat los van de mate van zekerheid waarmee deze pensioenaanspraken en -rechten naar de toekomst worden nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over de doorrekeningen van het Klimaatakkoord

The MP asks why the PBL climate-agreement calculations use a 3% social discount rate, versus about 1.5% for pension funds, and whether climate investments are less diversified and riskier. The minister confirms the 3% social discount rate follows the government's MKBA guidance, explains it reflects a risk premium for public investment, and says pension funds use a different discount rate for valuing liabilities.
The use of the discount rate therefore gives insight into whether a public investment is sufficiently worthwhile from a societal point of view.
Het gebruik van de discontovoet geeft dus inzicht in de vraag of een publieke investering vanuit een maatschappelijk oogpunt voldoende loont.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over de brief van de minister ‘vernieuwing pensioenstelsel’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the proposed renewal of the Dutch pension system, covering funding ratios, indexation rules, the cross-subsidy problem, CPB projections, young people's trust, and lump-sum options. The minister answered all 22 questions on substance, explaining the proposed contract, rejecting some premises, and noting that negotiations reached no agreement.
Soon I will inform you about this proposal via a main-lines letter.
Binnenkort zal ik u via een hoofdlijnenbrief informeren over dit voorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Rooijen en Van Brenk over koopkrachtcijfers van het Nibud

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether half of the Dutch population would lose purchasing power in 2019, whether the CPB's standard inflation figure fits all households, and whether Nibud should translate it into household-level impacts. The minister rejects the claim, citing CPB forecasts of about 95-96% of households gaining, and defends using representative averages and Nibud's example households as an appropriate approach.
The purpose of the purchasing power forecast is to make the effects of government policy on citizens' wallets visible, given the general economic picture.
Het doel van de koopkrachtraming is om de effecten van overheidsbeleid op de portemonnee van de burger inzichtelijk te maken, gegeven het algemeen economische beeld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Omtzigt, Lodders, Bisschop en Van Rooijen over een keurpunt voor levend vee voor de Brexit en de extra capaciteit bij de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA)

MPs asked whether the minister had led a public-private effort to set up live-animal inspection posts at Dutch seaports before a no-deal Brexit, and about NVWA staffing and preparedness. The minister replied that applications were sent to the European Commission before the 15 February deadline, that exact locations are confidential, that the NVWA has hired 100 of 143 needed staff, and that service levels may have to be adjusted for about a year.
I cannot go into the precise numbers and locations because of the confidentiality of this information.
Op de precieze aantallen en locaties kan ik niet in gaan in verband met de vertrouwelijkheid van deze informatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Linde, Bruins, Stoffer, Tony van Dijck, Leijten, Baudet en Van Rooijen over de brief van de Minister van Financiën d.d. 5 februari 2019 over het op handen zijnde akkoord b

MPs asked the Finance Minister when the PEPP pension regulation would be finalised, what delegated acts it contains, whether Dutch pension rules could be affected without Dutch influence, and whether the Netherlands will oppose it. The minister said the Netherlands cannot agree to the negotiated text because of the number of delegated-act powers and the EIOPA role, though the second-pillar pension system and tax rules are unaffected, and that the Chamber's view will be weighed in the vote.

As I announced in my letter of 5 February, I informed the Romanian presidency yesterday that the Netherlands cannot agree to the negotiated text of the PEPP regulation at Coreper this coming Wednesday.

Zoals ik in mijn brief van 5 februari jl. heb aangekondigd, heb ik gisteren aan het Roemeense voorzitterschap kenbaar gemaakt dat Nederland op Coreper aanstaande woensdag niet kan instemmen met het onderhandelaarsakkoord inzake de PEPP-verordening.

The minister answered that sociale partners must agree compensation, the government offers tax room and transition frameworks but no legal obligation or state backstop, and it will not adjust the discount rules or existing contract.
I am therefore not willing to start tinkering with separate levers within the existing contract, because this would disturb the intergenerational balance within the system.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid om aan aparte knoppen te gaan draaien binnen het bestaande contract, omdat dit het generatie-evenwicht binnen het stelsel verstoort.

The ministers reject the criticism, argue the power is a narrow, one-year transitional measure justified by Brexit's unprecedented nature and that the Council of State endorsed it, and say they will consider an amendment based on Chamber feedback.
We will, based on the views of the Chamber and further reactions from society, benevolently consider whether an amendment note is appropriate.

The minister agrees finding these pensions is good, stresses privacy protection must be balanced, promises talks with the sector and says a legal change may be proposed in 2019 if necessary.
I will shortly enter into discussions with the sector to find a suitable solution for the bottlenecks experienced.
Ik zal op korte termijn in gesprek gaan met de sector om een passende oplossing te vinden voor de knelpunten die worden ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over de tweede nota van wijziging bij wet 34 934

MP Van Rooijen asks why the distinction between domestic and cross-border pension transfers is compatible with EU free movement rules and whether the directive conflicts with the TFEU, and questions the two-thirds approval requirement in the second amendment. The minister answers that purely internal situations fall outside the freedoms, that the Council of State raised no legal objections, and that a two-thirds majority is permitted under the directive and appropriate.
The distinction was moreover already included in the bill submitted to the Council of State's Advisory Division.
Het onderscheid was bovendien reeds opgenomen in het wetsvoorstel dat is voorgelegd aan de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van Rooijen, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Kuzu over de uitvoering van de motie inzake Magnitsky-sancties

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he had formally proposed an EU human rights sanctions regime, how other member states reacted, and why he doubts a national Magnitsky-style regime would be effective, as well as whether he will implement the Omtzigt motion. The minister answered that he proposed an EU global human rights sanctions regime at the Gymnich meeting, that some states were positive and none openly negative, that a formal proposal is deferred until support exists, that a national regime would be ineffective given Schengen, and that he will pursue the EU route and report after a November meeting.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is organising a senior-official meeting in November for EU member states and like-minded countries to further develop the concept of a human rights sanctions regime.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken organiseert in november een hoogambtelijke bijeenkomst voor EU-lidstaten en enkele gelijkgezinde landen om het concept van een mensenrechtensanctieregime verder te ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Rooijen en Van Brenk over het bericht dat bijna een kwart miljoen senioren het risico lopen zorg- of huurtoeslag te missen

Two MPs from 50PLUS asked whether a Regioplan report showing that many seniors may be missing out on healthcare or rent allowances is accurate, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary says the percentages cannot be confirmed, names causes of non-take-up and promises an interdepartmental policy study of the allowance system, without committing to specific measures.
The cabinet recognises that there are citizens who do not use allowances although they may be entitled to them.
Het kabinet herkent en onderkent dat er burgers zijn die geen gebruik maken van toeslagen terwijl ze er mogelijk wel recht op hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Rooijen en Van Brenk over het artikel ‘Verhoog de BTW op drinkwater niet’

Two opposition MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a press piece opposing a VAT increase on drinking water, asking about the price effect, the tax structure, exempting drinking water, and cutting the water levy. The State Secretary confirmed the VAT rise from 6% to 9% would raise water prices by three percentage points, rejected exempting water from the single reduced rate, and said the government will not lower or abolish the water levy.
The cabinet does not intend to lower or abolish the levy on tap water.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens om de belasting op leidingwater te verlagen dan wel af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over het Twitterbericht van voormalig minister van Financiën Dijsselbloem over zijn lidmaatschap van de partij van de Franse President Emmanuel Macron

MP Van Rooijen asked the Prime Minister whether former Finance Minister Dijsselbloem's membership of Macron's En Marche movement, and his stance on ministers joining foreign parties, was acceptable. The Prime Minister answered that the choice was Dijsselbloem's own, that En Marche was not yet a party when he joined in 2016, and that the French elections do not change his views.
The choice to get involved with a political movement in formation was Mr Dijsselbloem's own.
De keuze voor betrokkenheid bij een politieke beweging in oprichting is er een van de heer Dijsselbloem zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over de stijging van de huizenprijzen

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Finance Minister whether faster-than-expected house price rises exceed forecasts and what the consequences are for the Treasury, the EWF forfait, municipal property tax and housing supply. The minister confirmed the WOZ-value rise is now projected at about 8.5% versus 7% previously, said the EWF revenue estimate stays roughly unchanged because the rate falls as WOZ values rise, and noted municipalities set property tax rates autonomously.
There is indeed a difference between the expected rise in the WOZ value for 2018 estimated at the end of 2017 and what is currently expected.
Er is inderdaad sprake van een verschil tussen de verwachte stijging van de WOZ-waarde in 2018 die eind 2017 geraamd werd en momenteel verwacht wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over het bericht dat consultant Aon in België goedkeuring heeft gekregen voor een eigen regelkader voor pensioenfondsen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that consultant Aon obtained approval in Belgium for its own prudential framework for pension funds, and whether Dutch funds relocating there would gain higher funding ratios and indexation, and what measures would prevent such moves. The minister said the Belgian framework is more principle-based so effects on funding ratios cannot be generalised, that the government sees no evidence of mass relocations to evade supervision, and that the matter is for employers and social partners, while pointing to pension reform work within the SER.
For now, the government has no indications that this is the case.
Vooralsnog heeft de regering geen aanwijzingen dat hiervan sprake is.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over het vervallen van de ANW-compensatieregeling bij het ABP

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Interior Minister about the end of the ANW-compensation scheme at the ABP pension fund and what had been done since earlier postponement and promises to help affected participants. The minister answered that the scheme was extended and broadened for those uninsurable, that sectors took initiatives like ANW supplementary insurance, and declined further action because pension rules are a matter for social partners.
Are you willing to take additional action toward the ABP to still force tangible results for the affected participants?
Bent u bereid aanvullende actie te ondernemen richting het ABP om alsnog tastbare resultaten af te dwingen voor de getroffen deelnemers?

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Leijten en Van Rooijen over het feit dat de Raad van de Europese Unie geen enkel antwoord geeft op de aanbevelingen van de Europees Ombudsman over transparantie en geheimhouding e

MPs Omtzigt, Leijten and Van Rooijen asked why the EU Council has not responded to the European Ombudsman's February 2018 recommendations on transparency and secrecy in its working documents, which they argued breaches the EU treaty. The Minister replied that no formal treaty deadline binds the Council, that the Netherlands pressed for a timely reply, and that a substantive Council response is expected in early July 2018.
Formally, no obligation arises from Article 228 TFEU for the Council to send its position to the European Ombudsman within three months.
Antwoord 3 Formeel vloeit er geen verplichting voor de Raad voort uit artikel 228 VWEU om binnen drie maanden een antwoord om de Europese Ombudsman zijn standpunt mede te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol en Van Rooijen over het bericht “Riet Zaal gecompenseerd, volgens pensioenfonds PMT alleen vanwege verkeerde communicatie”

Two 50PLUS MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that pension fund PMT compensated Riet Zaal only because of miscommunication, and whether other members could be similarly harmed, including by a confidentiality clause and a lost-records issue. The minister answers that PMT says the case is specific to Zaal, that pension funds should be transparent but confidentiality is a matter for the parties, that funds handle complaints first with the Pensions Ombudsman and courts as fallback, and that the 1980s fire had limited effects.
According to PMT, this concerns the specific situation of Mrs Zaal, and there is no reason to assume a comparable situation exists for other pension fund participants.

Volgens PMT betreft dit de specifieke situatie van mevrouw Zaal en is er geen aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat een vergelijkbare situatie aan de orde zou zijn voor andere deelnemers van pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over de open brief van de organisatie NHIB (Nederlanders in het Buitenland)

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about an open letter from NIHB on closing consulates and passport services abroad, including the travel costs, the risk of losing Dutch nationality for those unable to renew, and why ombudsman complaints have not improved service. The minister acknowledges the burden, points to mobile options, Schiphol and other border municipalities, a pilot with a commercial provider in Edinburgh, and modernisation toward digitisation by 2020, but does not commit to specific reversals.
The cabinet has a positive basic attitude towards expanding this service, also in light of the specific wishes from the House
Het kabinet heeft een positieve grondhouding ten aanzien van de uitbreiding van deze dienstverlening, ook in het licht van de specifieke wensen vanuit de Kamer

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Leijten en Van Rooijen over het transparantie initiatief, ondertekend door 26 delegaties van commissies voor Europese aangelegenheden uit de parlementen van de lidstaten van de Eu

MPs Omtzigt, Leijten and Van Rooijen asked whether the Dutch representative handed the COSAC transparency report to the Bulgarian presidency, whether all member states received it, what comments exist, when it will be on the agenda, and whether the government has actively pushed for its proposals. The minister confirmed the handover, said the initiators were responsible for distribution, stated no comments had been made and the Council's reaction will come later, and said the government has raised the topic and will seek a suitable moment to put it on the General Affairs Council agenda.
The cabinet will endeavour to put the subject of transparency on the General Affairs Council agenda at a suitable moment, in consultation with the presidency.
Het kabinet zal zich inspannen om het onderwerp van transparantie, in samenspraak met het voorzitterschap, op een geëigend moment te agenderen voor de Raad Algemene Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over het bericht ‘Franse regering wil strengere regels voor Bitcoin'

Van Rooijen (50PLUS) asked the Finance Minister whether he shares French concerns that crypto-assets enable tax evasion and terrorism financing, whether crypto investment should be regulated like other high-risk products, and whether the Netherlands will join France's international initiative. Minister Hoekstra agreed the risks are real, said a ban is unenforceable so crypto should be brought under a regulatory framework, and committed to pursue coordinated EU and G20 action and consumer-protection steps.
The Netherlands supports this initiative and wants to play a leading role in the European and international approach to crypto-assets.
Nederland steunt dit initiatief en wil een voortrekkersrol spelen binnen de Europese en internationale aanpak van cryptovaluta.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over de aantallen belastingplichtigen met lage inkomens die worden geraakt door de uitfasering van de aftrek wegens geen of geringe eigenwoningschuld

An MP asked how many low-income taxpayers (income under 20,000 euro) benefit from the Hillen deduction by WOZ value, given the phase-out of the deduction for homeowners with little or no mortgage debt. The state secretary provided a table showing 173,000 such households, and argued that many have substantial box 3 wealth and that the overall effect is limited once other tax measures are considered.
That table shows, as also presented above by WOZ value, that of the households using the Hillen deduction, 173,000 (19%) had an income up to 20,000 euro.
Uit die tabel blijkt, zoals ook hiervoor weergegeven per WOZ-waarde, dat van de huishoudens die gebruikmaken van de Hillen-aftrek, er 173.000 (19%) een inkomen hadden tot € 20.000.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over het vervallen van de Anw-compensatieregeling bij het Algemeen Burgerlijk pensioenfonds (ABP)

Van Rooijen (50PLUS) asked the Minister of Interior whether the government supports ABP's call for social partners to create a collective insurance replacing the abolished Anw-compensation scheme, and whether ABP should postpone the change by a year. The minister answered that social partners asked ABP to extend the transitional coulance arrangement by three months to 1 May 2018, which ABP accepted, and that pension content is for employers and employees to decide.
No. Employees and employers decide on the content of the pension scheme.
Nee. Werknemers en werkgevers gaan over de inhoud van de pensioenregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over het vervallen van de ANW-compensatieregeling bij het Algemeen Burgerlijk pensioenfonds (ABP)

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the ABP pension fund's abolition of the ANW-compensation scheme, including how many members are affected, whether they can get alternative insurance, and whether a longer transition period should be given. The minister answered that the change follows a social-partner agreement, that about 15,000 people currently receive the compensation, and that members can insure themselves until 1 February 2018, while not committing to a longer transition.
It is up to the ABP to inform the participant about the changes to the pension scheme agreed by employees and employers.
Het is aan het ABP om de deelnemer te informeren over de – door werknemers en werkgevers overeengekomen – wijzigingen in de pensioenregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over fiscale aspecten van specifieke uitkeringen op grond van de Duitse wet

MP Van Rooijen asked why the German ghetto pension is taxed in the Netherlands while Germany exempts it, whether it should be treated like Artikel 2-Fonds benefits, and asked for the Landsadvocaat's advice. The State Secretary confirmed the Dutch taxation under progression reservation, defended the different treatment of Artikel 2-Fonds benefits, and refused to release the advice as not customary.
It is not customary to share a Landsadvocaat's advice with the House of Representatives.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om een advies van de landsadvocaat te delen met de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Van Rooijen over het bericht “aantal afgekeurde ouderen stijgt sterk; voor zware beroepen komt pensioen te laat”

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that disability awards among older workers have risen sharply, especially in heavy occupations where retirement is delayed, and about the lack of progress on a heavy-occupations scheme from the 2011 pension agreement, plus CPB projections and the net fiscal effect of raising the AOW age. The State Secretary answered that the rise reflects more older workers and higher average age rather than a failure of policy, that a heavy-occupations definition has proven difficult and is being explored with social partners, that the AOW age increase still improves public finances, and that flexibility and employer-employee solutions are to be encouraged.
It is known that the chance of entering the WIA disability scheme increases as an employee gets older.
Het is bekend dat de kans om de WIA in te stromen, toeneemt naarmate een werknemer ouder is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Thieme, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Knops, Karabulut en Van Rooijen over repressieve maatregelen tegen de oppositie door de regering van Wit-Rusland

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister about repressive measures against the opposition in Belarus, including arrests of demonstrators and Christian Democrat leaders around the 25 March protest. The minister said the Belarusian authorities' measures were disproportionate, that Nederland raised concerns via EU statements and with the Belarusian ambassador, and that the issue was discussed in the OSCE Permanent Council.
In the cabinet's view, the measures of the Belarusian authorities are not proportionate.
De maatregelen van de Wit-Russische autoriteiten zijn in de ogen van het kabinet niet proportioneel.

qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldkamp, Olger van Dijk en Van Hijum over de toegenomen onveiligheid op de treindienst Zwolle-Emmen

Three NSC MPs asked why incidents of fare evasion and violence against rail staff on the Zwolle-Emmen line rose in early 2024, and what measures, cameras, travel bans and COA-related steps are being taken. The government answered that the rise largely reflects more systematic checks by the service team, that Arriva is reinstating two stewards per train, that camera discussions will continue, and that a national travel ban was ruled out on proportionality grounds while operators explore faster temporary bans.
