No figures are available on the nationalities of the persons causing the incidents.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over de nationaliteiten van de personen die de incidenten veroorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht ‘Maastricht en provincie Limburg slepen Vlaanderen definitief voor rechter en eisen miljoenen voor schrappen tramlijn’

MPs De Hoop asked whether Flanders unilaterally ended the Maastricht-Hasselt tram project, what the ministry's role was, and whether the €36.7 million in national funds would be redirected to other regional mobility projects. The minister answered that the ministry is only a subsidy provider, that the Flemish-Dutch arrangement is for the province to resolve, and that the AROV agreement is being terminated with the funds returned to the ministry, with ongoing talks on regional accessibility.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management has no formal role in this.
Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat heeft hierin geen formele rol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Olger van Dijk en Zeedijk over de Nationale Circulaire Plastic

MPs Olger van Dijk and Zeedijk asked the government about the planned recyclate blending norm for plastics, its EU alignment, competitive effects, recyclate supply and certification. The minister answered that the norm bill is still under review after consultation, that the EU is advancing product-specific recyclate requirements, and that EUR 267 million in subsidies is available, while many questions were deferred to a new cabinet or later regulations.
The decision to be based on this is for the new cabinet.
Het hierop te baseren besluit is aan het nieuwe kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over de plannen van de Waalse overheid om mijnbouw te vergunnen, vlak over de grens bij Vaals

An MP asked the minister whether Walloon plans to permit mining just across the border near Vaals were known and whether the Netherlands was involved, along with groundwater and environmental impact questions and avenues for Dutch participation. The minister answered that no concrete permit application exists, that the Netherlands asked in 2019 to be involved under the Espoo Convention, and that transboundary EIA and public participation rights apply once a concrete application is filed.
In addition, participation is also possible on a concrete permit application and on the decision of the competent authority thereon.
Daarnaast is ook op een concrete vergunningaanvraag en het besluit van het bevoegd gezag daarop inspraak mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het NOS-artikel van 16 februari 2024: ‘Prorail: “Vervangen spoor Vroomshoop kost mogelijk miljoenen”’

An SP MP asked the government about the costs of replacing asbestos roofs after a fire near Vroomshoop, including insurance coverage, who pays for cleanup when owners cannot, and loans and other support for roof owners. The minister answered that the government has no insight into insurer conditions, that the owner is primarily liable for cleanup, that a loan fund exists for low-income private owners with a possible wider opening under study, and that a communication programme with advisory support is starting.
The Ministry of IenW has no insight into the extent to which insurers provide coverage, nor into the owners' own resources.
Het Ministerie van IenW heeft geen zicht op de mate waarin verzekeraars dekking bieden en evenmin over de eigen middelen van de eigenaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de Dual Fuel tractoren van Blue Fuel Solutions

An MP asks why the RDW has not yet type-approved Blue Fuel Solutions' dual-fuel hydrogen tractors despite contact since 2021, why registrations were withdrawn, and what route (Article 35 procedure) and emissions testing are needed. The Staatssecretaris answers that an Article 35 procedure with emissions tests is required, that registrations were issued wrongly as diesel vehicles, that the EU-level route is preferred and that talks with the initiator and RDW continue.
I am still awaiting the results of these emissions tests.
Ik ben nog in afwachting van de resultaten van deze emissietesten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over asfaltcentrales

MP Gabriëls asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about community concerns over asphalt plants, emission measurement frequency, continuous monitoring, covering raw materials, and energy use in public procurement. The State Secretary answered that permitting and enforcement lie with local authorities, that a minimum yearly measurement regime for PAHs and benzene is proposed, that continuous measurement is deemed too costly, and that the Deventer case and enforcement details are for municipalities to decide.
Permitting, supervision and enforcement concerning asphalt plants is the responsibility of the local competent authority.
Vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving rondom asfaltcentrales is aan het lokaal bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht 'Inruim 400 woonwijken ligt tot 10.000 kilo vuurwerk opgeslagen: 'Dat is 400 keer heel gevaarlijk''

MP Van Nispen asked about reports that up to 10,000 kg of fireworks are stored in about 400 residential neighbourhoods, and about the Twente report on fireworks disasters, brigade firefighting instructions, and whether storage in residential areas should be banned. The government answers that storage rules (sprinklers, fire walls, 8-metre distance) apply, that a joint cabinet response to the Twente report is in preparation, that evacuation is now the priority in fireworks fires, and that it will inform parliament before the summer recess on whether rules should be tightened.
Parliament will be informed about this before the summer recess.
Uw Kamer wordt hier voor het zomerreces over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Olger van Dijk over statiegeld

An MP asked the state secretary about ILT's enforcement against Verpact for missing the 90% bottle-collection target, including a possible increase of deposit to €0.50, impact analysis, and extension to juice and dairy bottles. The state secretary answered that the enforcement is ongoing with proposed penalties, that the deposit level is one lever to be reviewed in an evaluation in 2024, and that the extension to juice and dairy is not current policy but will be examined.
It is important to note that the process is ongoing and currently concerns an intention to impose an order subject to penalty.
Hierbij is het van belang om te benoemen dat het traject in uitvoering is en dat het momenteel een voornemen tot last onder dwangsom betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostic´ over de noodzakelijke verbeteringen aan het statiegeldsysteem

An MP asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management why deposit-return collection rates for plastic bottles and cans fall short of the 90% legal target, why producer organisation Verpact communicates favourable figures, and what will be done about the slow timeline and the deposit regulation. The State Secretary answers that official reporting is not yet available, that the ILT has started enforcement and a notice of intent to impose penalties, and that the deposit regulation will be evaluated in 2024 with possible legislative changes deferred to a new cabinet.
Later this year I will receive official figures for 2023, which should show whether and what improvement has occurred.
Later dit jaar ontvang ik officiële cijfers over 2023, waaruit moet blijken of en welke verbetering is opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen, Hermans en Erkens over de vergunningverlening bij DOW naar aanleiding van het artikel 'Hoe een groen megaproject muurvast zit door ruzie Dow en overheid’

MPs Erkens, Hermans and Thijssen asked ministers about stalled permitting for Dow Chemical's planned hydrogen-based decarbonisation investment, reportedly blocked by nitrogen emission limits and conflict with government. The minister answered that talks continue, that initial plans exceeded the 80 mg/Nm3 nitrogen limit, that Dow is preparing revised plans, and that a permitting solution will be sought before further updates to parliament.
I will inform your House further about progress via the progress report on the tailor-made approach.
Ik zal uw Kamer nader informeren over de voortgang via de voortgangsrapportage maatwerkaanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Meulenkamp over het mogelijk maken van resomeren

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Interior and the State Secretary for Infrastructure about delays in legalising alkaline hydrolysis (resomation) and the planned modernisation of the Burial Act. The Minister agrees with the urgency, says the bill is delayed by complexity and will be consulted in the first half of 2024, and refuses to tolerate the practice in advance of legislation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Kostić over ‘de toelating van glyfosaat met tien jaar verlengen’

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked the state secretary about scientific criticism of the glyphosate renewal, the precautionary principle, and whether the Netherlands should oppose or ban glyphosate in Europe. The government defends the EFSA and Ctgb assessments finding no causal link to Parkinson's or cancer, acknowledges public concern, commissions RIVM research, but refuses to vote against or push for an EU ban.
That is why the Minister of Agriculture has called on the European Commission to develop a specific assessment framework for evaluating neurodegenerative effects.
Daarom heeft de Minister van LNV de Europese Commissie opgeroepen om specifiek toetsingskader te ontwikkelen voor de beoordeling van neurodegeneratieve effecten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht Nieuwe sof voor treinreizigers: Nederland verliest directe spoorverbinding met Zwitserland

Bamenga (D66) asked the state secretary about the loss of the direct Amsterdam-Basel train, including its climate impact, whether NS and German and Swiss authorities can keep the link, and what support new international operators will get. The state secretary says international services move to open access from 2025, a new Munich service replaces Basel, the government will facilitate new operators without direct intervention, and exact passenger and emissions figures are not available.
I do not have the exact figures on the number of train passengers, also because this involves commercially sensitive information from various operators in different countries.
Over de exacte cijfers van het aantal treinreizigers beschik ik niet, ook omdat het hier gaat om bedrijfsgevoelige informatie van verschillende vervoerders in verschillende landen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over afstemming bij de beantwoording van vragen over granuliet en granietzand

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management which departments must be consulted before answering earlier questions on granulite and granite sand, and why ongoing civil lawsuits would require extra coordination. The State Secretary replied that internal departments were consulted, that the lawsuits do not affect the answers, and that the answers will be sent as soon as carefully possible.
The answers to your questions of 28 March 2024 on granulite and granite sand will be sent to you as soon as carefully possible.
De beantwoording van uw vragen van 28 maart 2024 over granuliet en granietzand zal ik u zo spoedig als zorgvuldig mogelijk doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Veltman over het bericht 'Een derde van Gronings dorpje bezoekt dokter vanwege klachten windturbines'

MPs Erkens and Veltman asked about wind turbine distance and noise norms after a report that a third of a Groningen village visited a doctor over turbine complaints, including the status of the draft decree, the motion on a four-times-tip-height distance norm, and whether projects should be paused. The ministers answered that national norms are in draft with planned entry into force on 1 July 2025, that municipalities may set local norms via environmental assessment, and that no pause is warranted as the Nivel study shows no clear health risks.
To prevent delay, I aim to submit the draft decree to your House as soon as possible, expectedly after the summer.
Om vertraging te voorkomen probeer ik zo spoedig mogelijk, naar verwachting na de zomer, het ontwerpbesluit bij uw Kamer voor te hangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller Waterstaat over het bericht '65 miljoen euro schade door ontplofte lachgascilinders, kabinet overweegt compensatie'

An MP asked the government about explosions at waste processors caused by discarded nitrous oxide cylinders, the resulting 65 million euro in damage, and whether the state will compensate waste companies and municipalities. The government says the explosions stem from illegal disposal, that a direct national compensation is not appropriate and not feasible, and that it will inform the House separately while exploring producer responsibility options.
The cabinet has indicated it is willing to explore whether a financial contribution is possible for measures that help mitigate the risks in the waste sector.

Het kabinet heeft aangegeven bereid te zijn te verkennen of een financiële tegemoetkoming mogelijk is voor het treffen van maatregelen die bijdragen aan het mitigeren van de risico's in de afvalbranche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over te hoge boetes voor studentenreisproducten.

An MP asks about a court ruling that DUO did too little to prevent former students from accruing unnecessary public transport fines after their student travel product should have been stopped, and why it is still not automatic. The minister says DUO is appealing, describes the 30-day blacklist delay and planned OV-pas migration, gives a 2013-2023 fine table, and declines to commit to an investigation or compensation while the case is pending.
I cannot respond to a pending court case.
Ik kan niet reageren op een lopende rechtszaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de verhouding tussen artikel 6 van de Kaderrichtlijn afvalstoffen en de EVOA-verordening

MP Stoffer (SGP) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management whether materials that lose waste status under Article 6 of the Waste Framework Directive still fall under the EU Waste Shipment Regulation, and whether export distinctions or explicit receiving-country consent are required. The State Secretary answered that end-of-waste materials fall outside waste law, that in disputes the strictest classification (treated as waste) applies under EVOA Article 28, and that no export distinction or consent requirement follows from Article 6 itself.
In case of disagreement between competent authorities on international waste shipments, Article 28 of the EU Waste Shipment Regulation (EVOA) requires that the strictest classification be followed.

Bij een verschil van inzicht tussen bevoegde gezagen voor internationale afvaltransporten schrijft artikel 28 van Europese Verordening Overbrenging Afvalstoffen (EVOA) voor dat de strengste indeling moet worden gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over hinder op het spoor door vergeten werkzaamheden

An MP asked the state secretary about the sudden rail disruption around Schiphol on 8 March 2024 caused by forgotten rust-removal work, and how ProRail handled communication and prevention. The state secretary acknowledged the poor notice to passengers, said ProRail regrets the error and is sharpening its process, but did not commit to a specific guarantee beyond that.
ProRail has informed me that it regrets this and wants to learn from it.
ProRail heeft mij laten weten dat ze dit betreurt en dat ze hiervan wil leren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić, Koekkoek, Bamenga, Gabriëls en Thijssen over Tata Steel en de HUMAN documentaire STAAL

MPs from PvdD, Volt, D66 and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the state secretary about the HUMAN documentary STAAL on Tata Steel, including alleged concealment of emissions, the reliability of company emission data, citizen-operated cameras, health ultimatums and the dismissal and rehiring of a critical employee. The state secretary answered that emissions must fall, that the government will seek faster health-focused agreements with Tata Steel, and that enforcement and monitoring lie with the provincial authority and the Omgevingsdienst, while declining to judge several specific allegations.
Enforcement and supervision of Tata Steel is a task of the competent authority, the province of Noord-Holland.
Handhaving en toezicht op Tata Steel is een taak van het bevoegd gezag, de provincie Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over “de chaos bij busvervoerder EBS”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about service cuts and disruption at bus operator EBS in Flevoland, Gelderland, Overijssel and Noord-Holland, including staff shortages, vehicle faults, and whether concessions could be taken in-house by provinces. The State Secretary answered that the concession authorities manage the operator, that the reduced timetable is temporary with staff recruitment underway, that tendering has improved public transport, and that in-house takeover would require a change to the Wet personenvervoer 2000 which is not currently planned.
The decentralised public transport authorities, as concession grantors, are competent to amend or enforce the agreements made with operators in concessions.
De decentrale ov-autoriteiten zijn als concessieverleners bevoegd om de afspraken die in concessies worden gemaakt met vervoerders te wijzigen dan wel te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over de situatie op station Maarssen over een langdurig defecte lift

MP Bamenga asked the state secretary whether accessible public transport is a right, how often lifts are out of service, whether monitoring covers short outages and tram/bus/metro lifts, and what measures will reduce long-term lift failures. The state secretary answered that ProRail is responsible for maintenance, that NS and ProRail have agreed to provide alternative transport for stranded passengers, that a real-time monitoring system is in test, and that measures against vandalism and water damage are underway.
I remain in discussion with ProRail to take further measures to resolve this problem.
Ik blijf in gesprek met ProRail om verdere maatregelen te treffen om deze problematiek te verhelpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veltman over het bericht "Netbeheerder: elektrische auto's niet opladen tussen 16.00 en 21.00 uur”

An MP asks the state secretary about a report that grid operator Stedin wants EV charging halted during the 16:00-21:00 evening peak, and how this fits the Elektriciteitswet and the national charging agenda. The government acknowledges the risk of grid overload, says charging must remain possible at all times, and points to shared smart-charging agreements and the handreiking netbewust laden, while noting that the final decision lies with charge-point operators and concession grantors.
I am of the view that electric charging must be possible at any time of the day.
Ik ben van mening dat elektrisch laden op ieder moment van de dag mogelijk moet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veltman en Kisteman over de zero-emissiezones

MPs Veltman and Kisteman asked the state secretary about zero-emission zones, including the exemption for small businesses requested in a motion, the timing of the Central ZE-zones exemption counter, and the risk of small businesses disappearing from the streets. The state secretary answered that an extra exemption for certain older vans has been agreed, that the counter is being prepared to open by 1 July 2024 with municipalities, and that existing exemption categories cover those who cannot yet transition.
That is why I am working with the RDW and the municipalities to have a functioning counter ready from 1 July 2024.
Daarom zet ik mij samen met de RDW en de gemeenten in om al vanaf 1 juli 2024 een functionerend loket gereed te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over het bericht 'Thom kwam met z’n rolstoel wel de Domtoren op, maar station Maarssen is 'onmogelijke horde''

MPs Van der Plas and Pierik asked about repeated elevator and escalator failures at Maarssen station and whether ProRail and the state meet their accessibility duties. The state secretary said real-time elevator data is being rolled out gradually, that ProRail provides alternative travel advice when elevators fail, and that the Maarssen elevator was repaired on 1 March with the escalator expected back around 22 March.

Following your earlier written questions of 25 August 2023, it was stated that general information will be added to the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management website on accessibility facilities in station buildings

Naar aanleiding van uw eerdere schriftelijke vragen d.d. 25 augustus 2023 is meegedeeld dat algemene informatie zal worden toegevoegd op de website van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat over toegankelijkheidsvoorzieningen in stationsgebouwen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić, Teunissen en Beckerman over belastingontwijking door bedrijven zoals Chemours

Three MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax avoidance by Chemours, including whether its low corporate tax payments reflect transfer pricing and whether the Tax Authority supervises it. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual tax files under confidentiality rules, explained loss offset and arm's-length transfer pricing in general terms, and set out measures against tax avoidance and conduit companies.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot discuss individual tax files.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de AWR kan ik niet ingaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over aanhoudende problemen met het busvervoer van Arriva in Twente

An SP MP asked the state secretary about persistent problems with Arriva bus services in Twente, including high workload, high trip cancellations, and passenger compensation after the concession change. The state secretary largely deferred to the province and operator and the social partners, promising talks with the sector and unions but declining a direct role in working conditions.
I have no role in the discussions about working conditions.
Ik heb geen rol in de gesprekken over de arbeidsvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over microplastics

An MP asked the state secretary how the EU REACH restriction on intentionally added microplastics is being enforced in the Netherlands, including the lack of enforcement against glitter and small plastic products still on sale. The state secretary said the ILT and NVWA are responsible for supervision, promoted awareness and guidance, opposed a positive list, and said the Commission is preparing a Q&A document.
The ILT starts preparing supervision of compliance with the REACH restriction on loose glitters and microplastics in 2024.
De ILT start in 2024 met de voorbereiding van toezicht op de naleving van de restrictie onder de REACH-verordening op losse glitters en microplastics.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de gevolgen van recente branden waarbij asbest is vrijgekomen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management and the Minister of Social Affairs about the health risks and clean-up after recent asbestos-releasing fires, including whether workers cleaning up in Vroomshoop lacked protective equipment and how often such fires occur. The government answered that local authorities and implementing bodies are responsible for safety measures, clean-up and resident information, that asbestos-fire incidents are not centrally registered, that the Arbeidsinspectie found no reports of unprotected workers, and that it will inform parliament before summer on encouraging removal of asbestos roofs.
The number of fires in which asbestos is released is not centrally registered.
Het aantal branden waarbij asbest vrij komt, wordt niet centraal geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veltman en Olger van Dijk over het bericht 'Geweld tegen NS-medewerkers weer toegenomen, 'schokkend en onacceptabel''

MPs Veltman and Olger van Dijk asked the infrastructure state secretary about reports of rising violence against NS staff, whether the 'Aanvalsplan veilig met de trein' is needed, how other countries handle this, the status of the related motion, progress with the Justice ministry and carriers, NS's extra measures, and bodycams. The state secretary attributes the rise to wider social hardening and to homeless, confused and intoxicated people, condemns the violence, describes an action programme with carriers, police and the Justice ministry and existing measures, and says bodycam pilots have positive experiences.
In doing so, I share your sense that the parties involved need to step up their efforts to halt these developments.
Ik onderschrijf daarbij uw gevoel dat vanuit de betrokken partijen extra inzet nodig is om de ontwikkelingen een halt toe te roepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over olievervuiling op Bonaire

An MP from the SP asked the cabinet about oil pollution on the coast of Bonaire, including the environmental damage, the source (possibly the abandoned tanker Gulfstream), and whether the owner can be held liable. The government answered that the impact on nature appears limited for now, the long-term damage is not yet known, the situation is said to be under control, and liability is still being examined because the ship's owner has not been identified.
It is being examined whether there are possibilities to recover the damage.
Er wordt bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn om schade te kunnen verhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Grinwis en Bikker over het bericht ‘NS verbiedt christelijke jongeren flyers uit te delen op Utrecht Centraal: ‘Dit is propaganda’’

Three ChristenUnie MPs asked whether NS's ban on Christian youths handing out evangelism flyers at Utrecht Centraal, which NS called propaganda, restricts religious and expression freedom, and why pro-Palestine demonstrations there were not stopped. The minister replied that NS and ProRail may enforce station house rules requiring permission for distributing texts regardless of content, that the assessment belongs to NS and local authorities, and that he will not comment on their earlier decisions.
It is not for me to enter into the assessment that NS security and service staff made on site.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de afweging die de veiligheid- en servicemedewerkers van NS ter plaatse hebben gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het opheffen van de directe treinverbinding tussen Enschede en Deventer en Schiphol

MPs Grinwis and Vedder asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the temporary removal of the direct Enschede/Deventer–Schiphol train, its duration, the decision process, and infrastructure bottlenecks at Deventer. The State Secretary answered that the change is temporary and tied to HSL speed restrictions and delayed ICNG deliveries, that NS and ProRail have been urged to restore the link quickly, and that a Deventer infrastructure solution is not yet realistic and awaits a new cabinet.
I have called on NS and ProRail to keep the change to the timetable between Enschede and Deventer and Schiphol as short as possible.
Ik heb NS en ProRail opgeroepen om de aanpassing in de dienstregeling tussen Enschede en Deventer en Schiphol van zo kort mogelijke duur te laten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de impact van lozingen op het IJsselmeer

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the minister about reports that toxic discharges into the IJsselmeer endanger drinking water, including indirect industrial discharges via sewers, weak permit and enforcement control, and the Grip op indirecte lozingen pilot. The minister replied that water quality has generally improved, that a broader review of the VTH permitting, supervision and enforcement system with water boards is planned, and that a pilot report is expected in spring 2024.

At the legislative consultation on water on 29 January 2024 the Chamber was promised that the ministry, together with the water boards, would investigate the functioning of the permitting, supervision and enforcement system.

Tijdens het wetgevingsoverleg Water op 29 januari 2024 is aan de Kamer toegezegd dat het ministerie onder meer samen met de waterschappen een onderzoek gaat doen naar het functioneren van het stelsel van vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de problemen met communicatiesystemen aan boord van bussen bij Qbuzz

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reported failures of on-board communication systems (IVU-box) on Qbuzz buses, raising safety concerns, a union survey of drivers, and whether an Arbeidsinspectie investigation should follow. The state secretary answered that safety was never at risk, that only the payment system had occasional start-up delays, that the matter is governed by concession agreements between the concession authority and operator, and that no inspectorate investigation is warranted.
I therefore see no reason to have an investigation carried out into the functioning of the IVU-box based on these findings.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om op basis van deze bevindingen een onderzoek te laten verrichten naar de werking van de IVU-box.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht Nieuw plastic is goedkoper dan gerecycled plastic, waardoor fabrieken omvallen: Wil je een circulaire economie, dan moet je deze industrie helpen

An MP asks the State Secretary whether Dutch plastic recycling firms are being squeezed out by cheaper virgin plastic and what the government will do, including a mandatory recycled-content norm, an extra levy on virgin plastic, and stopping plastic waste exports that end up abroad. The government answers that it favours recyclate, will introduce a national circular plastic norm from 2027 and pushes for EU targets, but rejects an earlier national mandate and a virgin plastic levy, and points to the revised waste shipment regulation to tighten export controls.
It is not feasible to bring the norm into effect earlier.
Het is niet haalbaar om de norm eerder te laten ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over dumpprijzen van nieuw plastic

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the state secretary whether low prices for virgin plastic threaten recycling firms and whether a mandatory recyclate blend should start before 2027 and a tax on virgin plastic should be introduced. The government called the market disruption undesirable, pointed to EU recyclate targets, a national circular plastics norm from 2027 and financial support, but said an earlier mandate was not possible and it judged a virgin-plastic tax disproportionate because of leakage effects.
It is very undesirable that the market for recyclate cannot function properly.
Het is zeer onwenselijk dat de markt voor recyclaat niet goed kan functioneren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over enkele berichten rondom PFAS

An MP asks the government about PFAS contamination in backyard hen eggs, PFAS in sea foam, and the permit application by Chemours to discharge TFA, and about government's responsibilities and enforcement powers. The government answers that a risk assessment is underway, a broad research programme and EU-wide PFAS restriction are pursued, and that the province of Zuid-Holland is the competent authority handling the Chemours permit and enforcement.
Depending on the violation, the competent authority has a number of enforcement instruments at its disposal to act against emissions by companies.
Het bevoegd gezag heeft afhankelijk van de overtreding een aantal instrumenten tot zijn beschikking om handhavend op te treden om uitstoot door bedrijven te verminderen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over de bereikbaarheidsmaatregelen uit het compensatiepakketmarinierskazerne Vlissingen en de kwaliteit van het spoorvervoer in Zeeland

The MP asked about accessibility measures from the Vlissingen Marine barracks compensation package, including the Sprinter extension to Dordrecht, the IC Vlissingen-Amsterdam speed-up, the HRN concession's Zeeland volumes, Ghent-Terneuzen rail, Roosendaal connections and a second Roosendaal-Antwerp train. The government answered that the Dordrecht extension is not yet a significant improvement, that the IC speed-up to the HSL is being reconsidered because it harms some Zeeland travellers, and that the second Antwerp train depends on ERTMS with first results expected in spring 2024.
The discussion with regional administrators on the outcomes of the studies is currently ongoing.
Met de regionale bestuurders wordt momenteel het gesprek gevoerd over de uitkomsten van de onderzoeken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het feit dat er sinds december 2023 minder intercity’s stoppen op station Schiedam Centrum

The ChristenUnie MP Grinwis asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure about fewer Intercity stops at Schiedam Centrum since December 2023, and whether this trade-off was made to keep Sprinter stops and how it weighs against PHS goals. The State Secretary answered that Intercity stops were reduced to four per hour to make the additional Sprinters affordable, that total stops remain equal, and that the reduction will be monitored and reversed depending on passenger demand, with NS responsible for the timetable.
My ministry ensures that NS complies with these agreements.
Mijn ministerie ziet erop toe dat NS deze afspraken naleeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het artikel 'Het 'giftigste' terrein van Nederland wordt eindelijk aangepakt, maar zorgen bij omgeving blijven'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about contamination at the former EMK site in Krimpen aan den IJssel, including health risks, company liability, and remediation cost and timing. The State Secretary answered that residents are safe, the state bears responsibility for remediation after the bankrupt firm's failure, and remediation is planned to start in spring 2024 and take about four years.
Since there is currently no basis to hold these companies responsible for anything, it is not useful to name specific companies.
Aangezien er op dit moment geen grondslag is om deze bedrijven iets te verwijten, is het niet zinvol specifieke bedrijven bij naam te noemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht dat een trein overvuld met licht ontvlambare vloeistof en niet afgesloten deksels door Amsterdam reed

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that a train loaded with flammable liquid and with loose hatch covers left Amsterdam, and why the ILT imposed only a penalty order rather than a fine. The state secretary answered that the ILT blocked the transport, imposed a penalty order, referred the case to the Public Prosecution Service, and that inspections and drone checks continue, with no signal that the ILT cannot fulfil its duties.
Action was taken immediately and enforcement was initiated.
Er is direct opgetreden en overgegaan tot handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de berichten dat AEB (Amsterdams afvalverwerkingsbedrijf) door de gemeente Amsterdam opnieuw in de verkoop is gezet

MP Van Haga asked whether Dutch waste-incineration overcapacity could be resolved by closing AEB lines, so that AEB could be sold rather than shut, and how the €222 million Klimaatfonds reserve could be used for capacity reduction. The State Secretary estimated overcapacity at about 800 kiloton per year (10.7%), said closing lines needs a gradual approach given heat supply and hazardous waste roles, and said the reserve is for investment in recycling, with capacity reduction possibly part of wider maatwerk agreements still being prepared.
I am currently working on drafting a future outlook for waste incineration in the Netherlands towards 2030 and 2050, and a roadmap.
Momenteel ben ik bezig met het opstellen van een toekomstbeeld voor afvalverbranding in Nederland richting 2030 en 2050, en een routekaart
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Tjeerd de Groot over de ‘Verzamelbrief bodem en ondergrond’

MPs Bamenga and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management why the ILT report does not justify a notification or permit requirement for steel slag, why a decision is taking so long, and whether standards for heavy metals and pH should be set quickly. The State Secretary answered that a decision on the best measure will be taken within weeks, that an updated circular on steel slag will be published by end of March, and that the evaluation of the standards framework will be reported in mid-2024.
I want to take a decision within a few weeks on which measure best fits.
Ik wil binnen enkele weken een besluit nemen over welke maatregel het beste past.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriels over het artikel ´Mercedes muss über hunderttausend Diesel-Auto’s zurückrufen´

Gabriels (GroenLinks/PvdA) asked about the Mercedes diesel recall ordered by Germany's KBA, the emission defeat method, whether other manufacturers are affected, what the government has done since the 2022 EU Court ruling, the number of vehicles and extra nitrogen emissions in the Netherlands, and whether damages can be recovered from industry. The State Secretary answered that the RDW found no unlawful manipulation in its later tests, that the Netherlands supports recalls where defeat devices are found, and that recovering social damage from manufacturers is legally difficult because the State has no direct loss.
I am not aware of models from other manufacturers that are manipulated in a comparable way.
Ik ben niet bekend met modellen van andere fabrikanten die op een vergelijkbare manier worden gemanipuleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heutink over het bericht dat fors meer treinreizen dit jaar zijn vertraagd

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that train delays rose sharply, whether sanctions will be imposed on NS and ProRail, and how punctuality will improve. The state secretary acknowledged poor punctuality, said sanctions will be decided after annual accounts arrive by 1 March 2024, and listed planned measures without promising a guaranteed improvement.
Whether I will impose sanctions I am considering on the basis of the annual accounts of NS and ProRail. I will receive these by 1 March 2024 at the latest. I will then inform your House about it.
Of ik sancties ga opleggen, bekijk ik op basis van de jaarverantwoordingen van NS en ProRail. Deze ontvang ik uiterlijk 1 maart 2024. Ik zal uw Kamer daar vervolgens over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boucke over het bericht 'Provincie stond jarenlang toe dat Tata-fabriek kankerverwekkende stoffen lekte'

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary whether the province knowingly allowed Tata Steel to emit carcinogenic PAHs for decades, including a 1988 agreement that required no action on leaking coke-oven doors, and asked for archival reconstruction, the documents and a full overview of agreements. The state secretary declined archival research, said the 1988 document has not yet been found and will be sent when located, gave no overview of historical agreements, and said licence revocation is for the competent authority, with an OD NZKG investigation expected in Q1 2024.
As soon as these documents have been found, I will still send them to your House.
Zodra deze documenten zijn aangetroffen, zal ik deze alsnog aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht ‘Provincie stond jarenlang toe dat Tata-fabriek kankerverwekkende stoffen lekte’

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that the province of Noord-Holland tolerated decades of carcinogenic PAK leakage from Tata Steel's coke oven doors, and about related monitoring, permit and oversight questions. The government answered that past choices reflected the law and norms of their time, that the province and the regional environmental service (OD NZKG) remain responsible for enforcement, and that monitoring and studies are under way.
It is up to the competent authority, in this case the province of Noord-Holland, to enforce in case of violations.
Het is aan het bevoegd gezag, in dit geval de provincie Noord-Holland, bij overtredingen handhavend op te treden.

Antwoord op e vragen van het lid Van Esch over de artikelen ‘VN onderzoekt rol Nederlandse overheid in PFAS-schandaal VS’ en ‘export giftig PFAS-afval Chemours kan bijdragen aan schending mensenrechten, waarschuwt de VN’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the state secretary about UN concerns that Dutch export permissions for PFAS waste from Chemours Dordrecht to Fayetteville, North Carolina may contribute to human rights violations, and about the Dutch role and oversight. The state secretary answered that the Dutch authorities followed international rules, that the US EPA as receiving authority is decisive, that the EPA withdrew its consent on 29 November 2023, and that the Netherlands is pushing for a stricter EVOA revision and an EU PFAS restriction.
The Netherlands is not responsible for how companies in the United States carry out their activities.
Nederland gaat niet over de wijze waarop bedrijven in de Verenigde Staten hun activiteiten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het van het lid Beckerman over het artikel 'Agenten willen meer aandacht voor milieu: ‘Delicten met de meeste doden krijgen geen prioriteit.’'

MP Beckerman asked the ministers of Justice and Infrastructure about a police manifesto urging more priority for environmental crime and whether 'ecocide' should be made a crime. The government answered that prosecution priorities are set by the Public Prosecution Service, pointed to extra investment in environmental enforcement capacity, and said the revised EU environmental crime directive will be implemented, with a ecocide-like aggravating ground expected in a bill after 2024.
It is unacceptable that companies knowingly violate environmental laws. These companies must be tackled.
Het is onacceptabel dat bedrijven willens en wetens milieuwetten overtreden. Deze bedrijven moeten aangepakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Peters over de dreigende financiële dreun aan het openbaar vervoer in de regio

MPs Krul and Peters asked about a projected cut of about 260 million euros to student public transport budgets, arguing the 2021-2022 base year was unrepresentative due to COVID. The minister answered that the recalibration uses the 2022-2023 measurement period, that the freed-up funds (about 207.5 million) will be used once in 2024 to support public transport, and that a 2025 recalibration is proposed.
I therefore do not share the view that this recalibration study is not representative.
Ik deel daarom niet het standpunt dat dit herijkingsonderzoek niet representatief zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het besluit van de Omgevingsdiensten in Drenthe, Groningen en Friesland waarbij ruim 20 vergisters een afvoerverbod van digestaat is opgelegd.

An MP asked why the Northern environmental services required about 20 biogas plants to stop removing digestate after amphetamine was found, why it took a month to act, and whether the unaccredited test method and legal basis were sound. The State Secretary and Minister answered that the environmental services acted adequately, the method is used for sporadic analyses at an accredited lab, amphetamine has zero tolerance under the Opium Act, and no sanctions were imposed.
This question concerns the conduct of the environmental services. We do not share your view.
Deze vraag betreft het handelen van de omgevingsdiensten. Wij delen uw mening niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het nieuws dat Friesland kampt met vervoersarmoede door verschraald openbaar vervoer

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure about transport poverty in Friesland caused by reduced public transport, including whether bus routes may be cut, whether a national action plan and legal accessibility norms are needed, and about fares, private takeovers and provincial operators. The State Secretary points to regional deals, a 300 million euro structural boost, the Mobility Vision 2050, and says concession authorities handle service decisions while the Friesland timetable will be published later.
It is up to these concession authorities to enforce if carriers do not keep their promises.
Het is aan deze concessieverleners om te handhaven als vervoerders beloften niet nakomen.
Antwoord op van het lid Dijk over het nieuws dat de treinverbinding Zwolle-Enschede grote problemen kent

An SP MP asked the state secretary about severe train cancellations (10.5% in October 2023) on the Zwolle-Enschede line operated by Keolis, the causes including staff moving to NS, and the province's enforcement options, plus broader questions on regional public transport liberalisation. The secretary answered that the province as concession authority is handling the shortfall, that enforcement via fines and subsidy withholding is available, and that concession-based competition has improved outcomes, while declining to comment on individual staff motives and pointing to the province for operational matters.
The province can fine the operator under the granted concession or withhold subsidies to hold the operator to agreements when it fails to meet them.
De provincie kan de vervoerder op grond van de verleende concessie beboeten of subsidies inhouden om de vervoerder aan afspraken te houden wanneer de vervoerder niet voldoet aan afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het gebruik van Russisch uranium door de kerncentrale Borssele

An MP asked the ministers about EPZ's long-term contract with a European supplier that uses a Russian subcontractor for reprocessing Borssele's uranium, and why earlier answers said no such dependence existed. The government acknowledged an indirect relationship with Russia, said no short-term alternative exists, and committed to examining how to break the dependence and to reviewing EPZ's evaluation, while declining to discuss confidential details of the Russian subcontractor.
We will among other things look at developing alternatives to reuse as much used uranium as possible, and the consequences of possibly not reprocessing will be further mapped out.

Wij zullen onder meer kijken naar het ontwikkelen van alternatieven om zoveel mogelijk gebruikt uranium te hergebruiken en ook de consequenties van eventueel niet-opwerken zullen nader in beeld gebracht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de 'Borselse voorwaarden voor een kerncentrale'

MP Grinwis asked the government how it views the 39 'Borsele conditions' for new nuclear plants, the process behind them, and whether it will meet them on landscape, cooling towers and underground cabling. The minister answered that the conditions are still being consolidated with the municipality and province, that substantive assessment is premature, and that the government will weigh them in the siting decision.
At this moment it is too early to respond substantively to the conditions.
Het is op dit moment te vroeg om inhoudelijk in te gaan op de voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het nieuwsbericht ‘Lien mag niet meer werken als treinassistente omdat ze een abaya draagt: ‘Voelde me vernederd’’

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Social Affairs and the Staatssecretaris of Infrastructure about reports that a train attendant was barred from working for NS while wearing an abaya, and about whether NS dress rules and handling of the case were lawful. The government answered that it lacks full details, that personnel policy is NS's responsibility, that employers may impose dress rules within limits, that questions of discrimination are for the College voor de Rechten van de Mens and the courts, and that it cannot share any internal investigation for privacy reasons.
It is for the judiciary to assess in a specific case whether dress rules comply with laws and regulations.
Het is aan de rechterlijke macht om in een specifiek geval te beoordelen of kledingvoorschriften in overeenstemming zijn met wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over de vrijstelling van het C-rijbewijs voor zero-emissie (ZE) bestelvoertuigen tot 4.250 kilogram

An MP asked whether the temporary exemption from the C driving licence for zero-emission vans between 3,500 and 4,250 kg expires on 1 January 2024, how many vehicles benefit, what legal basis is needed for a permanent scheme, and whether delays harm sustainable logistics firms. The minister extends the tolerance period to 1 July 2024 for vehicles ordered before 1 October 2023, but states a permanent legal anchor is not enforceable under current EU rules and that the arrangement will be revisited only after EU clarification.
To accommodate entrepreneurs, I am extending the current tolerance period until 1 July 2024.
Om ondernemers tegemoet te komen, verleng ik de huidige gedoogperiode tot 1 juli 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het artikel ‘EPA okays Chemours request to export GenX from the Netherlands to Fayetteville Works plant'

Beckerman (SP) asked the state secretary about the US EPA approving Chemours' request to export GenX waste from the Netherlands to North Carolina, and about health and environmental risks, information received, oversight, and regulation. The state secretary answered that the EPA decides on imports, that the ILT received required information, that the EPA withdrew its consent on 30 November, and that the EU export regulation revision is under negotiation, while promising to ask the ILT to share the information received.
I will ask the ILT to share with your House the information it received from Chemours regarding the transports currently permitted.
Ik zal de ILT verzoeken de informatie die zij heeft ontvangen van Chemours met betrekking tot de op dit moment vergunde transporten met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het bericht 'Dit gebeurt er met die 30 miljoen ‘vergeten’ euro's op oude ov-chipkaarten'

An MP asked the state secretary about press reports on about 30 million euros of unclaimed balances on old public transport chip cards, including whether Translink funds ICT and a charity and whether consumer organisations approve spending. The secretary answered that the money belongs to travellers, is spent under NOVB agreements, and that the questioned spending was in line with those agreements, while not ruling on the consumer approval point beyond saying current arrangements work.
The exact amount is not known to me.
Het exacte bedrag is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht ‘Overleg over Eurostar vastgelopen, grote kans dat trein naar Londen stilvalt’

An MP asked the state secretary why no solution has yet been found to keep Eurostar running between Amsterdam and London during the Amsterdam Centraal renovation, and what concrete steps will be taken to carry out a parliamentary motion. The state secretary answered that a secure departure from Amsterdam will be unavailable for about six months, that options were assessed without any party blocking them, and that the government will keep working with NS, ProRail and Eurostar and optimise the Brussels transfer, but did not give a timeline for answers.
I will therefore continue to work together with NS, ProRail and Eurostar to deliver this connection.
Ik blijf mij dan ook samen met NS, ProRail en Eurostar inzetten voor deze verbinding.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over de te strikte toepassing van wetgeving, naar aanleiding van het artikel “ProRail: treinvertraging en economische schade door te strikt naleven van de wet; Roep om meer flexibili

An MP asked the State Secretary whether overly strict enforcement of rail and environmental law delays trains and causes economic harm, and whether the rules can be simplified. The State Secretary answered that safety and nature rules serve legitimate purposes, that existing consultations with ProRail and agencies continue, and that the government will examine legal instruments, without conceding that the rules are too strict.
My ministry is continuously in consultation with the parties involved to see where clarification is needed.
Mijn ministerie is continu in overleg met de betrokken partijen om te zien waar verduidelijking nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over kapotte liften en roltrappen op stations

Mr Van der Graaf (ChristenUnie) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about recurring lift and escalator failures at Breda station, including whether performance agreements with ProRail exist, how long-term breakdowns are reported, and the status of monitoring and accessibility programmes. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, reported a decline in long-term lift outages, described ongoing improvement trajectories, and committed to continued dialogue with ProRail and periodic information to parliament.
I will consult with ProRail on how to organise the provision of information on lift failures so that it meets the needs of the various stakeholders.
Ik ga met ProRail in overleg hoe we de informatievoorziening over liftstoringen kunnen organiseren zodat deze voorziet in de behoefte van de verschillende belanghebbenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de verdenking dat de treinen met Romeins huisafval mogelijk de bron zijn van het Blauwtongvirus type 3.

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether waste trains from Rome to AEB Amsterdam could be the source of bluetongue serotype 3, and asked about permits, objections, risk analysis, sampling, and vaccine efficacy. The Minister answered that the EVOA notification gave no public objection route, no risk analysis was required, no sampling was planned as there was no reason to suspect Italy, and sequencing shows the Dutch strain is unrelated to the Italian one, while refusing to halt the transports.
No, that did not happen. That is not part of the notification procedure.
Nee dat is niet gebeurd. Dat is geen onderdeel van de kennisgevingsprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Beckerman over de verkoop van vervoersbedrijf Arriva aan een Amerikaanse investeringsmaatschappij

Two SP MPs asked the Infrastructure minister whether the sale of Arriva to a US investment firm was imminent, what it means for passengers and staff, and whether public ownership of transport operators should be the rule. The minister answered that services and concession terms are expected to be unaffected, that provinces hold consent rights in some concessions, and that public ownership is not a precondition for good public transport, though the government will keep monitoring.
The provinces' process for determining whether consent to the sale can be given is confidential.
Het proces van de provincies om te bepalen of instemming met de verkoop kan worden verleend, is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op aanvullende vragen van de leden Dijk en Beckerman over de verkoop van vervoersbedrijf Arriva aan een Amerikaanse investeringsmaatschappij.

SP MPs Dijk and Beckerman asked about the sale of Arriva to US investor I Squared Capital, including provincial powers to block it, consequences of refusal and public spending on Arriva. The Staatssecretaris answered that most concessions are unaffected, that Limburg and Noord-Brabant have consent clauses, that nationalisation is not warranted, and that public-sector purchase of other operators would be explored if offered.
The provinces' process for determining whether consent to the sale can be given is confidential.
Het proces van de provincies om te bepalen of instemming met de verkoop kan worden verleend, is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de verkoop van vervoersbedrijf Arriva aan een Amerikaanse investeringsmaatschappij

An MP asked the State Secretary about the reported sale of Arriva, a regional public transport operator, by Deutsche Bahn to the US investment firm I Squared Capital, and whether this threatens service levels, transparency, and the public nature of public transport. The State Secretary answered that the sale should not change Arriva's concession obligations, which provinces supervise, and that the ministry is monitoring developments, but declined to disclose financial details citing company confidentiality.
Arriva states that the information is commercially confidential and therefore does not share it.
Arriva geeft aan dat het bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie betreft en deelt deze daarom niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de koeiensterfte aan de dijk van het Reevediep

An MP asked about cattle deaths on a farm beside the Reevediep dike and about the investigation into soil used in the dike, including contact with the water board and the farmer's cooperation. The state secretary answered that the province of Gelderland has commissioned soil research, that the dike was built under the soil quality rules with 98.7% of the soil in the cleanest class, that the farmer has withdrawn cooperation, and that results are expected in November 2023 with the parliament to be informed.
Once the final results of the research are known and any follow-up steps, I will inform your House about this.
Zodra de definitieve resultaten van het onderzoek bekend zijn en eventuele vervolgstappen zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Minhas over het bericht 'Intercity Eindhoven-Aken loopt mogelijk vertraging op 2025 zeer ambitieus'

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary whether a direct Intercity Eindhoven-Aken is feasible by 2025 or December 2024 in the off-peak hours, why the €125 million budget falls short, and what the economic and accessibility consequences of delay are. The State Secretary answers that the December 2024 off-peak introduction is still the target but is very ambitious, outlines the remaining steps, names an extra ~€920 million need for Eindhoven station works, and says he will inform parliament in early 2024 on the structural variant.
This is why I indicated in my letter to the House of Representatives of 5 October that the aim of introduction by December 2024 is very ambitious.
Dit maakt dat ik in de brief aan de Tweede Kamer op 5 oktober jl. heb aangegeven dat het streven naar introductie per december 2024 zeer ambitieus is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Van der Plas over het bericht 'Limburg trekt de beurs voor Maaslijn, maar risico’s blijven in hoofdpijndossier'

MPs De Hoop and Van der Plas asked why Limburg must provide extra funding for the Maaslijn rail upgrade, given that the national government should cover remaining shortfalls, and asked about the tender results and financial consequences. The State Secretary answered that cost increases require both co-principals (Limburg and the national government) to cover the gap under the 'samen uit, samen thuis' agreement, that ProRail definitively awarded the contract within the guaranteed amount, and that the government is willing to explore whether project organisation and management can be redesigned.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boucke over het bericht dat hoge concentraties kankerverwekkende stoffen bij Tata Steel als sinds jaren 70 bekend zijn

MPs Hagen and Boucke (D66) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that carcinogenic PAH concentrations near Tata Steel were known since the 1970s, asking whether government acted negligently, about enforcement, emissions, and the Tata India plans. The State Secretary answered that a 1977 provincial report existed and was shared with provincial states, that BaP levels fell 99% since 1975, that the state cannot fully reconstruct past decisions, and that enforcement against Tata is handled by the provincial authority and the Omgevingsdienst NZKG with ongoing penalty orders.
Without archival research it is difficult to say what the government specifically did in response to this report at the time.
Het is zonder archiefonderzoek moeilijk om te zeggen wat de overheid toentertijd precies heeft ondernomen in reactie op dit rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Sneller over statiegeld op lachgascilinders en het bericht “Maat is vol: afvalverzamelaars gaan ‘levensgevaarlijke’ lachgas cilinders terugsturen”

MPs Hagen and Sneller asked about dangerous nitrous oxide cylinders ending up in waste processing after the nitrous oxide ban, financial damage, responsibility, and collection measures. The government answered that the damage stems from illegal dumping by individuals, that it will explore possible financial support, and that it is working with the waste sector and ministries on collection points, storage capacity and enforcement.
The central government is willing to explore whether a financial contribution is possible, using existing schemes or not, for measures that help mitigate risks in the waste sector.

Het Rijk is wel bereid te verkennen of een financiële tegemoetkoming mogelijk is, al dan niet gebruikmakend van bestaande regelingen, voor het treffen van maatregelen die bijdragen aan het mitigeren van de risico's in de afvalbranche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over het bericht "Liters kankerverwekkende stoffen laat Claessen Tankcleaning zo de Maas in stromen"

An MP (D66) asked the ministers about NRC reports that tank cleaner Claessen Tankcleaning discharged benzene-laden waste water into the Maas, and about enforcement history. The state secretary answered that waste water is treated on-site and discharged via the municipal sewer and the Waterschap plant, that enforcement began in 2020, and that a penalty order was issued in July 2023 with follow-up checks.

On 31 July 2023 the municipality of Venlo sent Claessen Tankcleaning an order subject to a penalty after it was established that benzene tank cleaning was carried out differently, in method and installations, than described in the permit.

Op 31 juli 2023 is er door gemeente Venlo een last onder dwangsom verstuurd aan Claessen Tankcleaning nadat is vastgesteld dat de reiniging van tankwagens met benzeen anders wordt uitgevoerd qua werkwijze en installaties dan in de vergunning is omschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht Liters kankerverwekkende stoffen laat Claessen Tankcleaning zo de Maas in stromen

An MP asked the Staatssecretaris about reports that Claessen Tankcleaning discharged carcinogenic substances into the Maas, and about oversight failures by the omgevingsdienst, Arbeidsinspectie, police and OM over several years. The state secretary answered that the inspection regime is being strengthened through the IBP VTH programme, that enforcement steps were taken (including a dwangsom in 2023), and that no concrete new action beyond ongoing programme work was committed.
Without independently verified evidence of a violation, an authority cannot take enforcement action.
Zonder onafhankelijk geverifieerd bewijs van overtreding, kan een instantie niet handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Bevers over het bericht ‘Weer problemen met leerlingenvervoer in Schiedam: bussen komen soms wel twee uur te laat’

MPs Minhas and Bevers asked about late school transport buses for vulnerable pupils in Schiedam and what the government would do. The minister says responsibility lies with municipalities, that she has written to the VNG asking it to hold municipalities to account, and that she urges Schiedam to act quickly.
Responsibility for implementing pupil transport, however, lies with municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van het leerlingenvervoer ligt echter bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Treinen rijden weer na ochtend vol chaos en onduidelijkheid: 'We hebben drie uur moeten wachten''

MP Krul (CDA) asked the state secretary about chaos and poor information for rail passengers in Zeeland on 18 September 2023, when delayed engineering work and too few replacement buses left travellers waiting for hours. The state secretary acknowledged the hindrance, said NS and ProRail were asked to reflect and report and that an evaluation of the earlier Amsterdam Centraal incident would be shared with parliament, but did not commit to new structural measures.
After the external validation of the evaluation, I will share it with your House.
Na de externe validatie van de evaluatie zal ik deze met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over de case of Cordella and others versus Italy

An MP asked the state secretary about the ECHR Cordella v Italy ruling on Ilva steel emissions, the RIVM findings on Tata Steel, and whether a rapid risk assessment and an exemption from EU rules should be pursued. The secretary said the RIVM study already serves as the basis for the risk assessment, announced an expert group to advise quickly, and explained that the competent authority is the province and its environmental service, which is examining stricter permits and the precautionary principle.
I have asked the expert group to come up with advice as quickly as feasible.
Ik heb de expertgroep gevraagd om zo snel als haalbaar met een advies te komen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en De Hoop over de besluitvorming met betrekking tot de motie Klaver-c.s. over het gelijkstellen van potentieel zeer zorgwekkende stoffen (pZZS) aan zeer zorgwekkende stoffen (ZZS)

MPs Klaver and De Hoop asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management why the government did not implement the motion equating potentially very high-concern substances (pZZS) with very high-concern substances (ZZS), and about consultations, administrative burden, benefits, enforcement and the burden of proof. The State Secretary answered that the motion was legally vulnerable, that costs could not be precisely calculated, that no specific consultations followed the motion, and that alternative measures and an updated instrument for competent authorities were announced.
That is why in my letter of 6 October I announced various actions for the instruments of competent authorities.
Daarom heb ik in mijn brief van 6 oktober verschillende acties aangekondigd voor het instrumentarium van bevoegde gezagen.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Kent over de storting van ballaststenen in Apeldoorn

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management and the Minister of Social Affairs about quartz-containing ballast stored in an Apeldoorn residential area, including health risks, whether work should be halted, inspection and permit issues, and ProRail's compliance with quartz-free ballast requirements. The government answered that ProRail and BAM bear the legal responsibility, an independent investigation has been commissioned, the Labour Inspectorate is requesting information and will enforce as needed, and it is awaiting the outcomes of further research and a municipal fact report, while noting that the transition to quartz-free ballast is constrained by market availability.
It is understandable that residents want to know whether the way they were exposed to quartz dust poses health risks.
Het is begrijpelijk dat de bewoners willen weten of de manier waarop zij zijn blootgesteld aan kwartsstof gezondheidsrisico’s met zich meebrengt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Haverkort over het Telegraaf artikel ‘afval scheiden is een grote bende’

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary about reports that much separated plastic waste is incinerated due to contamination, and about waste policy (standardisation, diftar, restwaste targets). The state secretary acknowledged some cases, stressed local variation, said standardisation is being explored and a report is due in early 2024, and largely rejected the claimed links between diftar or machine sorting and contamination.
The rejection of waste streams is something that occurs between municipalities and processors, and I have no national oversight of it.
Het afkeuren van afvalstromen is iets dat speelt tussen gemeenten en verwerkers en daar heb ik op landelijk niveau geen zicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over het bericht 'Ruim veertig procent van de flesjes met statiegeld komt niet bij een inzamelpunt terecht'

An MP (D66) asked the state secretary about reports that over 40% of deposit bottles never reach a collection point, the enforcement response, deposit funds retained by the Afvalfonds Verpakkingen, and whether consumers should get deposit back at all points. The secretary answered that the ILT issued a warning and demanded data, that the producer-run fund is responsible for the system and retained deposit, and that the sector must present a plan to reach the 90% target.
The ILT has sent a warning to the Afvalfonds Verpakkingen because it failed to meet the collection target for plastic bottles.
De ILT heeft een waarschuwing gestuurd aan het Afvalfonds Verpakkingen vanwege het niet halen van het inzameldoel voor plastic flessen.
Antwoord op van het lid Stoffer over het opschorten van de export van pvc-recyclaat

MP Stoffer asks the State Secretary why PVC recyclate export, long allowed, is now suspended and how clarity on waste-versus-product criteria will be ensured. The State Secretary answers that waste status is assessed case by case under EU rules, that the inspectorate tightened scrutiny after 2021 changes to the waste shipment regulation, and points to guidance tools and a planned knowledge platform.
The ILT, among other things following this amendment, has sharpened its attention to the export of PVC for environmentally sound recycling.
De ILT heeft onder andere naar aanleiding van deze wijziging de aandacht voor de export van pvc voor milieuverantwoorde recycling verscherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over het bericht 'Zembla: Chemours wist al decennia van gezondheidsrisico’s pfas'

An MP from GroenLinks asks the government about media reports that Chemours knew for decades of PFAS health risks, including whether permits are adequately checked, whether residents are compensated, and whether PFAS measurements by the company rather than regulators are acceptable. The ministers answer that liability runs through civil suits by municipalities, permits are reviewed and an appeal is pending, the constitutional duty to protect the environment is met through existing law, and the government is strengthening the VTH enforcement system under the IBP programme, with the OvV report response to follow.
It is therefore necessary that companies reduce their emissions as soon as increased health risks become apparent.
Het is dan ook noodzakelijk dat bedrijven hun uitstoot verlagen zodra er verhoogde gezondheidsrisico's blijken te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen, Van Esch, Bouchallikh, Beckerman en Thijssen over PFAS

MPs Hagen, Van Esch, Bouchallikh, Beckerman and Thijssen asked about PFAS: licensed emitters, drinking water, health and economic effects, contaminated sites, enforcement against Chemours and 3M, and whether the government knew of harms. The minister answered that no central emissions register exists, outlined permitting and monitoring responsibilities, and said ongoing RIVM research and legal action continue, while declining to comment on several pending matters.
No, there is no centralised overview of this.
Nee, hiervan is geen gecentraliseerd overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Erkens over windmolens op land

MP Erkens (VVD) asked how the government will implement the coalition promise of clear distance norms for onshore wind turbines, the status of the motion on a 4x tip-height norm, the revised timeline for national rules, and the effect of delay. The minister answered that a national distance norm will be set in a draft AMvB with consultation planned for autumn 2023 and entry into force likely in 2024, that the 4x tip-height norm cannot be applied temporarily without a plan-m.e.r. due to the EU SEA Directive, and that about 17 municipalities currently apply local distance norms.
The planning must be adjusted because incorporating it into the system under the Environment and Planning Act is more complicated than expected.
De planning moet worden bijgesteld omdat de inbouw in het stelsel onder de Omgevingswet ingewikkelder is dan verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boucke over het bericht 'Tata hakt knoop door en gaat tóch staal maken met waterstof'

MPs Hagen and Boucke (D66) asked the ministers about reports that Tata Steel India and Tata Steel Netherlands would pursue revised green steel plans with a DRI and electric arc furnace, and what this means for climate, air quality, emissions, noise, jobs and the maatwerk agreements. The minister answered that the revised plans cannot yet be assessed, that the April 2022 expression of principles remains in place, and that the government will test the plans once the company provides details after the summer.
I cannot yet assess the plans at this moment.
Ik kan de plannen op dit moment nog niet beoordelen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikht over de berichten 'Miljardenschade door chemische uitstoot Shell en industrie in Rotterdamse haven' en 'Duizenden doden, ieder jaar opnieuw: dit kost de chemische industrie in

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management, following Follow The Money reports, about health damage from chemical emissions in the Rotterdam port, the adequacy of emission standards, permitting, RIVM emission registration, and the VTH enforcement system. The State Secretary answered that companies are primarily responsible, that a response to the OVV report and an Impulsprogramma Chemische Stoffen are underway, that permitting is a provincial competence, and that the Van Aartsen recommendations are being pursued in an interbestuurlijk programme.
Permitting, supervision and enforcement for industrial companies fall under the responsibility of the competent authorities concerned, in this case the province.
Vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving bij industriële bedrijven vallen onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de betrokken bevoegde gezagen, in dit geval de provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de rol van afvalenergiecentrales in de circulaire economie

Member Stoffer (SGP) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the role of waste-to-energy plants in a circular economy, citing an ESB analysis that more recycling requires continued incineration capacity. The State Secretary answered that the analysis rests on unrealistic import assumptions, ignores other circularity strategies and does not distinguish material types, and that the government prefers higher-quality recycling over new incineration capacity.
The cabinet prefers focusing on more and higher-quality recycling over building additional incineration capacity.
Het kabinet geeft de voorkeur aan een inzet op meer en hoogwaardigere recycling boven het bijbouwen van verbrandingscapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het voorkomen van zwerfafval door statiegeld

An MP asks the State Secretary whether the deposit scheme is cutting litter of small plastic bottles as much as possible, pressing on the 51% reduction, the 70-90% potential, dented cans and loose labels. The government answers that figures are seasonal and only comparable over time, that it will report to parliament in 2024 and meet the packaging industry in September, and that enforcement lies with the Inspectorate and the industry-run scheme.
As set out in article 16 of the Packaging Management Decree, the House of Representatives will receive a report in 2024 on the effectiveness and effects of the deposit on drinks packaging.
Zoals bepaald in art. 16 van het Besluit beheer verpakkingen zal de Tweede Kamer in 2024 een verslag ontvangen over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van statiegeld op drankverpakkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de berichten dat AEB (Amsterdams afvalverwerkingsbedrijf) door de gemeente Amsterdam opnieuw in de verkoop is gezet

An MP asked the state secretary about Amsterdam's renewed sale of waste-incinerator AEB, its capacity reduction goals, and whether the state could buy AEB to close it. The secretary answered that the climate fund reservations are not meant for buying and closing plants, and that gradual scaling down is preferred.
However, buying a company with the aim of closing it falls outside the scope.
Het kopen van een bedrijf met als doel het te sluiten valt echter buiten de scope.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Heerema over het bericht “Reizigersvereniging boos over plannen NS. Intercity Alkmaar-Haarlem komt niet terug en op vrijdag minder treinen tussen Alkmaar en Amsterdam”

MPs Minhas and Heerema asked the state secretary about NS plans to cut some Intercity and Sprinter services between Alkmaar, Haarlem and Amsterdam in the 2024 timetable, the expected ridership, use of the transition compensation, and how regions and the concession will safeguard service levels. The state secretary answered that NS decides the timetable within concession rules, that about 1800 extra trains per week are added overall, that the transition plan is submitted to the ministry, and that the new concession will include tariff differentiation requirements.
It is currently not possible to make the contribution from the 2023 public transport transition compensation scheme transparent, because it depends on actual passenger numbers.
Het is op dit moment niet mogelijk om de bijdrage uit de regeling transitievergoeding OV (TVOV) 2023 inzichtelijk te maken omdat deze afhangen van de werkelijke reizigersaantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Boucke over de ingroei van elektrische auto’s

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary about the uptake of electric cars under the planned post-2025 stimulus package, covering sales forecasts, total cost of ownership, the SEPP subsidy slowdown, the used-EV market, and international comparisons. The state secretary reaffirmed the 2030 zero-emission goal, forecast about 60% EV share of new sales in 2030 under the package, admitted falling subsidy applications and promised further research, and answered most questions substantively while committing to studies and a letter in 2024.
I expect to be able to inform the House by the first quarter of 2024 at the latest about the outcome of the study.
Ik verwacht de Kamer uiterlijk in het eerste kwartaal van 2024 te kunnen informeren over de uitkomst van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘'165.000 vrachtwagens niet toegestaan in zero-emissiezone; RDW stuurt brief

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary why RDW letters to truck operators on zero-emission zones omitted any reference to exemptions, causing unrest, and asked about the status of a national exemption desk.
