The state secretary acknowledged the omission, said national exemptions were published in the Staatscourant, and committed to including exemption information in future letters and sharing final decisions with the sector.
This could have removed unrest among the recipients of the letter.
Dit had onrust bij de ontvangers van de brief kunnen wegnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Krul over de openstelling van de Afsluitdijk voor fietsers en wandelaars

Two MPs asked the state secretary about the temporary opening of the Afsluitdijk to cyclists and walkers in July 2023, its success, and the possibility of another opening. The government confirmed the high usage and described preparations, and said that from 2024 cycling and walking will be possible over most of the dike but refused a full reopening.
However, the Afsluitdijk will be largely accessible from 2024 as I described in my answer to question 4.
Wel zal de afsluitdijk grotendeels toegankelijk zijn vanaf 2024 zoals ik heb beschreven in mijn antwoord op vraag 4.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht “Kritiek op gemeente Amsterdam die nieuwe vuilniswagens op diesel koopt vanwege overvol elektriciteitsnet”

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that Amsterdam is buying diesel garbage trucks because the electricity grid is full, and whether this undermines the 2025 zero-emission zone deadline for business vehicles. The secretary acknowledged the report, said he would have preferred otherwise but the choice is Amsterdam's under a transition arrangement, and refused to ask Amsterdam to drop its plan while pointing to grid-capacity measures.
Although I would have preferred to see this differently, the choice is up to the municipality of Amsterdam.
Hoewel ik dit liever anders had gezien, is de keuze aan de gemeente Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Ook NS wil in 2025 met internationale treinen blijven rijden en doet aanvraag bij ACM’

Koekkoek (Volt) asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about NS and other operators applying to the ACM to run international train services from 2025 without a concession, and how this affects the HRN concession. The State Secretary welcomed the open-access applications as benefiting travellers, listed all notifications, confirmed that international services will be left out of the HRN concession, and committed to requesting economic-balance reviews for three initiatives.

Where the risks to domestic service are limited and lines are not decisive for the robustness of the integrated Dutch network, I choose to give the open-access initiatives room by not including train services in the HRN concession.

Daar waar de risico's voor de binnenlandse dienstverlening beperkt zijn en lijnen niet bepalend zijn voor de robuustheid van het integrale netwerk in Nederland, kies ik ervoor om de initiatieven in open toegang de ruimte te geven door treindiensten niet op te nemen in de HRN-concessie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht dat een directe treinverbinding tussen Groningen en Bremen op korte termijn niet is uit te voeren

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the report that a direct Groningen–Bremen rail link cannot be realised in the short term, and about related bridge, Lelylijn and cross-border obligations. The State Secretary answered that stage 1 of the Wunderline will cut travel time by 17 minutes by 2025, that a direct train is not feasible by 2036 and partners are looking at stepwise improvements, and that no MIRT study is needed.
Unfortunately it has not proven possible to realise a direct train between Groningen and Bremen by 2036, previously named as a possible stage 3, and thus to see it as an alternative to stage 2.

Helaas is het niet mogelijk gebleken om een directe trein tussen Groningen en Bremen, eerder benoemd als een mogelijke bouwstap 3, voor 2036 te realiseren en daarmee als alternatieve invulling voor bouwstap 2 te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en De Hoop over de prijsverhogingen in het openbaar vervoer

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about fare increases in regional public transport, arguing they threaten accessibility and create a spiral of cut services, and asked what the government will do. The state secretary answered that regional fares are set by decentralised authorities, pointed to a EUR 150 million transition fund and ongoing work on a motion, and said fare increases are partly unavoidable given cost inflation.
I have no role or instruments in setting fares in regional public transport and therefore cannot prevent them.
Ik heb geen rol of instrumenten bij het vaststellen van tarieven in het regionaal openbaar vervoer en kan deze dus ook niet voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boucke over de vertraging om de groenstaalplannen van Tata Steel

MPs Hagen and Boucke (D66) asked about delays in Tata Steel's green steel plans, the regional environmental service's enforcement against unclean cokes-oven gas and its capacity, and the government's follow-up on related motions. The State Secretary answered that delays are undesirable, that the government is in talks with the company and the regional service, that enforcement is independent and risk-based, and that a verbal commitment to further steps and extra capacity funding has been made.
I agree with the OD NZKG that a worked-out and reliable planning is necessary for the success of the project.
Ik ben het eens met de OD NZKG dat een uitgewerkte en betrouwbare planning nodig is voor het slagen van het project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht 'Twee interessante subsidies voor duurzame goederenvervoer'

MP Van der Plas (BBB) asked the minister about a provincial Gelderland subsidy for sustainable freight transport using biofuels and whether a national subsidy for biofuels in trucking is appropriate. The minister answered that the government supports provincial efforts, outlines existing instruments such as the HVE system and ETS2, and explains that the truck toll reinvestment programme 2026-2030 excludes biofuel subsidies in favour of zero-emission technology.
Everything provinces do to support that task the cabinet fully endorses.
Alles wat provincies doen om die opgave te ondersteunen onderschrijft het kabinet van harte.
Antwoord op van de leden Boucke en Hagen over het bericht 'Miljoenen nodig voor sloop kerncentrale Dodewaard bij aandeelhouders beland'

MPs Boucke and Hagen asked how the state came to bear decommissioning costs for the Dodewaard nuclear plant while shareholders received payouts, and about financing rules for decommissioning other energy infrastructure. The minister explains that GKN could not secure approved financial guarantees, that a term sheet transfers NEA's assets to the state, and that a broader reform of mining decommissioning rules is planned for after summer.
The downside is that the state thereby becomes (indirectly) responsible for dismantling GKN.
Keerzijde is dat de Staat hiermee (indirect) verantwoordelijk wordt GKN te ontmantelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Provincie: 'Wijzig wet om nieuw Zeeuws OV-systeem mogelijk te maken''

MPs Krul and Van den Berg asked the state secretary about a provincial call to amend the Wet personenvervoer 2000 to allow an innovative Zeeland public transport system, and about financial support, further legal changes, and a right to tailored exemptions. The state secretary supports the initiative, says a review of whether the transport law needs amending will be completed by year-end, and states that no legal changes or funding have yet been decided.
By the end of this year I will complete an exploration of the need to amend the Wet personenvervoer 2000 or lower regulations.
Eind dit jaar rond ik een verkenning af naar de noodzaak om de Wet personenvervoer 2000 of lagere regelgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over treinen tussen Groningen en Zwolle

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the government would block extra NS intercity trains between Groningen and Zwolle, and whether open-access operators such as Arriva are a 'test ground' for the North. The State Secretary answered that the new concession will stay within financial limits and that the volume is still being specified in a draft to be sent in August, and denied any test-lab intent while listing ACM access notifications.
By August 2023 at the latest, I will present the draft concession to the House.
Uiterlijk in augustus 2023 bied ik de ontwerpconcessie aan uw Kamer aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het artikel ‘Dit mocht niet in rapport: ‘NS en ProRail weer samenvoegen’’

An MP asked whether a 2014 report omitted a conclusion that NS and ProRail should be merged again, and whether the minister would reassess a memo by Bierman on this. The State Secretary said the report was shared with parliament in 2014, could not establish now whether relevant conclusions were left out, saw no current reason for a merger, and declined to re-assess the memo or send a personal judgement to parliament.
It is no longer possible for me, ten years after the fact, to establish whether relevant conclusions for this discussion were not included in the report by NS and ProRail.
Het is voor mij tien jaar na dato niet meer mogelijk te achterhalen of er door NS en ProRail voor deze discussie relevante conclusies niet zijn opgenomen in het rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van  lid Minhas over berichtgeving in de Telegraaf over de economische schade van knelpunten in de weg-, vaarweg- en spoorweginfrastructuur

MP Minhas asked the minister, citing a Telegraaf report and a Panteia study commissioned by the Logistieke Alliantie, about record economic damage from freight congestion on road, waterway and rail, and how the government will address bottlenecks and fund infrastructure. The minister acknowledges the damage and the bottlenecks, points to rail measures and ProRail repairs, but states that 17 MIRT infrastructure projects are paused due to lack of financial, personnel and nitrogen room, with no funds currently for corridor bottlenecks.
As a consequence, 17 MIRT projects will be temporarily paused; other projects will continue.
Dit heeft als consequentie dat 17 MIRT-projecten voorlopig gepauzeerd worden; andere projecten blijven doorgang vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en De Hoop over de inperking van veerdiensten naar Ameland

MPs Bromet and De Hoop asked about the restriction of ferry services to Ameland, the broken road bridge at Holwert, and compensation for affected residents and businesses. The state secretary defended allowing a temporary force-majeure timetable for six weeks pending MARIN research, said no compensation is currently provided, and said the bridge renovation was not delayed and a second spare bridge section is already in use.
I have decided not to agree to a structural adjustment of the timetable between Holwert and Ameland.
Ik heb besloten niet in te stemmen met een structurele aanpassing van de dienstregeling tussen Holwert en Ameland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Akerboom en Van Esch over het gat in de voedselkringloop: menselijke mest

MPs Akerboom and Van Esch asked the minister whether human excrement could be used as fertiliser to close the nutrient cycle, why it is classed as waste, the medicine-residue risks, and whether farmers could get experimental room. The minister answered that direct use carries risks, that phosphate recovery and a public-private research project are under way, and that no short-term experimental room will be created, though controlled trials may be considered.

Given the current uncertainties about the risks of directly using human excrement as fertiliser in agriculture, I do not intend to create experimental space for field trials on farms in the short term.

Gezien de onzekerheden die er momenteel zijn met betrekking tot de risico's van het direct gebruik van menselijke uitwerpselen als meststof in de landbouw ben ik niet voornemens om op korte termijn experimenteerruimte voor praktijkproeven bij boeren te creëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Bouchallikh over het bericht 'Meer giftige zware metalen komen in grondwater dan gedacht door 'staalslakken': 'Het maakt al het leven kapot''

MPs De Hoop and Bouchallikh asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that steel slag releases heavy metals into groundwater, including the Eerbeek case, and about the rules, enforcement and responsibility involved. The State Secretary answered that the rules are being reviewed, enforcement is being strengthened with the regional environmental services, a registration or permit requirement is being examined, the Eerbeek remediation is delayed by protected species and nitrogen issues, and that the Rijk will not pay for remediation that falls on the polluter.
That is why two actions are under way. First, I am reviewing the regulations for secondary building materials.
Daarom lopen er twee acties. Ten eerste houd ik de regelgeving voor secundaire bouwstoffen tegen het licht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Van den Hil over het treinvervangend busvervoer in Zeeland

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about replacement bus service in Zeeland that failed stranded travellers, asking how NS oversees it, why app information was wrong, and how it will be improved. The State Secretary acknowledged the failures, said NS is responsible under the concession and will be held to account, and committed to lessons learned and a check before Roze Zaterdag, which went well.
In such cases I expect NS to learn from the situation and apply these lessons to improve replacement rail transport in the future.
In dergelijke gevallen verwacht ik van NS dat zij lering trekt uit de situatie en deze lessen meeneemt om het treinvervangend vervoer in de toekomst te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Hagen en Van der Graaf over het mislukken van het textielconvenant

MPs asked whether the government should reconsider its role as a party to voluntary sector agreements on responsible supply chains after the textile agreement collapsed, and what the failure means for garment workers and for the need for IMVO legislation. The minister answered that sectoral cooperation remains important, that the government's role will be evaluated in September 2023 with stakeholder consultation, and that the government is pursuing EU and national due-diligence legislation while keeping its existing policy mix.
In doing so I will of course evaluate the role of the government, also in relation to the future entry into force of legislation.
Daarbij zal ik uiteraard de rol van de overheid evalueren, ook in relatie tot inwerking treden van wetgeving in de toekomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het aansprakelijk stellen van bedrijven voor schade door PFAS-vervuiling

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked whether the government would hold Chemours, Schiphol, Sabic and other polluters civilly liable for PFAS damage, as it did with 3M in Belgium. The minister answered that the municipalities are already suing Chemours and DuPont and the province has held Chemours liable, that private-law liability is only one tool among several, and that no separate investigation into Schiphol or Sabic is currently planned.
Holding companies liable is only one of the options for keeping a company's environmental impact as small as possible.
Aansprakelijkheidsstelling is maar een van de mogelijkheden om de impact van een bedrijf op het milieu zo klein mogelijk te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gündoğan over de loodkwestie van het Oosterpark in Amsterdam

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about lead contamination in Amsterdam's Oosterpark, including whether the park should be treated as a children's play area and whether warning signs should be placed. The State Secretary answered that the municipality of Amsterdam is the competent authority, that a GGD health assessment found the park safe for play and recreation, and that the municipality decides on any further measures, without committing to new action.
The municipality of Amsterdam is the competent authority to assess soil quality and possibly take measures, including issuing usage advice.
Gemeente Amsterdam is bevoegd gezag in deze om de kwaliteit van de bodem te beoordelen en eventueel daarop maatregelen te nemen, waaronder het verstrekken van gebruiksadviezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over de publicatie van het onderzoek van Investico en EenVandaag in het bericht 'Een groenstrook is niet genoeg'

An MP asked the state secretary about Investico/EenVandaag findings that many children attend schools near busy roads and about protecting sensitive locations from air pollution. The state secretary answered that municipalities hold the competence over sensitive locations, referred to the Schone Lucht Akkoord advice and WHO-related targets, and promised further consultation and an agenda for 2024–2030 without committing to a timeline.
I cannot anticipate that process at this moment.
Ik kan op dit moment niet vooruitlopen op dat traject.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Tjeerd de Groot over het gebruik van chemische middelen zoals glyfosaat door ProRail

D66 MPs asked the state secretary about ProRail's slower-than-expected move away from glyphosate and other chemical weed control, and whether the 2025 phase-out target still stands. The government answered that the 2025 aim remains, that alternatives are still being tested, that no extra agreements with ProRail are needed, and that a ban on avoidable use will follow once adequate alternatives exist.
The aim is to end use before 2025, but the exact timing is ultimately determined by meeting the condition from the 25 October 2019 letter that usable and feasible alternatives must be available.
Inzet is beëindiging vóór 2025, maar het exacte moment van beëindiging wordt uiteindelijk bepaald door de vervulling van de randvoorwaarde uit de brief van 25 oktober 2019
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over geplande veroudering bij Apple

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management whether the government is aware of reports of planned obsolescence by Apple, how it views such practices, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing to address repairability and product lifespan. The State Secretary answered that planned obsolescence has no place in a circular economy, that the ACM supervises unfair trading practices, and that the EU proposals on consumer role in the green transition and the right to repair, along with Ecodesign rules and a repairability index, are the main instruments being negotiated.
In a circular economy, repairable products must be the norm and there is no place for planned obsolescence.
In een circulaire economie moeten repareerbare producten de norm zijn en is voor geplande veroudering geen plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over de inzet van het kabinet bij de trilogen over het Trans-Europees Transport Netwerk

MP Van der Graaf asks the state secretary how the cabinet is positioning itself in the TEN-T trilogues, including whether the Lelylijn and Wunderline should be placed in the core network, and what lobbying has been done with Germany and other states. The state secretary replies that the Netherlands supports adding the corridor to the extended core network, outlines the negotiating timetable and Dutch lobbying efforts, but says talks with Germany are not concluded and German positions remain unclear.
I am willing to speak personally at political level with Lower Saxony.
Ik ben bereid zelf op politiek niveau te gaan spreken met Nedersaksen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Boswijk en Krul over het bericht 'Nieuw probleem bij zoeken opvangplekken: ‘Dassen blokkeren opvang 800 asielzoekers’'

CDA MPs asked whether the government will act urgently to grant general exemptions under the Nature Protection Act so badgers blocking reception locations for 800 asylum seekers can be removed. The minister answered that exemptions are case-specific, the province is the competent authority, a general exemption is being explored with care, and ProRail has a code since January 2023.
As indicated, the province is the competent authority under the Nature Protection Act and it is up to the province to make that assessment.
Zoals aangegeven is de provincie bevoegd gezag op grond van de Wnb en is het het aan de provincie om die afweging te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger naar aanleiding van een artikel in de Stentor getiteld 'Overlast snelwegen ondanks elektrische auto’s: Ze produceren soms zelfs meer geluid'

MP Kröger asks whether road noise reduction from electric cars and quieter tyres falls short of predictions, and how calculations relate to measured noise. The State Secretary acknowledges quieter tyres had less effect than expected, that calculation methods will be adjusted with the Omgevingswet, and describes validation, monitoring and complaint routes while stating that electric cars are too few yet to change averages.
This insight has already led to adjustments in the calculation methodology that will apply under the Environment and Planning Act.
Dit inzicht heeft al geleid tot aanpassingen in de rekensystematiek zoals die onder de Omgevingswet zal gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht 'Populariteit van SUV’s drukt gewicht Nederlandse auto omhoog (en vertraagt daling uitstoot)'

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the growing popularity of SUVs is raising the weight of the average Dutch car and slowing the fall in CO2 emissions, and what tools government has to steer car size and weight. The State Secretary acknowledged that heavier cars raise CO2 emissions but argued the trend is not solely SUV-driven, described existing tax levers (BPM, MRB, fuel excise) as sufficient, and offered no new steering measures.
Because there is no statutory definition of an SUV, we can only give estimates on whether SUVs have slowed CO2 emissions from the Dutch car fleet and, if so, by how much.

Omdat er geen bij wet vastgestelde definitie van een SUV is (zie mijn antwoorden op vraag 4 en 5) kunnen we alleen schattingen geven op de vraag of SUV’s de CO 2 -uitstoot van het Nederlandse wagenpark hebben afgeremd en zo ja, hoeveel.
Antwoord  op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht “NS trapt op de rem vanwege drukte in buitenlandse treinen, reizigers woedend

An MP asked the state secretary about NS's reservation requirement and capacity limits on international trains to Germany and Belgium after reports of overcrowding. The government answered that temporary measures are in place, capacity expansion is planned for 2024, and that the wider cross-border capacity issues are a broader matter.
I am therefore pleased that NS and Deutsche Bahn (DB) intend to increase ICE capacity from 2024
Ik ben daarom blij dat NS en Deutsche Bahn (DB) voornemens zijn om de capaciteit van de ICE te verhogen per 2024
Antwoord van het lid Bouchallikh over het bericht “NS trapt op de rem vanwege drukte in buitenlandse treinen, reizigers woedend”

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about NS's reservation requirements, Early Bird ticket restrictions, capacity on international trains to Belgium and Germany, and the Eurostar and Nightjet arrangements. The State Secretary answered most questions by describing NS's measures and noting NS's tariff freedom, while saying that NS is responsible for much of the operational detail and committing to continued talks with NS.
In addition, I have no insight into the number of travellers who would face a price increase.
Ik heb, aanvullend hierop, geen inzicht in het aantal reizigers dat te maken zou krijgen met een prijsstijging.
Antwoord van het lid De Hoop over het bericht “Deze zomer verplicht reserveren voor treinreis naar Duitsland”

MP De Hoop asked the State Secretary whether mandatory reservations for international trains to Germany this summer undermine stimulating international rail, and why capacity cannot simply be expanded. State Secretary Heijnen answered that the reservation requirement is a temporary crowd-management measure by NS and DB, that capacity expansion depends on rolling stock arriving from 2024-2025, and that work on cross-border rail barriers and the Internationaal Spoor programme is underway, while NS is primarily responsible for implementation.
I regularly hold consultations with NS, both within the framework of the concession and outside it.
Ik voer regelmatig overleg met de NS, zowel in het kader van de concessie als daarbuiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg, Van Esch en Vestering over natuurherstel na drugsdumpingen

MPs from the Party for the Animals asked ministers how the costs of clearing drug waste dumped in nature are allocated, whether landowners must replant trees and bear restoration costs, and whether nature restoration is funded. The government answered that polluters should pay where possible, that a subsidy scheme capped at 200,000 euro compensates innocent owners, that restoration is covered only if linked to soil remediation, and that the new scheme under discussion does not exclude restoration.
There are no plans to exclude nature restoration from the new national scheme.
Er zijn echter geen plannen om in de nieuwe Rijksregeling natuurherstel uit te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Sneller over statiegeld en lachgascilinders

MPs Hagen and Sneller asked the government about the delayed deck-deposit (statiegeld) scheme on cans, risks of drinks cartons and plastic bottles, batteries in household waste, and fire and explosion risks from nitrous oxide cylinders at waste processors. The state secretary answered that the government will report to parliament on the deposit scheme in 2024, that it is monitoring substitution toward cartons and considering a recycling target, that battery fires are being tackled via a taskforce, and that it is working with partners on a practical solution for nitrous oxide cylinders, while rejecting a deposit system for them.
As provided in art. 16 of the Packaging Management Decree, I will send the House of Representatives a report in 2024 on the effectiveness and effects of deposit on beverage packaging.
Zoals bepaald in art. 16 van het Besluit beheer verpakkingen zal ik in 2024 de Tweede Kamer een verslag toesturen over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van statiegeld op drankverpakkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over kankerverwekkende stoffen die vrijkomen bij het storten van granuliet in natuurplassen

An MP asked whether acrylamide may be released into water when dredged material (granuliet) is dumped in deep nature lakes, whether the unpublished RIVM/Deltares report should be shared, and whether the precautionary principle and a halt on dumping apply. The state secretary answered that the literature review found no new evidence, the report was shared with parliament, earlier studies found acrylamide not detected and unlikely to form, the precautionary principle was applied, and only a future exploration of greener alternatives is promised.
The report was shared with the House at the same time as answering these parliamentary questions.
Het rapport is tegelijk met het beantwoorden van deze Kamervragen met de Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht ‘RIVM: Onduidelijk of kankerverwekkende stof in natuurplassen vrijkomt na stort granuliet’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management whether the government can still claim that granulite dumped in Over de Maas is safe, given RIVM/Deltares findings that acrylamide release from it cannot be ruled out, and asks about stopping such dumping, monitoring, and keeping the local municipality informed. The State Secretary maintains the risks are very small, announces monitoring of deep lakes and exploration of alternatives to polyacrylamide, and acknowledges the municipality should have been kept informed but says the report was unpublished.

I intend, in response to the conclusions and recommendations of RIVM and Deltares and in close cooperation with the various parties involved, to take the following steps to address the knowledge gaps.

Ik ben voornemens om in reactie op de conclusies en aanbevelingen van RIVM en Deltares en in nauwe samenwerking en afstemming met de verschillende betrokken partijen, de volgende stappen te zetten teneinde de kennisleemtes aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Rajkowski over een mogelijk datalek van klantgegevens van NS-reizigers

Two MPs asked the state secretaries whether NS was aware of a reported data leak of NS customer data via a market research subcontractor and its software supplier, and how it was handled, including legal basis, DPIA, subprocessor oversight and rules for protecting client data. The state secretary answered that NS had a processor agreement and DPIA, that the leak source and whether NS data was included remained unclear, and that existing GDPR rules and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens budget were adequate.
However, it is not yet certain which data exactly was leaked and whether NS data was also part of the data breach.
Het is echter nog niet zeker welke data precies zijn gelekt en of ook NS-data onderdeel waren van het datalek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het invoeren van statiegeld op blikjes

Madlener (PVV) asks the state secretary about deposit-free-to-deposit crushed cans, whether the deposit system on cans is practical, and why the government adds regulation instead of enforcing against littering. The state secretary answers that crushed cans can still be returned if barcodes are readable, defends the deposit as a Circular Economy measure created through proper democratic process, and rejects reversing it.
No. I do not consider this measure paternalistic, but an important step towards a Circular Economy.
Nee. Ik vind deze maatregel niet betuttelend, maar een belangrijke stap in de richting van een Circulaire Economie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Kröger en Thijssen over het vermoeden van het afnemen van Russisch uranium door de Nederlandse kerncentrale in Borssele

Opposition MPs asked whether the Borssele nuclear plant (EPZ) may be supplying Russia's war effort through fuel-element trade and reprocessing of uranium in Russia, and asked about export controls, EU sanctions and oversight. The minister answered that EPZ says it no longer trades directly with Russia, that the regulator sees no signs of irregularities, that EU sanctions on Russian nuclear supplies lack support, and that Euratom and the IAEA do not oversee Russian nuclear revenues.
In general, the cabinet makes no statements regarding commercially confidential information.
Antwoord 2 In het algemeen doet het kabinet geen uitspraken ten aanzien van bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Hagen over de aanpak van milieucriminaliteit

MPs Sneller and Hagen asked how the government will tackle environmental crime, including whether non-conviction transactions are sufficiently deterrent, the Court of Audit's findings on inspection, repeat offenders, and implementation of earlier motions. The Minister answers that a sentencing study will be commissioned, a compliance-based transaction modality is planned, and the motions will be followed up through the IBP VTH programme, while several answers defer to other bodies or to later letters.
The Ministry of Justice and Security will commission scientific research into the current way of sentencing and its effectiveness in environmental offences.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid zal opdracht geven voor een wetenschappelijk onderzoek naar de huidige wijze van straffen en de effectiviteit daarvan bij milieufeiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Krul over het bericht 'Gratis reizen met ov heel eenvoudig: betaling met OVpay te omzeilen'

MPs Minhas and Krul asked the state secretary about a report that OVpay contactless payment on public transport can be circumvented by fraudulently using disposable digital cards. The state secretary acknowledged the fraud scenario was known, described monitoring and bank sanctions, and stated no significant increase had been detected, with no new structural measures planned.
Following the RTL publication, no worrying increase in this type of fraud cases has been observed.
Er is, naar aanleiding van de RTL-publicatie, geen zorgwekkende toename geconstateerd van dit soort fraudegevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Van der Graaf over het bericht van het College voor de Rechten van de Mens: 'NS discrimineert reiziger met handicap'

MPs Van Ginneken and Van der Graaf asked the state secretary to respond to a College voor de Rechten van de Mens ruling that NS discriminates against passengers with disabilities through a one-hour pre-booking time for assistance and transfer norms, and asked about steps, data, and options to shorten booking times. The state secretary disagreed in part, citing NS research and improvements, Dutch and EU norms, and committed to continued dialogue and to including regional operators in assistance by 2025, while rejecting further shortening of pre-booking time for reliability reasons.
The College notes that NS has not conducted any new research into the wishes of its customers in this area since the last study seven years ago.
Het College stelt vast dat NS sinds het laatste onderzoek zeven jaar geleden geen nieuw onderzoek meer heeft verricht naar de wensen van haar klanten op dit gebied.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Amhaouch over de berichten 'Wat moet je met dassen onder het spoor? 'Uitgraven en weghalen'' en het bericht 'Dassen verlammen Brabants treinverkeer nog zeker drie weken'

CDA MPs Krul and Amhaouch asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about news reports on badger burrows disrupting rail traffic between Den Bosch and Boxtel, and asked whether ProRail should get a generic exemption to remove badger setts and whether burrow removal should be the policy. The State Secretary answered that ProRail needs a per-location exemption from the competent authority (RVO), that a generic exemption and an evaluation with the ministries are being explored, and that ProRail now has a code of conduct for monitoring and early action.
Following the problems in Molkwerum and Esch, the Ministry of IenW, ProRail, the Ministry of LNV and RVO will evaluate how it came to the point that no trains could run.

Het Ministerie van IenW, ProRail, het Ministerie van LNV en RVO gaan naar aanleiding van de problemen in Molkwerum en Esch evalueren hoe het zo ver heeft kunnen komen dat er geen treinen meer konden rijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Peters over het bericht 'MBO-scholen helemaal klaar met stakingen in streekvervoer: 'Sommige klassen zitten maar halfvol'

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers how MBO students were affected by regional transport strikes, what steps schools and the government would take, and whether the social partners should be urged to resume talks. The minister acknowledged the impact, noted that a collective agreement was reached on 7 April ending the strikes, and said further measures are no longer needed.
I therefore cannot state in general terms what the impact of regional transport strikes on education is.
Ik kan daarom niet in algemene zin aangeven wat de invloed is van stakingen in het streekvervoer op het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het bericht 'Agressie tegen NS-personeel neemt toe, topman wil meer ruimte voor aanpak'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about rising aggression against NS staff, the possibility of giving NS enforcement officers with boa powers access to the driving licence register to identify offenders quickly, camera rollout, reporting of crimes and bodycams. The State Secretary answered that the sector is working on additional measures, that access to the licence register is targeted for autumn 2023 and that camera and bodycam deployment is ongoing, with no further commitment on the substance of the scrutiny question.

The Ministry of I&W, together with the Ministry of J&S, is working to give boa's access to the RDW driving licence register so that the identity of a nuisance offender can be established more quickly.

Het Ministerie van IenW is samen met het Ministerie van JenV bezig om boa's toegang te geven tot het rijbewijzenregister van de RDW om de identiteit van een overlastpleger sneller vast te kunnen stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Haverkort over het artikel in dagblad Trouw over ‘Schone as van afval legt het af tegen goedkopere vuile variant’

An MP asked the State Secretary about a Trouw report that clean bottom ash from waste incinerators is left unused while dirty ash is used, and about the lack of progress since the 2012 green deal. The State Secretary acknowledged the contamination, stated that ash must meet the Besluit bodemkwaliteit, said the 2020 green-deal goal is achieved, and committed to further talks with industry and inclusion of immobilisation in the Circulair Materialenplan.
I am aware of this signal and will engage with the companies on the further sustainable use of bottom ash and the bottlenecks they experience.
Ik ben bekend met dit signaal en ga met de bedrijven in gesprek over de verdere verduurzaming van bodemassen en de knelpunten die daarbij worden ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het gebruik van station Heerenveen IJsstadion bij evenementen

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management why train stops at Heerenveen IJsstadion during events cannot be added, and about timetable space, cost claims and event-timetable procedures. The state secretary answers that the timetable is constrained, that a possible future stop depends on the concession and pending studies, and that NS decides case by case, committing only to keep parliament informed via the MIRT process.
I will keep your House informed of this through the regular MIRT process.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover op de hoogte houden via het reguliere MIRT-proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht in het Algemeen Dagblad/De Dordtenaar “Gevaarlijke treinen door steden verbieden kan wel”

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the ministry can and must intervene via a routing decision to reduce risks of hazardous goods rail transport through cities, citing a Zuid-Holland study. The State Secretary answered that a routing decision is legally possible but not preferred as a last resort because of the waterbed effect, and promised a study on the Basisnet and a rail freight vision.
No, as I indicated in answer to question 2, I do not intend to do that.
Nee, zoals ik bij vraag 2 heb aangegeven ben ik dat niet van plan.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Erkens en Haverkort over wind op land

MPs Erkens and Haverkort asked whether the planned timetable for new national noise and distance norms for onshore wind turbines (including the Danish 4x tip-height norm) is still feasible and when temporary norms can be applied. The State Secretary answers that the new rules are expected in early 2024 after a plan-MER procedure, that legally no temporary national norm can be imposed before that, and that municipalities must set site-specific conditions in the meantime.
The State Secretary of I&W is committed to ensuring that new regulations for onshore wind turbines can enter into force in early 2024.
De Staatssecretaris van IenW zet zich ervoor in dat begin 2024 nieuwe regelgeving voor windturbines op land in werking kan treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht «Rover verrast door mogelijke weigering van Interrail op de ICE»

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary whether Interrail holders would be refused access to ICE trains to Germany and about related rail access and capacity matters. The state secretary replied that NS says the reporting was incorrect, that temporary crowd-management measures are being developed, and that the ministry lacks ridership data for Interrail passes.
Such figures are not known at my ministry or at NS.
Dergelijke cijfers zijn bij mijn ministerie en bij NS niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat vijftienhonderd bushaltes zijn verdwenen in de afgelopen vijf jaar

An SP MP asks the state secretary about the disappearance of about 1,500 bus stops, regional differences, market competition in public transport, and whether norms for accessibility should be set. The secretary says reasons vary by region, alternatives like flexible transport are being developed, the sector faces cost and revenue pressures, and norms will be discussed after the mobility vision is sent to parliament.
In March the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management and I will send the main lines of the Mobility Vision to the House of Representatives.
In maart versturen de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en ik de hoofdlijnen van de Mobiliteitsvisie aan de Tweede Kamer.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Kröger, Van Esch en Teunissen over het bericht ‘Vervuilende Kooksfabriek 2 van Tata Steel blijkt verkeerd gebouwd: rookt en lekt vanaf eerste dag 'aan alle kanten'’

MPs from GroenLinks and PvdD asked the government about reports that Tata Steel's Coke Plant 2 was built with defects and emits pollutants, and about enforcement, permit revision, closure and related subsidies. The State Secretary answered that the competent authority (province and Omgevingsdienst NZKG) is investigating defects, has issued a third penalty payment order, and is examining permit withdrawal, while closure would be discussed in the maatwerk negotiations; several questions were referred to other bodies or withheld for tax confidentiality.
The OD NZKG asked EenVandaag and the reporters for further information; the information provided in the broadcast is insufficient to establish whether there are actually construction defects.

De OD NZKG heeft EénVandaag en de melders verzocht om nadere informatie; de in de uitzending aangereikte informatie is onvoldoende om vast te kunnen stellen of er daadwerkelijk sprake is van constructiefouten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de tijdelijke beleidsregel inzake elektrische laadpunten op verzorgingsplaatsen

An MP asks whether the temporary policy rule on EV charging points at service areas amounts to a moratorium on new fast chargers until 2028, and whether it conflicts with the 1.8 million charge-point target and with protections for existing tankstation rights. The Minister denies a moratorium, explains that new permits are tied to a minimum five-year term to ease transition to exclusive charging rights, and says he will not lift the rule or extend the permit terms, while answering the questions one by one.
No, the temporary policy rule is an important step in developing new policy, which will give entrepreneurs more clarity and is expected to lead to more charging points being realised.

Nee, de tijdelijke beleidsregel is een belangrijke stap in de totstandkoming van een nieuw beleid, dat ondernemers meer duidelijkheid zal gaan bieden en naar verwachting leidt tot de realisatie van meer laadpunten.
Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Bromet en Westerveld over het bericht ‘Slechtzienden blijven thuis door ov-staking: zorgen over actie op verkiezingsdag’

GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers how far blind and partially sighted voters must travel to vote, how many polling stations are accessible to them, how many voters would be affected by a public transport strike on election day, and what alternatives exist. The minister answered that accessibility varies by municipality, that the government urged unions not to strike on election day and asked VNG municipalities to arrange alternative transport, while stating the Kieswet offers no basis for home voting or early voting.
I have urged the VNG municipalities to try to offer alternative transport to voters who need it because of a possible strike.
Ik heb met de VNG gemeenten opgeroepen om te proberen alternatief vervoer aan te bieden voor de kiezers die dat vanwege een mogelijke staking nodig hebben.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering, Wassenberg en Van Esch over het zwijgcontract dat omwonenden van eendenslachterij Tomassen Duck-To in Ermelo moesten tekenen om te voorkomen dat zij bezwaar maken tegen de overl

Three PvdD MPs asked whether a clause requiring residents near the Ermelo duck slaughterhouse to pay 10,000 euro if they objected to nuisance, reportedly via a chain clause in purchase contracts, undermines their legal rights. The government answered that private parties may agree such terms within limits set by law, public order and good morals, that courts decide admissibility, and that residents remain free to have the clause tested in civil court.
Agreements that restrict access to justice too much will quickly be inadmissible within these limits.
Afspraken die de toegang tot het recht te zeer beperken zullen binnen deze grenzen al snel ontoelaatbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht 'Gedeputeerde over natuurregels op vaarroute naar Ameland: 'Dweilen met de kraan open''

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the minister about the Ameland ferry route, its navigation channel problems, and the ongoing study into a durable connection after 2030, including protection of Wadden Sea nature. The minister answered that the ferry operator has stopped sailing at low water levels for safety reasons, that the 2030 study will assess alternatives by end 2023 with a decision then, and that extra dredging and more frequent buoy repositioning are being introduced.
I therefore understand the operator's decision not to sail when, in its judgement, this safety is at stake.
Ik heb dan ook begrip voor de beslissing van de rederij om niet te varen wanneer deze veiligheid naar haar oordeel in het geding is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over het artikel van het platform voor onderzoeksjournalistiek Follow the Money met als titel ‘Steenwolfabriek in Roermond mag van de provincie twee keer zoveel st

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked the government about a Follow the Money report that the Rockwool stone wool plant in Roermond may emit twice the ammonia and phenol limits of other plants under a 2020 provincial permit. The State Secretary answered that Rockwool is the second-largest ammonia emitter, that the province chose permit limits within the EU BREF range, that the Schone Lucht Akkoord lowest-end principle is a starting point rather than an automatic cap, and that the government will talk with Rockwool and push for BAT revisions and sustainable insulation alternatives without committing to tighter national limits.
The competent authority prioritised limiting the emissions of these two substances, even if phenol emissions are higher as a result.
Het bevoegd gezag heeft prioriteit gegeven aan het beperken van de uitstoot van deze twee stoffen, ook als daarbij de emissie van fenol hoger is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat er een vijfdaagse staking plaatsvindt in het openbaar vervoer

MP Alkaya (SP) asked the state secretary how he views a five-day strike in public transport over pay, recognition and workload, and whether the government will fund pay rises, verify employers' finances, ban profit distribution by commercial operators, or appoint a mediator. The state secretary largely deflected, stating that labour conflicts and staff policy are the responsibility of operators, employers and concession authorities, while pointing to extra transition aid of up to 150 million euros this year and rejecting a profit ban.
Within this labour conflict between employers and employee representatives, I exercise restraint.
Binnen dit arbeidsconflict tussen werkgevers en (de vertegenwoordiging van) werknemers past mij terughoudendheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het bericht ‘De zakenreiziger staat te popelen om de trein te nemen, maar stuit op gebrek aan stoelen en ticketchaos’

An MP asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that business travellers cannot get enough train seats, especially to London, and about barriers to international rail travel. The state secretary answered that capacity is limited and that operators, not the government, should adjust supply, while listing planned capacity increases, EU pilots and ministry coordination.
It is up to the operators to align the supply as well as possible with the market.
Het is aan de vervoerders om het aanbod zo goed mogelijk aan te laten sluiten bij de markt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de ammoniakuitstoot van bronnen buiten de landbouw

An SGP MP asked whether ammonia emissions from combustion processes are underestimated in the Netherlands and Europe, citing a 2022 study that puts their share far above the national figure. The State Secretary replied that the RIVM sees no reason to revise Dutch combustion emission factors, though it is still checking coal-combustion implications and will report back if needed.
The RIVM is checking whether this has implications for Dutch ammonia emissions from coal combustion.
Het RIVM gaat na of dit implicaties heeft voor de Nederlandse ammoniakemissies uit steenkoolverbranding.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid De Hoop over de gevolgen van de stakingen in het streekvervoer voor leerlingen speciaal onderwijs

An MP asked whether the strikes in regional public transport, which disrupt special-education pupils' travel, will be prevented, whether staff pay and working conditions will be improved, and what the social costs are. The State Secretary answers that municipalities are responsible for pupil transport, that the strike is a labour dispute between employers and employees the government cannot influence, and that the social costs cannot be mapped.
Municipalities in the Netherlands are, however, responsible for pupil transport.
Gemeenten zijn in Nederland echter verantwoordelijk voor het leerlingenvervoer.
Antwoord op vragen die het lid De Hoop over het bijna-ongeval op een onbewaakte spoorwegovergang in Rheden

An MP asked the state secretary about a near-accident at an unguarded level crossing in Rheden and why the 2023 target to close all unguarded crossings (NABOs) will be missed. The state secretary admitted disappointment, explained the delays, noted that the Lentsesteeg crossing may be closed earlier, and committed to temporary safety measures and a plan of action this spring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over groene vmbo-scholen en de mogelijke sluiting daarvan

An MP asked the minister whether the Curio Prinsentuin Andel green vocational school must close because the province of Noord-Brabant is re-tendering the dedicated school bus service, and what the government would do to keep the school open. The minister replied that closure is premature, that funding would only be affected by a three-year enrolment shortfall, that the province is responsible for accessibility and says it will guarantee it, and that the government trusts the province's assessment.
The province, as concession grantor, is responsible for the accessibility of this school.
De provincie is als concessieverlener verantwoordelijk voor de bereikbaarheid van deze school.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Minhas over het bericht ‘ProRail dumpt Chinese bewakingscamera’s, de NS laat ze hangen’ van Follow The Money

MPs Rajkowski and Minhas asked whether Chinese-made cameras in rail rolling stock, where the rail infrastructure is a designated vital process, are compatible with national security given China's offensive cyber strategy, and whether NS's mitigation measures and NCSC advice are adequate. The government replied that Chinese equipment in vital sectors is not per se undesirable, that vital providers like NS are responsible for risk assessment and mitigation under supervision by the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport, that NS has taken measures such as network separation and no direct internet connection, and that the NCSC does not advise on individual products.
That a particular product or service, in this case cameras, within a vital sector originates from a Chinese provider is not necessarily undesirable.
Dat een bepaald product of dienst, in dit geval camera's, binnen een vitale sector afkomstig is van een Chinese aanbieder is niet per definitie onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over decentrale productie van bio-LNG

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the rising CO2 emissions of long-distance transport, the role of bioLNG, and the trade-offs between decentralised and centralised bioLNG production. The state secretary replied that bioLNG is a transition fuel, that policy supports both production routes via SDE++ and RED II/III, and that a study into biogas use in mobility versus buildings may limit biogas use in transport, with further information promised.
I will inform your House about this together with Minister Jetten as soon as possible.
Hierover zal ik uw Kamer samen met Minister Jetten zo snel mogelijk informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het bericht “Te veel giftreinen denderen door onze steden, doe daar iets aan staatssecretaris”

An MP asks the state secretary to act on reports that too many freight trains carrying dangerous goods pass through towns, raising safety risks for residents and questioning how municipalities can control this. The state secretary rejects the premise of increasing risk, describes existing safety chains, the Basisnet risk ceilings, information channels to municipalities, and future measures such as a Delta Corridor pipeline project, while stating that residual risk cannot be eliminated and that the government cannot guarantee fewer dangerous goods on rail.
I do not recognise myself in this.
Ik herken mij hier niet in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Minhas over de motie Koerhuis en Minhas om te onderzoeken hoe het probleem op de spoorwegen van de Maasvlakte voor goederenvervoer kan worden opgelost

MPs Koerhuis and Minhas asked about their motion to study how rail freight bottlenecks on the Maasvlakte can be solved, including costs and possible state funding. The State Secretary says a bottleneck will emerge, that the state lacks the funds for the proposed €400 million infrastructure and is still negotiating reuse of remaining MIRT money, and that funding the remaining €195 million depends on future Mobility Fund space.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over de uitspraak van de Raad van State over statiegeld op metalen drankverpakkingen

An MP asked the state secretary how the government responds to a Council of State ruling that postponed enforcement of the mandatory deposit on metal beverage cans, and whether the framework for extended producer responsibility needs tightening. The secretary calls the ruling disappointing, says enforcement is suspended until 31 March 2023, rejects tightening the law now, and promises an evaluation in 2024 that will inform Parliament.
I will inform the House of Representatives about that.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht over het ontbreken van een rolstoelbrug.

An MP asked why station Ede-Wageningen's platform 5 lacked a wheelchair bridge for months, whether it would stay missing until 2024, and how NS handled complaints. The state secretary said the bridge was restored on 15 December 2022 after a delayed safety procedure following renovation, explained that moving bridges between platforms carries safety risks, and described alternative travel options offered meanwhile.
Since 15 December 2022 a wheelchair assistance device is again available on platform 5, so assistance to and from this platform can be offered again.
Sinds 15 december 2022 is er weer een reisassistentiemiddel beschikbaar op perron 5 waardoor er weer reisassistentie van en naar dit perron aangeboden kan worden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij  over het artikel 'Lelylijn-discussie trekt zich na Europese erkenning vacuüm, bevindt zich in een stukje niemandsland tussen voorvechters en tegenstanders - zonder te weten wa

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure about the Lelylijn rail project's inclusion in the EU TEN-T network, its financing, German coordination, the 160 km/h speed issue and planning steps. The State Secretary answered that the line was added to the extended TEN-T network, that financial consequences are not yet clear pending the MIRT study, and that regional co-financing and contacts with Germany will follow.
I am pleased that in the agreement of the Transport Council of 5 December the Lelylijn is now included in the extended network of the trans-European transport network (TEN-T).
Ik ben blij dat in het akkoord van de Transportraad van 5 december jl. de Lelylijn nu is opgenomen in het uitgebreide netwerk van het trans-Europees vervoersnetwerk (TEN-T).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over de waarborging van toegankelijkheid in het openbaar vervoer

Sylvana Simons (BIJ1) asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about accessibility of public transport for risk groups, people with mobility impairments, blind and partially sighted people, deaf and hard-of-hearing people, and about the public-transport goal for 2040 and profit-making in the sector. The state secretary answered that a national mask requirement is not being considered, that NS has added reisassistentie staff and a customer panel, that accessibility measures are planned under a 2040 timeline, and that tariff cuts are not an effective emission measure.
I endorse the importance of accessibility in public transport and refer in this context to our ambitions
Ik onderschrijf het belang van toegankelijkheid in het openbaar vervoer en verwijs in dat kader graag naar onze ambities
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het programma ‘Sven op 1’

An MP asks the state secretary whether he discussed with the European Commissioner the direct award of the main rail network to NS, whether the Commission still demands a market analysis, and why the media were informed before parliament. The state secretary confirms the talks, says the Commission's position is unchanged, and explains he chose not to carry out the market analysis in line with a parliamentary motion while acknowledging legal and financial risks, and promises a 'plan B'.
In view of the motion not to carry out a market analysis, which was broadly supported and adopted, I have chosen not to carry out this market analysis now.
Mede gelet op de motie om geen marktanalyse uit te voeren, die breed is gesteund en aangenomen, heb ik ervoor gekozen om deze marktanalyse nu niet uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over Europese belemmeringen voor het invoeren van een kwaliteitseis voor bio-ethanol

An MP asks whether EU law prevents the Netherlands from requiring pure, undenatured ethanol for bio-ethanol blending and why it will not introduce such a quality requirement despite other member states doing so. The State Secretary answers that the Commission's reply does not allow that conclusion, that a Dutch quality requirement would conflict with the Fuel Quality Directive via the RED incentive system, and that the government does not intend to introduce the requirement but will consider CO2-reduction rewards during RED III implementation.
I am also considering implementing this in national implementation.
Ik overweeg dit bij de nationale implementatie ook door te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht dat het RIVM wéér veel gevaarlijke stoffen rond Tata Steel meet

MP Van Esch (PvdD) asks why pollutant deposition near Tata Steel remains high two years after the previous RIVM study, why the promised independent assessment covers only the hydrogen route, and what more is needed before closing the most polluting parts. State Secretary Heijnen acknowledges the health risks must fall, says more monitoring and provincial enforcement are underway, and defends limiting the independent study to the hydrogen scenario since Tata Steel has chosen that route.
It was already clear that dust deposition and thus health risks must come down, and that is still the case.
Het was al duidelijk dat de stofdepositie en daarmee de risico’s voor de gezondheid omlaag moet, en dat is nog steeds zo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht 'reizigersorganisaties keren zich tegen beperkte dienstregeling NS'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reduced NS train timetables due to staff shortages, including whether the reduction is acceptable, what steps are being taken, and what recruitment and other measures NS is pursuing. The State Secretary acknowledged the reduction is undesirable, said NS should scale up as soon as possible, reported recruitment and staffing figures, and stated NS is examining longer trains with one conductor, while giving no concrete new national intervention.
I therefore expect NS to do absolutely everything to limit the inconvenience for travellers.
Ik verwacht dan ook van NS dat zij er écht alles aan doet om de hinder voor reizigers te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over maatregelen tegen de hoge uitval in het treinvervoer

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management what short-term measures would address train cancellations, shortened trains and overcrowding caused by staff shortages at rail operators, including whether first-class seats should be opened to all passengers. The State Secretary answered that operators are primarily responsible, that he is pressing NS in talks and expects it to tackle staffing, and that conductors may already open first class when crowding justifies it, without committing to a general change.
Rail operators are in principle themselves responsible for managing operational risks, including the staff shortage.
Spoorvervoerders zijn in beginsel zelf verantwoordelijk voor de beheersing van operationele risico's, waaronder het personeelstekort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over lozingen op de Waddenzee

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked about FrieslandCampina's discharges of nitrogen and phosphate into the Wadden Sea, the adequacy of its permit and supervision, and the lack of a water permit for the HoWa pipeline. The minister answered that the Omgevingsdienst Groningen judged the permit compliant, that supervision occurred annually, that a water permit was being processed by Rijkswaterstaat, and that no illegal discharge exists, though some questions were not answered in time.
There is no question of an illegal discharge via the HoWa pipeline by FrieslandCampina.
Er is geen sprake van een illegale lozing op de HoWa-leiding door FrieslandCampina.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht “Forse verhoging prijzen bus, trein- en metrokaartjes dreigt volgend jaar”

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries about reported fare rises for buses, trains and metro in 2023, the end of a transition safety net, and whether fares should be frozen or VAT removed. The State Secretary answered that fares are a decentralised responsibility under a fixed indexation system, that NS fares rise 4.3% on average, that a 150 million euro transition safety net was agreed, and that KiM research on fare incentives will be discussed with the NOVB, with a report expected by summer 2023.
I am not responsible for the fares; fare authority lies with decentralised governments and NS.
Ik ga echter niet over de tarieven, de tariefbevoegdheid ligt bij decentrale overheden en NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Haverkort over het bericht dat Bouwend Nederland waarschuwt dat er gaten in de weg komen door een dreigende asfaltcrisis

Two VVD MPs asked whether the government would delay scrapping the approved measure for asphalt production, warning of asphalt shortages and effects on roads, circularity and costs. The Staatssecretaris answered that asphalt plants can meet the emission norms, so production will not stop, that the measure was withdrawn because it could not guarantee compliance, and that she will not relax the emission norms.
No, the approved measure has been withdrawn, see the answer to question 4.
Nee, de erkende maatregel is ingetrokken, zie antwoord onder vraag 4.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Hagen over het bericht 'Nieuwe productiemethode maakt rotorbladen van windmolens goed recyclebaar'

Two MPs (Boucke and Hagen, D66) asked the government about recycling of wind turbine blades, the fate of decommissioned turbines, circularity in the energy transition, and related regulation and tenders. The minister answered at length, describing current recycling options, the TNO innovation, producer responsibility rules, and planned measures such as a national circular economy programme and circularity criteria in offshore wind tenders, but gave no firm numeric targets.
For stimulating R&D&I aimed at transitions, mission-driven innovation policy makes an important contribution.
Voor het stimuleren van R&D&I gericht op transities levert het missiegedreven innovatiebeleid een belangrijke bijdrage.

Antwoord op vragen van lid Vestering over het handjeklap dat zou hebben plaatsgevonden tussen het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en de fabrikant van een emissiearme stalvloer, om de stalvloer als schoner te

MP Vestering (PvdD) asked the state secretary whether the ministry improperly favoured the manufacturer of the Eco-vloer low-emission stable floor, lowering its emission factor under pressure, and whether ministries shared information on it. The government denies any deal, admits the correction factor was omitted in 2019 and intends to raise the emission factor back to 7 kg, while declining to see the handling as improper.
I intend to adjust the emission factor.
Ik ben voornemens de emissiefactor aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Agnes Mulder en Haverkort over de rol van afvalenergiecentrales in Nederland

MPs Bontenbal, Agnes Mulder and Haverkort asked about the Royal HaskoningDHV report on waste-to-energy plants, the effects of the waste import levy on CO2 emissions, the role of waste incinerators in a climate-neutral system, CO2 capture and chemical recycling. State Secretary Heijnen answered that the levy reduced cross-border waste incineration, disputed the claimed emissions increase, and said incinerators will play a shrinking role as waste is shifted to higher-value recycling, while committing to examine how instruments can support both transitions.
The cabinet will examine in the coming period how instruments can be deployed to support both the transition to a climate-neutral economy and the transition to a circular economy.

Het kabinet zal de komende tijd bezien hoe instrumenten zo kunnen worden ingezet dat zij zowel de transitie naar een klimaatneutrale economie als de transitie naar een circulaire economie ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over de asfaltfabriek in Deventer

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about residents' concerns over emissions from the Deventer asphalt plant, its request to relax benzene emission limits, the controllability of monitoring, and whether an asphalt-specific approach will be developed. The State Secretary answered that permitting and enforcement lie with the competent authorities (municipality and omgevingsdienst), that the request for a temporary relaxation was rejected in a draft decision, that inspections are planned weekly and some measurements are unannounced, and that the Schone Lucht Akkoord review will not include a separate asphalt approach.
Within the permitting, supervision and enforcement system, the competent authority for asphalt plants lies with municipalities and provinces.
Binnen het stelsel van vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving (VTH-stelsel) ligt het bevoegd gezag voor de asfaltcentrales bij gemeenten en provincies
Antwoord op vragen die het lid Van der Plas over de opname van de Lelylijn op het TEN-T netwerk

An MP from BBB asked the state secretary about public support, expected ridership, costs and benefits, and EU co-financing for including the Lelylijn in the TEN-T network and linking it to northern Germany. The state secretary answered that these matters are still under study in the MIRT review, with participation planned, and that EU co-financing cannot be guaranteed or quantified in advance.
At this moment there are no forecasts on this yet.
Op dit moment zijn daar nog geen prognoses over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de voorgenomen afschaffing van de BPM-vrijstelling voor bestelauto's

Sen. Stoffer (SGP) asked the government about the planned abolition of the BPM exemption for business delivery vans, its CO2 effect, the basis for the 0.7 Mton figure, the switch of the tax base to CO2, the legal basis, alternatives and talks with industry. The state secretary answered every question on substance, explaining the climate and budget rationale, the CO2-based tax base, and that the industry alternative was rejected while the MRB increases for business vans were partly withdrawn.
The 0.7 Mton is the reduction target that the coalition agreement set for this measure for this target group.
De 0,7 Mton is het reductiedoel dat bij deze maatregel voor deze doelgroep in het coalitieakkoord is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht ‘Recordaantal goederentreinen door Overijssel, omwonenden willen rem op groei’

MP Stoffer (SGP) asked the state secretary about rising freight train vibration and transport of hazardous substances past Wierden, including forecast growth, monitoring, mitigation and communication with residents. The state secretary answered every question on substance, citing ProRail data, a mitigation plan and an innovation programme, while declining to specify hazardous substances as commercially confidential.
I cannot provide further information on specific substances, because that is commercially sensitive information from the carriers.
Ik kan geen verdere informatie verstrekken over specifieke stoffen, want dat is bedrijfsgevoelige informatie van de vervoerders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘Uitval van treinen door stremming Hanzelijn en personeelstekort’

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about train cancellations on the Hanzelijn caused by track works and staff shortages, the reliability of NS timetables and replacement bus services, and whether the concession allows NS to be assessed per line. The State Secretary answered on substance, noting ProRail's December 2022 recovery target and NS measures, but said NS's operational decisions are its own and that the concession only assesses NS annually on network-wide seat availability.
With the intended future concession holder it is being examined how performance on specific routes can be measured.
Met de beoogd toekomstig concessiehouder wordt bekeken hoe prestaties op specifieke trajecten in kaart gebracht kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Van Ginneken over het aanbieden van petities door de gemeente Bergen en de Nederlandse Federatie Omgevingslawaai Motorvoertuigen (NEFOM)

MPs Hagen and Van Ginneken asked the State Secretary about petitions from NEFOM and the municipality of Bergen on motor vehicle noise nuisance, the RIVM advice on environmental noise, and steps taken per noise source. The State Secretary answered that concrete follow-up will be reported to parliament around the end of the year, noted that noise norms are generally met, and said an inventory of motor vehicle noise nuisance and a study are underway.
I expect to be able to inform your House about this around the end of this year.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer rond het eind van dit jaar hierover te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘Onbemande shuttlebusjes mogen bijna nergens meer rijden’

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the minister about the withdrawal of the autonomous shuttle pilot between HagaZiekenhuis and Leyenburg, RDW approval criteria, comparisons with other EU countries, and whether HTM can proceed. The minister answered that the RDW, as independent inspection body, judged the vehicle's safety insufficiently demonstrated, that the ministry does not decide individual approvals, and that a framework exists but no full list of criteria is planned, with only informal talks held so far.
It is up to the Dutch Vehicle Authority (RDW) as an independent inspection body to assess whether a vehicle may or may not be admitted to the public road.
Het is aan de Dienst Wegverkeer (hierna: RDW) als onafhankelijke keuringsinstantie om te beoordelen of een voertuig al dan niet kan worden toegelaten tot de openbare weg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Haverkort over het bericht ‘Nederland is kampioen plastic afval exporteren, Plastic Soup Foundation wil een verbod’

MP Haverkort (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that the Netherlands exports the most plastic waste within the EU to non-EU countries such as Indonesia and Vietnam, and about calls for an export ban, recycling rates, and chemical recycling. The State Secretary answered at length, defending export for high-grade recycling pending EU capacity, pointing to the EU waste shipment regulation revision and existing 2% contamination limits, and describing recycling investment programmes.
Export to countries outside the EU is only permitted if those plastics are recycled in the destination countries.
Uitvoer naar landen buiten de EU is alleen toegestaan als die kunststoffen in de bestemmingslanden worden gerecycled.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bevers en Minhas over het bericht “Terschelling en Vlieland vragen Rijk om compensatie voor Doeksen. ‘Onze levensader kan niet alleen voor rijken zijn weggelegd’”

MPs Bevers and Minhas asked the State Secretary about Doeksen's request to raise Wadden ferry fares by 11.1% and whether residents could be shielded or compensated. The State Secretary answered that a temporary fuel surcharge was agreed at 4.5% for island residents and 16.5% for other passengers, that compensation would be discussed only if the Rijk makes funds available, and that greening the ferries is being studied.
I agree with you that the residents of the Wadden Islands depend on the ferry connection for transport to the mainland.
Ik ben het met u eens dat de bewoners van de Waddeneilanden voor het vervoer naar het vasteland afhankelijk zijn van de veerverbinding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over de berichtgeving rondom de nieuwe dienstregeling van de Nederlandse Spoorwegen

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about critical reporting on NS's 2023 timetable, which cuts trains by about 13% (more on weekends), the claimed decline in service, staffing shortages and the lack of prior detection. The State Secretary answered that the cuts are an NS decision with no ministerial consent power, that NS is pursuing an integrated staffing approach the ministry monitors closely with Finance, and that NS will study the consumer advice but not that a plan is binding.
I have no power of consent for this.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht dat chemiefabriek Chemours maandenlang veel meer GenX in water loosde dan toegestaan

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked whether Chemours discharged far more GenX into water than permitted, and whether monitoring data pointed to illegal discharges. Minister Harbers answered that the national monitoring data are not suited to attributing discharges to a single firm, that Chemours' permits allow 2 kg and 5 kg per year, and that enforcement was not possible because the source could not be identified.
None of these measurements show that Chemours exceeded the set GenX standard at the end of 2021.
Uit geen van deze metingen blijkt dat Chemours eind 2021 de gestelde norm voor GenX heeft overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Minhas over het bericht ‘ProRail dumpt Chinese bewakingscamera’s, de NS laat ze hangen’

MPs Rajkowski and Minhas asked the ministers about reports that NS was buying Chinese-made surveillance cameras for trains and stations and whether the government would restrict such procurement. The government answered that NS uses isolated networks and follows government advice, that concrete procurement criteria are not set in the concession, and that a government guideline and scan of vital infrastructure are being prepared.
As requested in the adopted motion 4 Rajkowski et al., the House will be informed before the Christmas recess about the requested guideline for the central government and its suppliers.
Zoals verzocht in de overgenomen motie 4 Rajkowski c.s. zal de Kamer nog voor het kerstreces geïnformeerd worden over de verzochte richtlijn voor de rijksoverheid en haar leveranciers
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over het milieuzorgsysteem van Tata Steel

MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked the State Secretary about Tata Steel's environmental management system (ISO 14001), including whether its documents, coke oven plant 2 emissions and benchmarks can be disclosed and verified. The State Secretary answered that the system is not a single shareable document, that the matter is partly under court review and that the regional environmental service and certifier hold the relevant oversight, declining to provide documents or confirm several points.
Given my own role and position, as stated in the introduction, I also have no legal powers to demand – insofar as that is even possible – the relevant parts of the environmental management system.

Gelet op mijn eigen rol en positie, zoals aangegeven in de inleiding, heb ook geen wettelijke bevoegdheden om – voor zover dat überhaupt kan – de relevante delen uit het milieuzorgsysteem te vorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht dat de rechtbank heeft geoordeeld dat burgers in het buitengebied onvoldoende worden beschermd tegen stank uit de veehouderij

An MP from D66 asked the government how it will respond to a court ruling that residents of rural areas are insufficiently protected against livestock odour, including its plans for the Biesheuvel commission's recommendations and whether it will appeal. The state secretary answered that the ruling is being studied, promised a letter before the 10 November debate, and noted that municipalities already have tools under the Crisis- and herstelwet and the Omgevingswet.
At this moment the ruling is being studied. I take the ruling and the problem very seriously for all those involved.
