Op dit moment wordt de uitspraak bestudeerd. Ik neem de uitspraak en de problematiek voor alle betrokkenen zeer serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van der Molen en Geurts over het bericht 'Nieuwe dreun voor boeren: burgers die last hebben van stank hebben recht op schadevergoeding'

CDA MPs asked ministers about a Hague court ruling holding the State liable to residents exposed to excessive odour from livestock farms, and its effects on farms, permits, and costs. The government replied that the ruling is still being studied, promised a letter before the 10 November debate, and gave no cost estimate.
At this moment the ruling is being studied.
Op dit moment wordt de uitspraak bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Esch over gezondheidsrisico’s door PFAS in de omgeving van Chemours

An MP asked the state secretary about PFAS health risks around the Chemours plant in Dordrecht, including breast milk exposure, vegetable gardens, permit decisions and a Europe-wide ban. The government disputed the breast-milk conclusion, largely followed RIVM advice on gardens, and pointed to permit competence of the province and Rijkswaterstaat and to an EU-level restriction planned for 2023.
Furthermore, the RIVM has been asked to develop a programme to investigate various exposure routes in the Netherlands and map out options for action.
Verder is aan het RIVM gevraagd een programma uit te werken om verschillende blootstellingsroutes in Nederland te onderzoeken en handelingsperspectieven in beeld te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Molen over het bericht ‘Grote zorgen Nederland over nieuwe Belgische bron PFAS-lozingen in Westerschelde’

Christian Democrat MP Van der Molen asked the minister about reports that Belgian Indaver emissions of PFAS are polluting the Westerschelde, including questions on responsibilities, licensing history and enforcement. The minister responded that a joint Dutch-Flemish approach is underway, that Flanders has tightened the emission limits, and that the ILT and Flemish authorities oversee waste transport and enforcement, with the matter to be monitored closely.
Flanders cannot unambiguously conclude from the licensing history that illegal PFAS discharges have taken place.
Vlaanderen kan vanuit de vergunningsgeschiedenis niet eenduidig concluderen dat er illegale PFAS-lozingen hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Bromet en Ellemeet over het PFAS-schandaal

MPs Bouchallikh, Bromet and Ellemeet asked the government about the PFAS contamination scandal, including breast milk levels near Dordrecht, the export of PFAS waste to Antwerp, Rijkswaterstaat permits for PFOA and GenX discharges, and the EU-wide PFAS ban. The state secretary answered all twelve questions in substance, defending existing health norms, the permitting framework and the planned EU restriction, while promising further study of exposure routes.
For a number of pending export permit applications, the ILT has requested additional information from the notifiers and the Flemish authorities.
Voor een aantal lopende aanvragen voor exportvergunningen heeft de ILT aanvullende informatie opgevraagd bij de kennisgevers en de Vlaamse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over nieuwe risicogrenzen voor PFAS in oppervlaktewater

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked about new RIVM risk limits for PFAS in surface water and their consequences for the Hedwige polder de-embankment and the Westerschelde. The minister confirmed the new limits, said a decision on adopting them as norms is still pending, and maintained that PFAS levels do not obstruct the nature goals of the de-embankment.
I will, partly on the basis of RIVM's advice, decide whether the PFAS standards for surface water need to be adjusted.
Ik zal mede op basis van het advies van het RIVM een besluit nemen of de normen voor PFAS in oppervlaktewater aangepast moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken, Minhas, Bouchallikh en De Hoop over het bericht 'Inspectie: NS heeft onvoldoende zicht op gevaarlijke situaties'

MPs asked the State Secretary about a NRC report that the Inspectorate found NS had insufficient oversight of dangerous situations in trains, following a whistleblower complaint, including questions on maintenance, a possible concealed technical defect, and sanctions. The State Secretary answered that the ILT found no acute risk or violation, is monitoring NS's improvement measures, will share the ILT letters, and found no concealment, though many answers defer to NS's own information.
Such letters are currently not actively made public, but an exception is possible in consultation with those involved.
Dergelijke brieven worden op dit moment niet actief openbaar gemaakt, maar in overleg met betrokkenen is een uitzondering mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over de Zembla uitzending van 9 september 2022 over PFAS

An MP asked the ministers about a Zembla broadcast on PFAS contamination in the Westerschelde, Indaver's discharge permits, Dutch objections to Flemish permits, and contacts with Flanders. The minister answered that the VU study's breast milk conclusions were wrong, that Indaver now complies with tightened limits, that Rijkswaterstaat advised Flanders in writing, and that a national health study will be announced.
Rijkswaterstaat sent letters on my behalf to the Antwerp city council and the Flemish Department of the Environment.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft namens mij brieven verzonden aan het college van burgemeester en schepenen en het Vlaams departement Omgeving
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over de aantrekkelijkheid en betaalbaarheid van duurzame vormen van vervoer

An MP asked the state secretary about the affordability and attractiveness of rail travel and electric driving after energy contracts, tax reductions and fuel costs change. The state secretary confirmed the timing of expiring contracts and tax cuts, said the effects are not yet clear, and committed to scenarios for stimulating electric driving in spring 2023 and to ongoing price information to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht Zorgen over populariteit houtstook door oplopen gasprijzen: Help met isoleren van huizen

MP Van Esch asked the state secretary whether rising gas prices driving up wood-burning and whether the government would act to prevent worsened air quality and health harm from wood stoves this autumn and winter. The state secretary acknowledged the rise in wood burning, pointed to measures with municipalities such as stove alerts, a routewijzer and pilots, but declined to commit to a stricter 2030 reduction target and said further measures would be reported by the end of the year.
Regarding the further process on additional wood-burning measures, I will inform you further before the end of this year.
Over het verdere proces omtrent aanvullende maatregelen houtstook zal ik u nader informeren voor het einde van dit jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Bontenbal over de stijging van het aantal korte vluchten van en naar Nederlandse luchthavens

MPs Van der Molen and Bontenbal asked the government about the rise in short private and government flights from Dutch airports, including whether cabinet members set an example and whether flights without passengers can be curbed. Minister Harbers answered that government has no control over private flights, that a cabinet-wide guideline on short government flights is being drafted, and that no legal basis or policy exists to restrict specific flights, though the impact on climate will be examined.
Furthermore, research has started into establishing an interdepartmental guideline regulating the use of the government aircraft for short flights and/or repositioning flights.
Verder is een onderzoek gestart naar de realisatie van een interdepartementale richtlijn, die het gebruik van het regeringsvliegtuig voor korte vluchten en/of positioneringsvluchten reguleert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Haverkort en Chris Simons over het bericht 'Tientallen Deventenaren trekken witte pakken aan om asbest te verwijderen: 'Dat sjouwen wordt nog zwaar''

MPs Haverkort and Chris Simons asked about a Deventer initiative in which residents helped remove asbestos, the scale of remaining asbestos on private, business and government roofs and buildings, the cost of government asbestos removal, and why a foam-based removal method had not been approved by the VIP. The State Secretary answered that such initiatives exist via Milieu Centraal's asbestos-free shed week, that complete inventories of asbestos in government buildings are not feasible or efficient, that cost data are unavailable, and that foam methods have been approved in several cases while applicants are encouraged to submit requests.
This is unfortunately not possible. Research to find this out would cost a lot of time and money due to the large number of clients
Dit is helaas niet mogelijk. Een onderzoek om dit te achterhalen zou veel tijd en geld kosten vanwege het grote aantal opdrachtgevers
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het bericht ‘Reizigers klagen massaal over bomvolle treinen tussen Zwolle en Randstad: NS moet meer doen’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about overcrowded and short trains on several routes after NS reduced its timetable due to staff shortages, including the Zwolle-Randstad corridor. The State Secretary answered that NS is lengthening trains and raising frequencies, that complaint counts rose but causes are unclear, and that NS will be assessed at year-end under the concession.
I will assess NS at the end of the year on its performance, as laid down in the Hoofdrailnet transport concession.
Ik zal NS aan het eind van het jaar beoordelen op haar prestaties, zoals opgenomen in de vervoerconcessie van het Hoofdrailnet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Bromet en Van der Lee over door de Nederlandse regering erkende MTCS-certificaten voor Maleisisch hout

Greens MPs asked the state secretary about a lawsuit by timber firm Samling against the NGO SAVE Rivers over MTCS-certified timber, whether MTCS should be suspended, and related Tropical Timber Organisation funding. The state secretary confirmed awareness of the lawsuit and said TPAC would be asked to discuss the complaints with PEFC International, while stating TPAC has no independent power to act beyond the minister's request.
I will ask TPAC to discuss with PEFC International, following the signals I have received about MTCS, the signals and how they were handled.
Ik zal TPAC verzoeken om, naar aanleiding van de door mij ontvangen signalen over MTCS, in gesprek te gaan met PEFC International 3 over de signalen en de wijze waarop deze zijn opgepakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Esch over eendenslachterij Tomassen Duck-To, die al zes jaar miljoenen dieren per jaar slacht zonder geldige vergunning en zonder dat hiertegen wordt opgetreden

MPs Vestering and van Esch ask why the Tomassen Duck-To duck slaughterhouse in Ermelo has operated for six years allegedly without a valid permit and without enforcement, and why three environmental services have not acted. The state secretary answers that Gelderland granted a permit in May 2022, that the municipality and environmental services are enforcing (including a Raad van State ruling on a penalty), and that the Van Aartsen recommendations on VTH enforcement are being implemented via the IBP VTH, though he rejects national supervision of environmental services.
I believe the VTH system must be strengthened as soon as possible.
Ik vind dat het VTH-stelsel zo spoedig mogelijk moet worden versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van der Molen over de problemen met de invoering van ERTMS

MPs Alkaya and Van der Molen asked the state secretary about problems with the ERTMS rail signalling rollout on the Merwede-Lingelijn, including the cost-effectiveness of retrofitting existing trains and the planned provincial decision. The state secretary answered that retrofitting is not cost-effective, offered a lump-sum contribution toward new trains as an alternative, and said talks with Zuid-Holland are ongoing with a decision expected from the province on 12 October.
Together with the ERTMS Programme Directorate I am in continuous talks with the province of Zuid-Holland about the ERTMS implementation in the rolling stock on the Merwede-Lingelijn.
Ik ben samen met de Programmadirectie ERTMS continu in gesprek met de provincie Zuid-Holland over de ERTMS-implementatie in het materieel op de MerwedeLingeLijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Bevers over het bericht 'Bereikbaarheid Ameland op het spel: boot te vaak te laat'

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary and minister about reports that the Ameland ferry is often late, threatening reliability and accessibility before the storm season. The ministers answered that Rijkswaterstaat is studying long-term solutions for the period after 2030, with a decision expected in 2023, while acknowledging ferry delays caused largely by silting of the shipping channel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over de brief over de evaluatie van de IT-storing bij NS van 3 april

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the division of responsibilities between NS, ProRail and the state after the 3 April 2022 IT outage, and about simplifying the timetable and regional coordination. The State Secretary answers that NS is responsible for the timetable and operations under the concession, that the government steers via output indicators, that a simplification proposal is being examined with NS, and declines to commission further ProRail work or extend formal consumer consultation.
I have therefore asked NS to critically examine which simplification options, friendly to travellers, it can still implement that could also contribute to a faster restart after disruptions.
Ik heb NS daarom gevraagd kritisch te bezien welke (reizigersvriendelijke) vereenvoudigingsmogelijkheden zij wél kan doorvoeren die ook kunnen bijdragen aan een snellere opstart na verstoringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het arbeidsconflict bij NS

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management and the Finance Minister why NS cancelled trains nationwide on 9 September 2022 due to a regional strike, how the affected area was expanded, and what criteria NS applied. The State Secretary answered that the nationwide cancellation was undesirable, that the strike area was larger than before, and that NS judged it could not guarantee a safe and reliable timetable, promising to ask NS for an explanation to be shared with parliament.

As I promised in the committee debate on Public Transport and Taxis of Wednesday 14 September, I will ask NS to reflect on the strikes and to set out again the reasons for the nationwide impact of the strike on 9 September, which I will share with your House.

Zoals ik heb toegezegd in het commissiedebat Openbaar Vervoer en Taxi van woensdag 14 september jl., zal ik NS vragen te reflecteren op de stakingen en om de redenen voor de landelijke uitstraling van de staking op 9 september nog eens op een rij te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en De Hoop over het bericht Acht boerderijen (deels) dicht voor extra stikstof door verbreding A27 en A12 bij Utrecht

MPs Thijssen, De Hoop, Bromet and Kröger asked why nitrogen capacity is being allocated to widening the A27 and A12 near Utrecht while an alternative is being developed, which other projects could use that capacity, and whether road widening really reduces congestion. Minister Harbers answered that the Raad van State appeal cannot be paused, that other projects such as the A28/A1 junction may need the capacity, that a 2020 traffic study shows congestion more than halved, and that the government is committed to sustainable mobility alongside road investment.
When the region has an alternative ready, I will enter into discussion with them.
Als de regio een alternatief gereed heeft, ga ik met hen in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht dat autofabrikanten alleen nog grote auto’s willen bouwen

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked whether car manufacturers are only building large, heavy cars and whether this conflicts with space, energy, circularity and emissions goals. The State Secretary disagreed with the framing, argued electric cars are more efficient despite their weight, pointed to innovation in batteries and to policies promoting cycling, public transport and shared mobility.
I recognise the picture. Cars have become heavier for several reasons.
Ik herken het beeld. Auto's zijn om verschillende redenen zwaarder geworden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het inzamelpercentage van kleine plastic flesjes

MP Van Esch asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management for the collection rate of small plastic bottles, which the sector was to report after 1 August 2022, and whether the 90% legal target will be met and what consequences follow if not. The State Secretary answers that the sector's 2021 report predates the legal 90% minimum (applicable from 2022), that the first report on it arrives in 2023, that he holds the sector to the target for all plastic bottles without separate small-bottle reporting, and that non-compliance could lead to enforcement by the ILT.
It is up to the packaging industry to achieve the legally set collection rate.
Het is aan het verpakkende bedrijfsleven om het wettelijk vastgestelde inzamelpercentage te behalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de mogelijke komst van de Noordtak Betuweroute en de druk op de (groene) ruimte in bredere zin in Twente en de Achterhoek

An MP asks the government about public opposition to a proposed Noordtak rail line through Twente and the Achterhoek, its legal status, the pressure on rural space, and whether cheaper alternatives such as inland shipping should replace it. The Staatssecretaris answers that a joint options paper found the need for a new freight route not yet established, that the line is far from certain, and that further study with stakeholders will follow before conclusions are drawn.
I will discuss with stakeholders what exactly still needs to be investigated and how we will do this.
Ik zal met belanghebbenden bespreken wat er precies nog verder moet worden onderzocht en hoe we dit gaan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Van der Laan over een geweldsincident tijdens de Amsterdam Pride

MPs Van Ginneken and Van der Laan asked the government about a violent incident involving an Uber driver during Amsterdam Pride, whether data exist on LHBTIQ+-related violence and refusals in taxis, and about the effectiveness of Uber's discrimination button and the Actieplan Veiligheid LHBTI. The state secretary answered that no specific figures are kept for taxi-sector incidents, that the investigation is ongoing, and pointed to existing general reports, a pending study and future policy letters.
No specific figures are kept on violent incidents in the taxi sector against LHBTIQ+ persons.
Er worden geen specifieke cijfers bijgehouden over geweld gerelateerde incidenten in de taxisector tegen LHBTIQ+-personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en De Hoop over de afschaling van de dienstregeling van de NS

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about the planned cut in NS train timetables, the public transport pattern of service reductions, and whether better NS staff pay and state funding are needed. The state secretary acknowledged concern, said the operator and its board are responsible for wages and staffing, and promised continued pressure on NS through concession oversight and talks with the Finance Ministry, without committing extra funds.
As concession grantor I will continue to hold NS to account for compliance with its concession obligations and for limiting passenger inconvenience caused by staff shortages.
Als concessieverlener zal ik NS blijven aanspreken op de naleving van haar verplichtingen uit de concessie en over het beperken van hinder voor de reiziger als gevolg van de personeelskrapte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over de Kamerbrief ‘Afschalen dienstregeling vanwege personeelstekorten NS’ en ‘NS’ers willen meer geld, ja. Maar ze willen vooral waardering’

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management and the Minister of Finance about NS's planned timetable cuts of 10 to 15 percent due to staff shortages, including consultation, accountability, concession incentives and sanctions. The government answers that it finds the cuts undesirable, is monitoring NS and seeking to limit the impact, but says the shortages cannot be fully prevented and that it sees no direct link to shareholder decisions.
As concession grantor for the main rail network, I expect the concession holder to do everything it can to run trains as agreed.
Als concessieverlener voor het hoofdrailnet verwacht ik van de concessiehouder dat NS alles in het werk stelt om conform afspraak treinen te laten rijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Maatoug over het afschalen van de dienstregeling van NS vanwege personeelstekorten en de stakingen bij NS

GroenLinks MPs Bouchallikh and Maatoug asked the ministers about NS cutting its timetable by 10-20% due to staff shortages and strikes, including effects on passengers, car use, wages and state responsibility as shareholder. The government answered that it shares concern, is pressing NS in talks, will inform parliament on relevant developments, and says wage and funding decisions rest with NS's board.
We will inform your House of relevant developments regarding the scaling back of the timetable due to staff shortages at NS.
Wij zullen uw Kamer informeren bij relevante ontwikkelingen ten aanzien van het afschalen van de dienstregeling vanwege personeelstekorten bij NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het bericht Chaos na opnieuw ‘computerblunder’ bij ProRail, ‘Het back-upsysteem moet werken’

An MP asked the State Secretary about repeated IT failures at ProRail, the lack of a working backup system, the absence of replacement transport for passengers, and compensation communication. The State Secretary acknowledged the failures, said they had different causes, admitted the backup did not switch over, and promised further evaluation and the new concession programme.
I am already in discussion with ProRail and NS to examine to what extent we can prevent disruptions in digital systems in general and
Ik ben al in gesprek met ProRail en NS om te bezien in hoeverre we storingen in digitale systemen in het algemeen kunnen voorkomen en
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over de Kamerbrief Versterking VTH-stelsel.

An MP asked why the interbestuurlijk programma VTH (IBP VTH) was sent to the Chamber late, why environmental service boundaries are not aligned with safety regions, and how the Van Aartsen recommendations on environmental crime, enforcement capacity, uniform enforcement policy and independence of enforcement bodies are being followed up. The government answered that the programme was delayed by the pre-recess workload, that alignment with safety regions is a stated aim being examined under pillar 1, and that the recommendations are being worked out in pillars 1 to 5 with progress reports twice a year.
As indicated in the programme plan, this recommendation is also being taken up.
Zoals in het programmaplan aangegeven, wordt ook deze aanbeveling opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht ‘Nieuwe milieunormen voor Tata laten op zich wachten door Europese stroperigheid’

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked whether the EU process for setting best available techniques (BBT/BREF) for steel plants like Tata Steel is objective, whether environmental norms are outdated, and what the government will do about pollution around Tata Steel IJmond. The state secretary replied that the process is sufficiently objective, that the government will push in the Industrial Emissions Directive revision for faster BREF updates and an end date for outdated-installation exemptions, and that a National Environmental Programme on the right to a clean environment is being developed.
I agree that the process for drafting the BREF reference document and the associated BAT conclusions should proceed as objectively as possible.

Ik ben het met u eens dat het proces voor het opstellen van het Referentiedocument voor de Beste Beschikbare Technieken (BREF) en de daarbij behorende conclusies over de Beste Beschikbare Technieken (BBT-conclusies) zo objectief als mogelijk moet verlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Haverkort en Koerhuis over het bericht dat chemisch afval massaal wordt gebruikt als scheepsbrandstof

MPs Haverkort and Koerhuis asked the government about reports that chemical waste is being mixed into marine fuel, including questions on enforcement, EU waste definitions and the financial incentive to mix waste. The State Secretary and Minister mostly deferred substantive answers to a promised letter to parliament on ILT enforcement results, while describing existing REACH, MARPOL and Dutch fuel rules.
The further answering of these questions will address existing regulations and efforts, pending the results of the commitments being carried out.
De verdere beantwoording van deze vragen zal ingaan op bestaande regelgeving en inzet, in afwachting van de resultaten van de in uitvoering zijnde toezeggingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de verlaging van de gezondheidsnorm voor GenX in drinkwater in de Verenigde Staten

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the state secretary about stricter US EPA health advisories for GenX in drinking water and what this means for Dutch RIVM limits, Chemours discharge rules, filtration, and oversight of GenX waste flows. The state secretary answered that RIVM relies on EFSA values, that no new RIVM advice is currently needed, that GenX discharges are already subject to the strictest minimisation duty, and that the ILT and competent authority are improving insight into GenX in waste streams, with a regulatory change planned for 2023.
Therefore there is currently no reason to ask RIVM to advise again on the currently applicable drinking water guideline value.
Daarom is er op dit moment geen aanleiding om het RIVM te vragen opnieuw te adviseren over de nu geldende drinkwaterrichtwaarde.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boucke over de aangenomen motie-Hagen c.s., het artikel ‘Kankerverwekkende stof chroom-6 aangetroffen in grond Tata Steel’ en de intentieverklaring ‘Afspraken met Tata Steel Neder

MPs Hagen and Boucke (D66) asked the government about the timeline, binding nature, monitoring, financing and emissions targets of the Expression of Principles with Tata Steel Nederland, and about carcinogenic chromium-6 found in soil at the site. The minister answered that the EoP is non-binding but guides negotiations toward a binding agreement, that no public funds are yet attached, that further investigation into chromium-6 has been commissioned by the regional environmental service, and that some answers depend on ongoing procedures or are the responsibility of other bodies.
First an attempt will be made to reach more concrete and binding agreements between the parties.
Eerst zal geprobeerd worden om te komen tot concretere en bindende afspraken tussen partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Chroom 6 aangetroffen in grondwater bij Tata Steel’

An SP MP asked the ministers about reported chromium-6 contamination of groundwater at Tata Steel, the lack of health protection, the implementation of a motion on health gains, the smoke incident, the timeline for sustainability agreements, and subsidies. The government answered that the GGD sees no health risk because there is no exposure, that the environmental service has ordered follow-up research and tightened permits, and that binding maatwerk agreements depend on a complete business case, so no firm timeline is given.
However, I will not make concessions on a careful assessment of the business case; I will not take irresponsible risks with taxpayers' money.
Ik ga echter geen concessies doen aan een zorgvuldige beoordeling van de business case, ik ga geen onverantwoorde risico's nemen met belastinggeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het bericht ‘Invalide reiziger uit ongenoegen over defecte lift’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about a disabled traveller who left a station after a broken lift, asking about lift maintenance responsibilities, breakdown numbers, repair times and alternatives. The government answered all ten questions in substance, acknowledging repair backlogs due to parts shortages and staff gaps, and pointed to ProRail measures such as monitoring systems and parts recovery.
It is correct that ProRail is responsible for lift maintenance at stations.
Het klopt dat ProRail verantwoordelijk is voor het liftonderhoud op stations.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Bromet en Kröger over het bericht dat Nederland geen gezonde leefomgeving biedt aan kinderen

MPs Bouchallikh, Bromet and Kröger asked the government about a UNICEF report finding that the Netherlands does not offer children a healthy living environment, covering air pollution, energy poverty, breakfast, noise, lead, pesticides and damp/mould. The government replied that the situation is not 'very worrying' but that there are attention points, pointed to the forthcoming National Environmental Programme, the Clean Air Agreement, energy allowances, lead-pipe measures and a broad mould-prevention approach, and promised to answer each question individually.
For that reason I would not call the situation in the Netherlands very worrying, although there are certainly points of attention that the Netherlands wants to address.
Om die reden zou ik de situatie in Nederland niet zeer zorgelijk willen noemen, al zijn er zeker aandachtspunten waar Nederland een been bij wil trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht 'Minder treinen door personeelstekort'

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of reduced train services due to staff shortages, the threat to public transport after BVOV funding ends, and wage conditions in rail. The government answered that NS will keep reducing some services through at least week 33, that a one-off 2023 transition safety net is in place, and that personnel policy is NS's own responsibility, so it has no role on wages.
My ministry has no role in the matter of wages and working conditions in the rail sector.
Mijn ministerie heeft geen rol bij het vraagstuk rondom de loonsituatie en arbeidsvoorwaarden in de spoorsector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘Gebrekkig spooronderhoud leidde tot ontspoorde trein bij Groningen’

An MP asked the state secretary whether ProRail's finding that postponed maintenance contributed to a derailment near Groningen is accepted, whether other track sections have gone over ten years without comprehensive assessment, and how measurement-train inspections are scheduled. The state secretary confirmed the findings, identified inadequate inspection and oversight regimes, provided a map of unmeasured track, and agreed that ProRail relies too much on contractor processes, with ILT supervising ProRail's remediation programme.
Having read the ProRail report, I share that view.
Het rapport van ProRail gelezen hebbende, deel ik die mening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over meer hart- en vaatziekten door Tata Steel in IJmond

An MP asked the state secretary about GGD and RIVM findings that residents near Tata Steel in IJmuiden have more heart and vascular disease and high blood pressure, and whether emissions should be cut faster, including reaching WHO air quality guidelines and closing coke plant 2. The state secretary acknowledged the health problems, pointed to the joint action plan with the province, said WHO guideline attainment by 2030 is uncertain and will be decided in 2023, and committed to exploring earlier closure of coke plant 2 with the other authorities.
Yes, at the committee debate on External Safety of 22 June I committed to talk with the co-governing authorities about the possibilities to close Coke Plant 2 sooner.
Ja, in het commissiedebat Externe Veiligheid van 22 juni jl. heb ik toegezegd dat ik met de mede-overheden in gesprek ga over de mogelijkheden om de Kooksfabriek 2 versneld te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over overlast door transformatorstation TenneT in Krimpen a/d IJssel

An ChristenUnie MP asked the ministers about noise nuisance from a TenneT transformer replacement at the Krimpen a/d IJssel substation and why the northern site was chosen. The minister answered that the permit is a municipal matter, that TenneT justified the northern location with noise reductions and lower costs, and that participation of residents is a condition for good spatial planning.
Assessing the permit application is a municipal matter.
De beoordeling van de vergunningaanvraag is een gemeentelijke kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over fijnstof en stankoverlast

MPs Thijssen and Bromet asked about odour and particulate nuisance from livestock farms, including enforcement gaps, combi-scrubber performance, permit practice and recovery of subsidies. The Staatssecretaris acknowledged the problem and pointed to area-based approaches, WUR research on chemical odour measurement and an e-learning module, but largely deferred permit and enforcement questions to municipalities and provinces and declined to give farm-level data citing GDPR.
Due to the General Data Protection Regulation, the data on agricultural businesses from the top 100 ammonia sources were supplied anonymised by the RIVM.
In verband met de Algemene verordening persoonsgegevens zijn de gegevens van de agrarische bedrijven uit de top100 ammoniakbronnen geanonimiseerd aangeleverd door het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de naar schatting 400.000 mensen die al jarenlang in de stank van de vee-industrie wonen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the State Secretary about residents living in livestock odour, the failure of innovative stable technologies, court rulings annulling expansion permits, and whether animal numbers should be limited. The government answers that it is revising odour rules and commissioning research into low-emission stable management, but refuses to discuss animal numbers, which it says fall under another ministry's responsibility.

I am responsible for setting emission standards for ammonia and particulate matter from stables, odour policy for livestock farming and air quality standards. It is not about animal numbers but about emissions to the environment.

Ik ben verantwoordelijk voor de vaststelling van emissienormen voor ammoniak en fijnstof uit stallen, het geurbeleid voor de veehouderij en voor luchtkwaliteitsnormen. Het gaat daarbij niet om dierenaantallen maar om de emissies naar de omgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht dat Duitsland de spoorlijn Nijmegen-Kleef weer in gebruik wil nemen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the German plan to reactivate the Nijmegen-Kleve rail line and whether the Netherlands should pursue it. The State Secretary said reactivation is not a priority given low projected ridership, local opposition and financing gaps, and that he would reconsider if circumstances changed.
Based on current and future passenger numbers, I do not expect reactivation of the Nijmegen-Kleve rail line to be a realistic and appropriate solution within the foreseeable future.
Op basis van de huidige en toekomstige reizigersaantallen verwacht ik niet dat reactivering van de spoorlijn Nijmegen-Kleve binnen afzienbare tijd een reële en passende oplossing is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smolders over toenemend aantal geweldsincidenten in het openbaar vervoer

MP Smolders asks the state secretary about a rising number of violent incidents in public transport, whether national public transport bans should be standard for aggression, and whether a broader ban covering spitting and weapon possession should be introduced. The state secretary reports 2,327 incidents in 2021 versus 2,083 in 2020, says a trend cannot yet be confirmed, notes 1,050 transport bans issued, rejects a national ban on proportionality grounds, and points to a regional pilot in Eastern Netherlands starting in the second half of 2022 and existing categorisation that already covers spitting and weapons.

A carrier that wants to apply travel or residence bans must, in consultation with the Public Prosecution Service, state in an action plan the specific types of incidents for which it wants to impose the ban.

Een vervoerder die reis- of verblijfsverboden wil gaan toepassen moet in overleg met het Openbaar Ministerie aangeven en in een plan van aanpak omschrijven voor welke concrete typen incidenten de vervoerder het verbod wil kunnen gaan opleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over de brief 'Actualisatie prognose reizigersaantallen OV'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management why KiM's public transport passenger forecasts are more optimistic than those of operators and regional authorities, and about model updates, uncertainty, uniform modelling and update frequency. The State Secretary answered at length, explaining sources and assumptions, that the KiM model was not changed, that operator forecasts are confidential, and that updates occur twice yearly.
Operators use confidential business information for their scenarios that is not publicly available.
Vervoerders gebruiken voor hun scenario's bedrijfsvertrouwelijke info die niet openbaar beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over een brief van de Provincie Noord-Holland over geluidsregels van luchtvaart

MP Koerhuis asked the State Secretary about a Noord-Holland province letter requesting talks on cumulative aviation noise rules and about implementing his adopted motion to transfer noise rules policy-neutrally. The government says talks with the BRS are scheduled for 12 July 2022, that the rule transfer was policy-neutral, and that it expects to inform parliament over the summer.
The Bestuurlijk Overleg with the BRS is scheduled for 12 July 2022.
Het Bestuurlijk Overleg met de BRS is gepland op 12 juli 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht 'Duizenden cosmeticaproducten bevatten microplastics'

MP Van Esch asked the State Secretary about reports that many cosmetics contain intentionally added microplastics, their health effects, and whether the Netherlands would push for a broad EU restriction and stricter national rules. The government answered that more health research is underway, that it expects an EU Commission proposal on restricting intentionally added microplastics, and that it prefers EU-level regulation over unilateral national phase-out.
I therefore consider it important to pursue ambitious European regulation to limit and prevent microplastics that are intentionally added to products.
Ik vind het daarom belangrijk om in te zetten op ambitieuze Europese regelgeving voor het beperken en voorkomen van microplastics die bewust worden toegevoegd aan producten.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Koerhuis een aantal vragen over een artikel van de Telegraaf  over een Europees Plan om vanaf 2027 een verplichting in te voeren voor de elektrificatie van bedrijfswagens

An MP asked the state secretary about a reported EU plan to require electrification of company fleets from 2027 for large firms and 2030 for SMEs, and about its effects. The state secretary said the proposal is only under consideration within the REPowerEU plan, details are unknown, and the Netherlands would share an impact analysis with parliament later.
I will inform the House, in line with the Van Ginneken, De Hoop and Kröger motion, about possibly including fleet standards in this proposal.
Ik zal de Kamer conform de motie Van Ginneken, De Hoop en Kröger 4 informeren over het eventueel meenemen van vlootnormering bij dit voorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over de beperkte beschikbaarheid van het openbaar vervoer tussen Meppel en Groningen en de beperkingen door een personeelstekort bij NS

An MP asked the state secretary about bus replacement shortages, staff shortages at NS and reduced train services between Meppel and Groningen. The state secretary answered that the bus supplier could deliver only about 75% of requested buses, outlined NS's measures, compensation and planned changes, but largely shifted responsibility to NS and its suppliers.
I have asked NS to inform me of the measures it is taking, and I will continue to hold NS to its duty of care regarding replacement transport.
Ik heb NS gevraagd mij te informeren over de maatregelen die zij treft, en blijf NS aanspreken op haar zorgplicht ten aanzien van vervangend vervoer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over de RegioExpres en de verbinding Arnhem-Doetinchem-Winterswijk

MP Van der Graaf asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the RegioExpres rail service and the Arnhem-Doetinchem-Winterswijk link, including a cost-benefit score of 0.73 and capacity concerns. The State Secretary answered that the project offers value to travellers, that the score will be weighed before the autumn 2022 MIRT consultation, and that no commitment is made in advance.
I do not want to anticipate that now.
Daar kan en wil ik nu niet op vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over het artikel 'RIVM: 'eet zo min mogelijk vis en garnalen uit de Westerschelde'

An MP asked the government about RIVM advice to eat little fish and shellfish from the Westerschelde due to high PFAS levels, including whether it is acceptable that this contamination is far higher than in shop-bought products, the status of a motion on holding 3M liable, and whether a population health study should be started. The minister acknowledged the contamination and advice, said follow-up on the motion is underway with Belgium and a report to parliament will follow, and said a population study is for the GGD and expert group to advise on, with EU limits planned.
The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management will inform your House ahead of the Water Legislative Consultation about progress in implementing the motion.
De Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat zal uw Kamer voorafgaand aan het Wetgevingsoverleg Water informeren over de voortgang in de uitvoering van de motie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht van Leeuwarder Courant van begin april getiteld 'Friese treinreiziger moet na misser ProRail de komende 2,5 jaar maar hopen dat hij overstap in Zwolle haalt'

MP Van der Graaf asks why ProRail's deadline for rail works at Wolvega and Akkrum slipped about 2.5 years to Q4 2024, how many travellers will miss Zwolle connections, and what the government is doing to speed up works and whether a rail aqueduct should replace the HRMK bridge. The Staatssecretaris confirms the timeline, estimates 30 to 400 missed connections per week while bridge openings continue, says ProRail is doing its utmost and that the ministry monitors progress, and states the existing bridge is in good condition with replacement costs borne by the province of Friesland.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management discusses progress with the province and ProRail in its contacts.
Vanuit het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat wordt in de contacten met provincie en ProRail de voortgang besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over de PFAS-uitstoot door Chemours/Dupont

An MP asked the state secretary about PFAS/GenX emissions from the Dupont/Chemours plant, including whether permits should allow such releases and what is done to protect residents. The government answered that permitted GenX emissions have been reduced by over 99% since 2016, that GenX is classed as a substance of very high concern requiring minimisation, and that Nederland is preparing an EU-wide PFAS restriction to be submitted in January 2023.
Furthermore, I remain committed to addressing the concerns about PFAS in Europe.
Daarnaast zet ik mij blijvend in om de zorgen over PFAS in Europa te adresseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over het bericht dat veel gevaarlijk asbestschroot in illegaliteit verdwijnt

An MP asked whether the claim that over 50% of asbestos demolition is illegal, as reported by Omgevingsdienst NL, is correct, and how the government will respond to that body's letter. The state secretary says the illegality mostly concerns missing demolition notifications and asbestos inventories, that the VTH system has not failed given the difficulty of enforcing against private parties, and promises further consultation and a letter to provinces.
No, given a compliance shortfall that largely arises among private individuals, it cannot be said that the VTH system has failed.
Nee, op grond van een nalevingstekort dat voor een belangrijk deel speelt bij particulieren kan niet worden gesteld dat het VTH-stelsel heeft gefaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat werknemers in het streekvervoer gaan staken voor fatsoenlijke arbeidsvoorwaarden en een lagere werkdruk

An SP MP asked the Staatssecretaris about announced strikes in regional public transport over pay, workload and staff shortages, and whether the government would intervene or act on driver recruitment, scheduling cuts and tendering. The Staatssecretaris expressed regret about strikes, said the labour dispute is for employers and unions to resolve and declined to intervene, and defended partial market competition while saying working conditions are the operators' responsibility.
Because this is a labour dispute between employers and employee representatives, I exercise restraint.
Omdat er hier sprake is van een arbeidsconflict tussen werkgevers en (vertegenwoordiging van) werknemers past mij terughoudendheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het achterhouden van informatie in de granulietzaak en het toevoegen van bodemvreemd materiaal aan Granuliet

An MP asks whether the ministry withheld granulite-case information from the municipality West Maas en Waal, whether bodemvreemd flocculant added to granulite complies with soil quality rules, and whether the government will await further research. The state secretary admits the municipality was not properly informed, promises regular official consultation every six weeks, refuses a new study, and maintains that granulite is classed as soil and poses no harm.

In a telephone consultation on 7 April 2022 between alderman Ans Mol and the director-general of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, apologies were offered for this and the agreement was reconfirmed that the municipality will be kept informed on developments in the granulite file.

In een telefonisch overleg op 7 april 2022 – tussen de wethouder Ans Mol en de dgWB van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat – zijn hiervoor excuses aangeboden en is de afspraak herbevestigd dat de gemeente blijvend zal worden geïnformeerd over de ontwikkelingen in het granuliet-dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de oproep van gedeputeerden Overijssel en Utrecht aan het Rijk om sanering asbestdaken vlot te trekken

MP Van der Plas asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about provincial calls to speed up asbestos roof removal, including the falling removal pace, the timeframe, use of remaining business-fund money, national coordination and links to farm-exit and solar policy. The State Secretary acknowledged the slowing pace, said a letter with alternative use of funds would come before the 22 June debate, gave no firm deadline, and referred several questions to other ministers.
My aim is to send this letter to the House before the upcoming External Safety committee debate on 22 June.
Mijn streven is om deze brief voor het komende Commissiedebat Externe Veiligheid van 22 juni, aan de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Nispen over het voornemen van de NS om de boa-bevoegdheid weg te halen bij hoofdconducteurs

MPs Alkaya and Van Nispen asked the government about NS's plan to remove the boa (special investigating officer) powers from its 2,800 head conductors, including the role of cost savings, staff shortages, safety impacts and consultation with staff. The state secretary answered that NS is responsible for safety and the decision, that the change saves about 5.7 million euro a year with little boa use, that safety is preserved through Veiligheid & Service staff, and that NS is exploring keeping boa powers for willing conductors.
NS is responsible for the safety of its passengers and staff. It is up to NS to decide on the necessary safety measures, such as the deployment of boas, in consultation with the works council.

NS is verantwoordelijk voor de veiligheid van haar reizigers en personeel. Het is aan NS om over de benodigde veiligheidsmaatregelen, zoals de inzet van boa's, te besluiten in afstemming met de ondernemingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Helder over het afnemen van de boa-status van hoofdconducteurs

Two PVV MPs asked the State Secretary and Justice Minister about NS removing the boa (special investigating officer) powers of train conductors and the resulting safety risks for staff and passengers. The government answered that NS is responsible for these operational decisions, expects only a small rise in assistance requests that can be absorbed, and that the conductors remain supervisors who call in Veiligheid & Service staff when needed.
It is therefore up to NS to decide on the necessary measures, such as the deployment of boa's, in consultation with the works council.
Het is daarom aan NS om over de benodigde maatregelen te besluiten, zoals de inzet van boa's, in afstemming met de ondernemingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat de aanbesteding van laadpalen in Oost-Nederland naar Vattenfall InCharge gaat

An MP asked whether the tender for public charging points in eastern Netherlands awarded to Vattenfall InCharge is sufficient and what the state would do if Vattenfall underdelivers or prices become too high. The State Secretary replied that the regional concession is sound, Vattenfall must place at least 8,000 points in three years, and no national intervention is needed, while promising a broader letter on a nationally covering network before summer.
I trust that the Oost-Nederland region, as the contracting authority, will oversee this so that sufficient charging points are placed each year.
Ik vertrouw er op dat de regio Oost-Nederland hier als opdrachtgever op toeziet, zodat er jaarlijkse voldoende laadpunten worden geplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat EVBox dieper in de problemen zit door ondeugdelijke laadpalen

An MP asked the Secretary of State for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that EVBox faced problems from defective charging poles, covering quality requirements, supervision, and risks to charging infrastructure if the company fails. The government answered that quality tests are the responsibility of contracting authorities, the company's defects were remedied, and it will address continuity and financial safeguards through the national charging infrastructure agenda without committing to new oversight.
The national government does not have this information.
De rijksoverheid beschikt niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het BTW-tarief op openbaar vervoer

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Infrastructure whether VAT on public transport should be abolished to attract passengers, compensate consumers and fight transport poverty, and what this would cost. The government declined to commit to abolition for now, pointing to pending analyses (KIM study, evaluation of the reduced VAT rate, the EU proposal), gave cost estimates of 300-400 million euros for full abolition and 100-133 million for a return to 6%, and noted that a 6% rate is technically impossible before 2026.
The cabinet wants to help people who find it difficult to absorb short-term cost increases with its package of purchasing power measures.
Het kabinet wil met het pakket aan koopkrachtmaatregelen mensen tegemoetkomen die kostenstijgingen op korte termijn moeilijk kunnen opvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het dreigende capaciteitstekort voor spoorgoederenvervoer door werkzaamheden aan het derde spoor

An MP asked the state secretary about the capacity shortfall for rail freight caused by 20 weeks of double-track closure at Emmerich during third-track works, including diversions via Venlo and Oldenzaal, hazardous goods, noise, trade competitiveness, bus alternatives and passenger delays. The state secretary confirmed the planned closure, said a ProRail action plan and advice from the steering group are awaited, and deferred most substantive answers until then.
Earlier, my predecessor asked ProRail, in consultation with the Third Track Germany Steering Group, to draw up an action plan for the long-term works in 2024, 2025 and 2026.
Eerder heeft mijn voorganger ProRail gevraagd om in samenspraak met de Stuurgroep Derde spoor Duitsland een Plan van Aanpak op te stellen voor de langdurige werkzaamheden in 2024, 2025 en 2026.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht 'Volgend jaar mogelijk 30 procent minder metro’s, bussen en trams'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether a possible 20-30% cut in public transport service for 2023 is acceptable and what the government will do about it, including whether the availability compensation (BVOV) will continue into 2023. The State Secretary answered that the BVOV is extended to end-2022, that the KiM forecasts 97% ridership recovery for 2023 with an update due in June, and that regional timetables are the responsibility of provinces and transport regions, while the government will keep monitoring and consulting the sector.
Responsibility for drawing up regional timetables lies with the provinces and transport regions.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het opstellen van regionale dienstregelingen ligt bij de provincies en vervoerregio's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Esch over het bericht ‘Grondeigenaren moeten opdraaien voor drugsafval op hun terrein’

MPs Bikker and Van Esch asked whether landowners stuck with costs of large-scale drug waste dumping (exceeding the 25,000 euro subsidy cap) should be protected, and about subsidy adequacy and underspending. The minister answered that the Rijk has no statutory duty but co-funds costs via a regulation, that talks with IPO, BIJ12 and Noord-Brabant are ongoing, and promised to inform parliament before summer.
I will inform your House, on behalf of the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management, before the summer about the state of affairs.
Ik zal uw Kamer, mede namens de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat, voor de zomer informeren over de stand van zaken hiervan.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de 'Kamerbrief over stimuleren van hernieuwbare waterstof in jaarverplichting energie vervoer voor periode 2023 en 2024' en het TNO-rapport 'Impact 'fit for 55' voorstel voor

Deputy Bontenbal (CDA) asked about the TNO report on the RED revision's green hydrogen demand in transport, the 4 PJ cap on hydrogen in the annual obligation, and the viability of the refinery route after 2025. Minister Jetten answered that the RED III targets are still under negotiation, that TNO's study of all routes is due in June, and that a decision accompanying the letter addresses the refinery route from 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht 'ProRail moet schadevergoeding betalen voor trillend huis door passerende treinen'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about a court ruling ordering ProRail to pay damages for train vibrations, and about measures in Goes and possible norms for rail vibrations. The State Secretary said ProRail is appealing, measures have been taken in Goes with a monitoring study pending, and a norm-setting decision on vibrations will be prepared after research results expected this year.
After the legal procedure has concluded, I will assess the possible consequences of this.
Na afloop van de juridische procedure beoordeel ik de mogelijke gevolgen hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van der Graaf over de noodconcessie voor Arnhem-Nijmegen/Veluwe Zuid n.a.v. een bericht op de website van de provincie Gelderland

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about the emergency concession for the Arnhem-Nijmegen/Veluwe Zuid public transport network, rising operating costs, the risk of service cuts, and accessibility for people with disabilities. The state secretary answered that the province is responsible, that the Rijk funds public transport through the Provinciefonds and BDU with annual indexation, and that the temporary BVOV scheme has been extended to end-2022 with further monitoring and a forthcoming accessibility agreement.
I am aware of the concession for Arnhem-Nijmegen/Veluwe Zuid. The province of Gelderland is the responsible concession authority.
Ik ben bekend met de concessie voor Arnhem-Nijmegen/Veluwe Zuid. De provincie Gelderland is de verantwoordelijke concessieverlener.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over aanvullende voorzieningen bij verzorgingsplaatsen langs rijkswegen

MP Bontenbal asked the state secretary about charging points as additional facilities at rest stops along motorways, including term lengths, size relative to basic facilities, safety, and whether the 2018 court ruling on fair allocation is respected. Minister Harbers answered that both permits run up to 15 years, that no numerical cap applies to additional charging points, that the ruling did not equate additional and basic facilities, and that existing policy stays in force pending the 'Verzorgingsplaats van de toekomst' project with a new letter before 1 July.
The Hague Court of Appeal (ruling of 24 July 2018) did not in fact rule that an additional facility amounts to the same thing as a basic facility, but rather emphasised the differences.

Het Gerechtshof in Den Haag (arrest, 24 juli 2018) heeft overigens niet geoordeeld dat een aanvullende voorziening op hetzelfde neerkomt als een basisvoorziening, maar heeft juist de verschillen onderstreept.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht dat de treinoverstap op het station van Zwolle vaker gaat mislukken

MP Van der Molen (CDA) asked the state secretary about reports that rail transfers at Zwolle will increasingly fail due to ProRail works, and about the condition of the HMRK rail bridge. The state secretary acknowledged the inconvenience, said the connections will remain sufficient with only limited delays, committed to discussing progress with the province and ProRail, and said the bridge is in good condition with replacement to be considered later.
In this context, the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management will discuss progress in its contacts with the province and ProRail.
Vanuit het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat zal in dit kader in de contacten met provincie en ProRail de voortgang worden besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Plas over de open brief van het Nationaal OV-Beraad (NOVB) over de staat van het openbaar vervoer en het voorzieningenniveau

MP Van der Plas asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management whether the government would act on the Nationaal OV-Beraad's warning that delayed decisions could cut regional public transport by 20-30%, and whether it would secure multi-year bridging support beyond 2022. The State Secretary answered that the transport availability allowance (BVOV) was extended to end-2022 and that the government will keep monitoring, with the KiM forecast to be updated in June.
That is why on 14 April the cabinet decided to extend the transport availability allowance (BVOV) until the end of 2022.
Daarom heeft het kabinet op 14 april jl. besloten de beschikbaarheidsvergoeding OV (BVOV) te verlengen tot eind 2022.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Hoop over een dreigende kaalslag in het openbaar vervoer, n.a.v. het artikel  “Brandbrief lagere overheden: zet coronasteun ov niet zomaar stop” van 8 april 2022 in de Telegraaf

An MP asks the State Secretary whether the public transport availability payment will be extended, why clarity came late, and how fewer services and regional impacts will be monitored. The government answers that the payment is extended through 2022, that monitoring continues with the sector, and that service decisions rest with provinces and transport regions.
I will again inform your House this autumn, once the 2023 timetables have been set by the decentralised authorities, about the development of the service level.
Antwoord 11 Ik zal uw Kamerdit najaar, als de dienstregelingen voor 2023 door de decentrale overheden zijn vastgesteld, wederom informeren over de ontwikkeling van het voorzieningenniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de berichtgeving dat de woningbouw in gevaar komt door te weinig grind en zand

An MP asked whether a sand and gravel shortage threatens housing construction because permits are not renewed or granted, and about national oversight of extraction permits. The minister acknowledged the importance of raw materials, said a national monitoring system is being set up, and noted that national steering was abandoned in 2003 and the role lies with provinces and the market.
To regain a national overview, a new national monitoring system is currently being developed.
Om het landelijk overzicht opnieuw te verkrijgen wordt momenteel gewerkt aan het opzetten van een nieuw landelijk monitoringssysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Haverkort, Koerhuis en Peter de Groot over de uitzending van EenVandaag over mogelijke tekorten in industriezand en grind

VVD MPs asked the government whether extraction permits for sand and gravel are expiring, whether shortages will arise, and how supply will meet the infrastructure and housing ambitions. The minister answered that a monitoring system and a national demand forecast are being developed, that circularity measures are underway, and that talks with provinces and the sector are ongoing.
At present, the need for sand and gravel is being mapped in cooperation with knowledge institutes and industry organisations. The House will be informed of the results before the end of the year.

Op dit moment wordt – in samenwerking met kennisinstituten en brancheorganisaties – de behoefte aan zand en grind in beeld gebracht. De Kamer zal voor het eind van het jaar over het resultaat worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over het verlopen van de beschikbaarheidsvergoeding openbaar vervoer

An MP from GroenLinks asks the state secretary whether the government will extend the public transport availability fee (BVOV) beyond 2022, warning that without it public transport faces major cuts while passenger numbers remain below pre-pandemic levels. The state secretary answers that the BVOV is extended through 31 December 2022 to secure the second-half 2022 timetable, that passenger numbers are forecast at 88% of 2019 this year and 97% in 2023, and that the ministry will keep monitoring and talking with the sector.

As I informed your House on 14 April, the cabinet, given the importance of accessible and safe public transport for travellers, therefore decided to extend the public transport availability fee (BVOV) through 31 December 2022.

heb geïnformeerd 2 heeft het kabinet, gezien het belang van een bereikbaar en veilig OV voor de reiziger, daarom besloten de Beschikbaarheidsvergoeding OV (BVOV) door te trekken tot en met 31 december 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Minhas over het bericht ‘Alarm om agressie op spoor en station’

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Minhas asked about rising aggression against rail and public transport staff, including the role of conductors as boa's, their equipment and police response times. The Minister answered that incidents rose (NS 660 to 744, regional transport 787 to 977), outlined the NS request for database access to verify identities, and promised talks with NS and police but gave limited concrete commitments.
To improve the information position of boa's when establishing identity, it is important to give them better access to information so they can carry out their tasks independently.
Om de informatiepositie van boa's te verbeteren bij het vaststellen van de identiteit is het belangrijk hen betere toegang te geven tot informatie voor een zelfstandige taakuitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over nieuw bewijs voor zware vervuiling van Nederlandse waterwegen met plastickorrels

An MP asked the state secretary about new evidence of heavy plastic pellet (nurdle) pollution in the Westerschelde, whether enforcement under the permitting and inspection system had failed, and what was being done with Belgium and the UK. The government acknowledged the problem and pointed to industry initiatives, inspections by Rijkswaterstaat and the regional service, international cooperation (OSPAR, Scheldt Commission) and EU plastics measures, without accepting failure of the enforcement system.
Companies are first and foremost responsible themselves for preventing polluting substances, such as plastic pellets, from entering the environment.
Antwoord 4 Bedrijven zijn allereerst zelf verantwoordelijk om te voorvoorkomen dat verontreinigende stoffen, zoals plastic korrels, in het milieu terechtkomen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden van de leden Koerhuis en Haverkort over ongelukken met e-bikes en drukte op fietspaden

MPs Koerhuis and Haverkort asked the minister about reports of more accidents with fast e-bikes and crowded cycle paths, including causes, prevention, sales information, speed tuning, and path design. The minister answered that the role of e-bikes is still being studied with results due by end 2022, outlined educational campaigns and infrastructure investments, and said the government will inform parliament before year end.
By the end of 2022 at the latest, your House will be informed of the results.
Uiterlijk eind 2022 wordt uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Hagen over het stimuleren van het gebruik van wasbare luiers en incontinentiematerialen

MPs Van Esch and Hagen asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about municipal and national handling of disposable versus washable nappies and incontinence products, including recycling, collection bins, VAT, insurance coverage and chemical content. The State Secretary answered at length, acknowledging limited recycling capacity and fragmented responsibility, but largely deferred to municipalities, care institutions, insurers and EU rules, and committed only to examining instruments and to pleading for EU labelling changes.
I am currently examining which instruments can be deployed to make the nappy chain more closed.
Momenteel bezie ik welke instrumenten ingezet kunnen worden om de luierketen meer sluitend te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over ‘de afvalbergen die ontstaan door het verplaatsen van textielproducten vanuit Europa naar Ghana’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about textile waste mountains in Ghana caused by exports from Europe, including export volumes, steps against low-grade textile exports, financial support to Ghana, extended producer responsibility, and lobbying in Brussels. The government says exports are sorted to buyers' demand and EVOA rules apply, that there is no data on trade flows, that Ghana receives no Dutch funding, and that it will raise the issue in the EU textile strategy and report in spring 2023.
There are no figures on these trade flows known to the Dutch government.
Er zijn geen cijfers over deze handelsstromen bekend bij de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat Rijkswaterstaat niet weet waar zijn metaalafval met giftige stoffen zoals Chroom-6 blijft

MPs Van der Molen and Agnes Mulder asked the government about reports that Rijkswaterstaat scrap metal containing chromium-6 was mixed and sent to smelters, including questions on enforcement, export controls and contractual safeguards. Minister Harbers answered that existing working-conditions rules, contract requirements and the Beheersregime apply, that mixing is allowed when smelters accept it, that enforcement capacity is limited, and that the ILT is drafting an action plan without giving figures on past cases.
How many cases of scrap mixing have occurred in recent years is not known to me.
In hoeveel gevallen in de afgelopen jaren sprake is van schrootvermenging is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over te veel lood in de grond van het Oosterpark in Amsterdam

An SP MP asked the state secretary about lead contamination in the soil of Amsterdam's Oosterpark, where children play, and whether the GGD's standards differ from national guidance. The state secretary replied that the municipality of Amsterdam is the competent authority, that national guidance sets no generic lead norm, that the GGD found no health risk for park visitors, and that the municipality will be asked to respond to the new soil survey.
The competent authority (under the Soil Protection Act) for the quality of the soil of the Oosterpark.
Het Bevoegd gezag (Wet bodembescherming) ten aanzien van de kwaliteit van de bodem van het Oosterpark.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over de verkoop van het vervuilde voormalige terrein van chemiebedrijf Akzo Nobel in Deventer

MP Bouchallikh asked the state secretary about the sale of the heavily polluted former Akzo Nobel site in Deventer to the province, the risks to the Deventer-Zutphenseweg drinking water well and the Natura 2000 area, and whether the polluter pays for remediation. The state secretary answered that the municipality is the competent authority, that no specific study of the clay layer was done but no risks to the well were found, that Nouryon remains liable via a transferred remediation obligation, and that no talks were needed.
The competent authority states that Nouryon (AkzoNobel) is responsible for the costs and damage relating to remediation of the soil contamination.
Het bevoegd gezag geeft aan dat Nouryon (AkzoNobel) verantwoordelijk is voor de kosten en schade met betrekking tot de sanering van de bodemverontreiniging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over de transitie naar een circulaire economie en de definiëring van afval binnen de afvalwet- en regelgeving

An MP asked the state secretary about the waste definition blocking circular businesses, the implementation of the Taskforce recommendations, and legal certainty for investments in recycling. The government answered that the definition of waste is a shared EU concept needing clarification rather than replacement, that companies bear the primary burden of proving material status, and that it is working on guidance, end-of-waste regulations for struvite and cellulose, and EU-level clarification, though many answers restate existing policy and defer to decentralised authorities.
It is not so much a new waste definition that is needed, but mainly a clarification of the current definition.
Het is niet zozeer een nieuwe afvaldefinitie die nodig is, maar met name een verduidelijking van de huidige definitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Wassenberg  vragen over het bericht in de Gelderlander ‘Slib storten in diepe plas zorgt niet altijd voor betere natuur’

MPs Van Esch and Wassenberg asked whether a study showing deep floodplain lakes are ecologically better than assumed, and that shallowing gives little ecological gain, should halt shallowing projects, and how permits are handled. The State Secretary responded that a policy reaction will follow before summer, that compliant ongoing shallowings cannot simply be stopped, and that competent authorities will be asked to consider the new findings for new initiatives.
Ongoing shallowings that meet all legal requirements cannot simply be stopped.
Lopende verondiepingen die aan alle wettelijke eisen voldoen kunnen niet zomaar worden stopgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de prijzen van het openbaar vervoer

An MP asked whether rail and public transport fares rise yearly with inflation and whether the state will intervene to prevent large fare increases during high inflation. The state secretary answered that NS may correct fares for inflation under the concession, that regional fares follow an index formula, and that he has no power over regional fares.
As the previous answers show, I have no authority over regional public transport fares.
Zoals uit voorgaande antwoorden blijkt, heb ik geen bevoegdheid ten aanzien van de regionale OV tarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over de zorgelijke situatie bij de voormalige kerncentrale in Tsjernobyl

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked the government about the Chernobyl plant's staffing, power supply and radiation monitoring, and what diplomatic routes exist to fix them. The minister answered that the IAEA coordinates on-site risk mitigation, that the plant's grid connection was restored on 14 March, and that short-term radiological risk is considered low, with no new staff rotation yet possible.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Bikker over het niet opruimen van drugsafval

MPs Van Esch and Bikker asked why a large drug-waste dump in the Brabantse Wal nature area, found in March 2021, remains unremediated, and about health risks, cost recovery from the landowner, and dump statistics. The State Secretary answered that the province of Noord-Brabant is the competent authority, that partial clean-up has occurred, that remaining remediation is complex and under investigation, and that the Interior and Justice ministries are discussing whether the 25,000 euro compensation cap should be raised.
Removing the waste is a responsibility of local and regional governments; I have no insight into that.
Het opruimen van het afval is een verantwoordelijkheid van de lokale en regionale overheden, daar heb ik geen zicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over zwerfkapjes

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management, jointly with the Minister for Health, about face masks as litter, their share of litter, the reuse and recycling options, and the advice to wear medical masks. The government acknowledged the problem, reported that masks make up about 2 percent of litter in 2021, and said it prefers prevention and communication over an import levy, while answering most questions on substance and promising a sustainability study and SBIR competitions.
The Ministry of Health is going to talk with stakeholders (users, industry, inspectorate) to see which measures are possible to limit the waste mountain.
Het Ministerie van VWS gaat met veldpartijen (gebruikers, industrie, inspectie) in gesprek om te kijken welke maatregelen er mogelijk zijn om de afvalberg te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards.
