The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Van der Graaf over de kwartaalrapportage OV Ombudsman van het vierde kwartaal van 2021 en het bericht 'Gps-proef moet eind maken aan meervoudig in- en uitchecken in ov'

Two MPs asked the state secretary about station lift and escalator outages, bus ramps, and dual-card (subscription plus pay-as-you-go) problems raised by the OV Ombudsman. The secretary acknowledged the priority of repairs, described existing ProRail-NS arrangements and monitoring, and said the dual-card issue will be solved by the OVpay programme, while declining to take further immediate steps on the current card system.
I share the view of the OV Ombudsman that the repair of lifts and escalators should be given priority in keeping stations accessible.
Ik deel de mening van de OV Ombudsman dat de reparatie van liften en roltrappen prioriteit moet hebben in het toegankelijk houden van stations.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het bericht ‘Bouw brandblusinstallatie Waalhaven Zuid op losse schroeven’

An MP asked why the fire-suppression works at Waalhaven Zuid rail yard cost four times the estimate, how a 63 million euro shortfall arose at ProRail, why it was disclosed late, and what logistics and closure risks follow for the 1 January 2023 deadline. The State Secretary answered that the cost rise reflects project complexity, that ProRail is still validating the estimate and shortfall, that the ministry was alerted in December 2021, and that all parties are working to meet the deadline.
Once a stable picture is available, I can proceed to decision-making on the shortfall.
Zodra er een stabiel beeld is kan ik overgaan tot besluitvorming over het tekort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Bouchallikh over PFAS in de Westerschelde

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government about PFAS contamination of fish and shellfish in the Westerschelde, public warnings, the Hedwigepolder managed-realignment project, and coordination with Flanders. The ministers answered that GGD Zeeland issued consumption advice, that EU restriction and Flemish emission measures are underway, that the Hedwigepolder project may proceed because PFAS levels are within legal limits, and that a senior-official coordinator will be appointed.

In response to the letter from the Zeeland provincial executive, the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management has indicated that he wants to appoint a coordinator at senior official level in both central government and the province of Zeeland.

In reactie op de brief van gedeputeerde staten van Zeeland heeft de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat aangegeven bij zowel de rijksoverheid als de provincie Zeeland op hoogambtelijk niveau een coördinator te willen aanwijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht ‘Na jaar vertraging levert Schiphol onvolledige data over gifstoffen’

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked about reports that Schiphol delivered late and incomplete data on emissions of carcinogenic substances, and whether the Omgevingsdienst NZKG should enforce before assessing the report and how citizens are protected. The minister replies that the reported emissions concern only 0.1% of Schiphol's total ZZS emissions under the environmental permit, that the regulator granted two extensions and gave Schiphol two months for supplementary data, that enforcement is not ruled out but no sanctions yet, and that the government will examine in the first half of 2022 whether aviation ZZS emissions require reduction.
Therefore I will examine in the first half of this year whether emissions of ZZS from aviation affect the surroundings of airports to such an extent that these emissions must be reduced.
Daarom zal ik nog in de eerste helft van dit jaar bezien of de uitstoot van ZZS door de luchtvaart, de omgeving van luchthavens dusdanig negatief beïnvloedt, dat die uitstoot moet verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de verwachting dat de productie van plastic rond 2040 zal zijn verdubbeld en het plastic afval in de oceaan tegen 2050 is verviervoudigd

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about a WWF report on plastic pollution in oceans, microplastic health risks, bans on single-use plastics, extended producer responsibility, a possible plastic tax and a binding UN treaty. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing and planned measures (bans, deposit schemes, producer responsibility for litter, research funding, a study on a polymer tax) and said a binding UN plastics treaty negotiation will start in 2022.
I share WWF's concerns about plastic in the environment; it does not belong there.
Ik deel de zorgen van het WWF over plastic in het milieu, daar hoort het niet thuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het artikel 'Welkom op het slechtste station van Nederland: 'Ik heb maar een auto gekocht''

An MP asked the state secretary about a news report calling Rotterdam-Zuid the worst station in the Netherlands, covering ratings, ridership, crime, camera surveillance, complaints and safety measures. The state secretary acknowledged the low rating, described joint police, municipal and NS/ProRail safety measures, and gave ridership and crime figures without addressing executive oversight.
That is unpleasant for the travellers who use this station and that must improve.
Dat is vervelend voor de reizigers die gebruik maken van dit station en dat moet beter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Van Ginneken, Van der Molen, De Hoop en Bouchallikh over toegankelijkheid in het openbaar vervoer

Five MPs asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about accessibility of public transport, including the delayed Bestuursakkoord toegankelijkheid OV, assistance and toilets on regional trains, station counter closures, and the replacement of accessible buses by buurtbus and taxi concepts. The state secretary confirmed the accord was not concluded due to the outgoing cabinet, promised to aim for completion before summer without committing to specifics, and said a study on buurtbus accessibility is underway with results expected in November 2022.
I also consider it desirable that the measures are developed through a careful process.
Ik vind het daarnaast wenselijk dat de maatregelen tot stand komen via een zorgvuldig proces.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Inge van Dijk over het mogelijk verdwijnen van de Bredabus n.a.v. het bericht van omroep Zeeland ‘Van Zeeland tot Breda: politici willen Bredabus koste wat k

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary whether he shares concerns about the possible loss of bus line 19 (Bredabus) between Hulst and Breda, the proposal to end it at Antwerp, and what can be done to prevent public transport decline in Zeeland. The State Secretary answered that public transport is important, that the province of Zeeland (the responsible authority) wants to keep the link but faces rising costs, that the province is talking with NS about student travel, and that decentralised authorities bear responsibility for service design.
The responsible public transport authority, the province of Zeeland, has informed me that it also sees the importance of the Hulst-Breda link and therefore wishes to keep it.
De verantwoordelijke OV-autoriteit, de provincie Zeeland, heeft me laten weten ook het belang van de verbinding Hulst-Breda te zien en wil deze daarom ook graag behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over het bericht 'Rotterdam vraagt Staatssecretaris om oplossing voor blusprobleem Waalhaven Zuid'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about ProRail's reported 63 million euro shortfall for fire-fighting and safety measures at the Waalhaven Zuid rail yard, the risk of closure on 1 January 2023, and the transport of hazardous goods. The State Secretary answered that safety is currently not at stake, that ProRail is preparing an externally reviewed cost estimate and that a decision on the shortfall will follow, likely before summer.
On the basis of this picture, I can proceed to decision-making.
Op basis van dit beeld kan ik overgaan tot besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Van Ginneken over het niet dragen van mondkapjes in de taxi.

Two D66 MPs asked why the mask requirement in taxis lapses when only one passenger is present, whether this differs from public transport, and about risks and the use of partitions. The state secretary answered that the exemption follows from the 1.5-metre distance norm, that taxis are not public transport, and that no signals of enforcement problems have been received.
The Ministry of I&W regularly has contact with the transport operators about the corona measures.
Het Ministerie van IenW heeft regelmatig contact met de vervoerders over de coronamaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Hoop over het opheffen van servicebalies op treinstations

An MP asked the state secretary about NS closing staffed service counters at railway stations and how accessibility and personal help for less digitally skilled travellers, and the concession's information obligations, are safeguarded. The state secretary said station operations are NS's responsibility within the concession, that the government is monitoring the issue, that other forms of assistance remain available, and that the next concession will still aim for accessible public transport.

Within the agreements I have laid down in the main rail network transport concession on matters such as accessibility and social safety, it is up to NS to align its service provision and staffing as well as possible with the needs of the traveller.

Met inachtneming van de afspraken die ik heb vastgelegd in de vervoersconcessie voor het hoofdrailnet over zaken als toegankelijkheid en sociale veiligheid, is het aan NS om haar dienstverlening en personele inzet op een zo goede en efficiënt mogelijke manier aan te laten sluiten op de behoefte van de reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over de producentenverantwoordelijkheid van matrassen.

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the voluntary extended producer responsibility scheme for mattresses, covering fee levels, cost coverage, monitoring, consultation and the absence of legal targets. The State Secretary replied that producers set the scheme's terms themselves, that government only declared the private agreement generally binding, and that further policy details would follow in a letter.
The producer responsibility for mattresses therefore has no statutory obligations or targets.
Daarmee kent de producentenverantwoordelijkheid voor matrassen geen wettelijke verplichtingen of doelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over de toename van het aantal treinstoringen

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management why train disruptions rose nationwide in 2021, whether ProRail and NS were contacted, what actions were planned, why the rail operator reports more punctual journeys despite more disruptions, and how the shortage of traffic controllers relates to the increase. The State Secretary answered that ProRail reports only a slight 2-3% rise in disruptions, mainly due to winter conditions, that neither NS nor ProRail recognises a sharp nationwide increase, that performance indicators are within agreed targets so no extra action is planned, that traffic controller shortages are a very minor cause, and that punctuality and disruption metrics are defined differently.
At this moment I therefore see no reason to take additional actions.
Op dit moment zie ik dan ook geen aanleiding om aanvullende acties te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en De Hoop over het bericht ‘Spoorbrug in Maastricht wordt gesloopt: slechts 15 treinen na renovatie van 33 miljoen’

Two PvdA MPs asked why a rail bridge in Maastricht, renovated for 33 million euros, is to be demolished after only 15 trains crossed it, and whether alternatives and municipal consultation were considered. The minister and state secretary answered that freight traffic failed after the Sappi reorganisation, that the bridge obstructs navigation and water safety on the Julianakanaal, that the municipality is the competent authority for the demolition permit, and that future maintenance spending will be assessed for efficiency.

The intention to demolish a disused bridge, saving costs on management, maintenance, renovation and adjustments in favour of nautical and high-water safety, is on balance an efficient use of state funds.

Het voornemen om een in onbruik geraakte brug te slopen en zo kosten uit te sparen voor beheer, onderhoud, renovatie en aanpassingen ten gunste van nautische- en hoogwaterveiligheid is onder de streep een doelmatige inzet van rijksmiddelen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het contact met de regio (Achterhoek en Twente) over de noordtak van de Betuwelijn en een verzoek om ter plaatste het traject te zien en het gesprek aan te gaan

An MP asked the minister about regional opposition to a northern branch of the Betuwe freight line, consultation with the Achterhoek and Twente, costs, and a request to visit and talk with residents. The state secretary replied that no decision has been taken, that consultation has been broad but without specific talks on the branch, and that a visit to the region is planned.
I cannot go into the possible consequences for Doetinchem, Haaksbergen, Hengelo/Oldenzaal.
Ik kan niet in gaan op de eventuele gevolgen voor Doetinchem, Haaksbergen, Hengelo/ Oldenzaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht in de Gelderlander van 23 januari: 'Heisa in de Achterhoek over nieuwe tak van de Betuweroute: ‘Het brengt ons helemaal niets’

An MP asked the state secretary about residents' concerns over a study of the economic and social value of a northern branch of the Betuweroute rail freight line, and about involving local parties and German alternatives. The state secretary answered that no decision has been taken, the preliminary study (due spring 2022) will be reported to parliament, and stakeholders and livability will be considered, with scenarios to be examined only if a route study is decided.
When the study is completed, I will inform your House.
Wanneer het onderzoek is afgerond, zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Grinwis over het bericht 'Tata vervuilender dan gedacht: een gat in de administratie'

An ChristenUnie MP asked whether RIVM measurements showing more metals and PAH near Tata Steel IJmuiden than the emissions register predicts should lead to a continuous deposition monitoring programme, direct enforcement of Tata's permit, and similar checks on other large emitters. The state secretary said the discrepancy is worrying, that the province will investigate the reporting gap and deposition studies will be commissioned for 2022, but declined to order direct enforcement and deferred judgement on other emitters pending that investigation.
I consider it important that the reporting of emissions from the Tata Steel site and the underlying system be examined as quickly as possible
Ik vind het belangrijk dat er zo snel mogelijk naar de rapportage van de emissies van het terrein van Tata Steel en de achterliggende systematiek wordt gekeken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht “FNV Spoor is er klaar mee: personeel op IC Brussel belaagd door ‘tuig van de trein’’

MP Van Ginneken asked about intimidation and violence on the IC Brussel line, the lack of enforcement powers across the Belgian border, and union demands for action. The Staatssecretaris answered that incident numbers did not specifically rise during lockdowns, described extra NS and police measures, and said cross-border enforcement has no legal basis, with ongoing cooperation with Belgian counterparts.
On the basis of these agreements I will remain in close contact with NS and the Belgian government to be able to respond quickly to comparable situations.
Op basis van deze afspraken zal ik met de NS en de Belgische overheid in nauw contact blijven om snel op vergelijkbare situaties te kunnen reageren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht dat European Sleeper de dienstregeling van de nieuwe nachttrein tussen Brussel, Rotterdam, Amsterdam, Berlijn en Praag heeft bekendgemaakt

MPs Amhaouch and Palland (CDA) asked about the European Sleeper night train timetable, why it stops only in the Randstad and not in regional stations like Hengelo, the government's involvement or subsidies, and the role of regional stations and capacity. The Staatssecretaris answered that the operator decides its stops, no subsidy goes to European Sleeper, other international trains do stop in regional stations, and capacity has been allocated without major problems.
Developing the timetable is in principle the responsibility of the operator itself, including the choice of a particular stopping pattern.
Het ontwikkelen van de dienstregeling is in beginsel de verantwoordelijkheid van de vervoerder zelf, inclusief de keuze voor een bepaald stoppatroon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Alkaya, Grinwis en Van der Plas over de mogelijkheid dat de nachttrein Brussel/Amsterdam-Berlijn/Dresden/Praag ook in Hengelo stopt

MPs asked why the new European Sleeper night train from Brussels/Amsterdam to Berlin/Dresden/Prague does not stop in Hengelo despite earlier investment in the Hengelo-Bad Bentheim link and overnight travel gaps. The State Secretary explained that the stop is commercially and timetable-constrained for European Sleeper, that a stop in 2022 is unlikely, and that the government will explore whether a 2023 stop is feasible and talk with the operator.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Grevink over de uitspraak van Gerechtshof ’s-Hertogenbosch over forse verhoging van de forensenbelasting in 2020

MPs Idsinga and Grevink (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior whether the government shares concern about a court ruling on a sharp municipal forensenbelasting increase and whether municipalities are overstepping their powers. The minister replied that municipal taxation is an autonomous competence, that the courts and municipal politics provide sufficient safeguards, and declined to assess the case or propose new limits.

The tax levy concerned is an autonomous competence of the municipality and, given the role of the independent judge, it is not for me to give a judgment on the assessment and/or the court ruling on it.

De betreffende belastingheffing is een autonome bevoegdheid van de gemeente en gegeven de rol van de onafhankelijke rechter, is het niet aan mij om een oordeel te geven over de aanslag en/of de rechtelijke uitspraak daarover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Grevink over het bericht 'Schiphol en Havenbedrijf Rotterdam klagen de staat aan over 5G-beleid'

MPs asked the minister about the 3.5 GHz spectrum allocation for local use, after Schiphol and the Port of Rotterdam sued the state over the 5G policy and its first-come-first-served allocation. The minister answered that local-use concerns were partly accommodated in the final band plan, that the mainports' wish for a formal coordinating role is for the government to weigh in the allocation conditions, and that the appeals may delay but do not necessarily stop the auction.

However, it remains the (statutory) task of the government, specifically the Radio Communications Agency (RDI), to assess licence applications, coordinate with other radio services, and grant licences to applicants.

Het is en blijft echter de (wettelijke) taak van de overheid, specifiek die van de Rijksinspectie Digitale Infrastructuur (RDI), om vergunningaanvragen te toetsen, de coördinatie met andere radiodiensten te verzorgen, en vergunningen te verlenen aan de aanvragers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grevink en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Internet kan tientallen euro’s goedkoper in Nederland'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether internet access prices in the Netherlands are too high, whether market entry is hindered, and what will be done to open the market. The minister confirmed Dutch prices are relatively high, noted the ACM has binding commitments from KPN and Glaspoort and is preparing a new market analysis that will be delayed beyond this year, and pointed to the existing legislative framework as the responsibility of the independent regulator.
The ACM is currently working on a new market analysis.
De ACM werkt momenteel aan een nieuwe marktanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van Lanschot, Piri, Van der Werf, Belhirch, Van der Burg, Ceder en Dassen  over een gat in de steun aan Oekraïne

MPs from several parties asked whether part of the 2026 military support budget for Ukraine was brought forward into 2025, leaving a gap in 2026, and how the government will prevent unwanted gaps. The Minister confirms that €3.1 billion for 2026 was partly accelerated into 2025, that planned 2026 cash outlays now stand at about €2.1 billion, and that support will continue with further burden-sharing efforts, without committing to a specific new safeguard.
Part of this support has been accelerated into cash expenditure in 2025.
Een deel van deze steun is versneld in 2025 tot kasuitgaven gekomen.
